"""Sector-flow catch-up conditioned on transient basket execution residuals."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank


def _static_labels(sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Obtain one static sector label per ticker."""
    if sector.empty:
        return pd.Series(index=sector.columns, dtype=object)
    labels = sector.ffill().bfill().iloc[-1].astype(object)
    fallback = pd.Series(
        ["__missing_" + str(col) for col in sector.columns],
        index=sector.columns,
        dtype=object,
    )
    return labels.where(labels.notna(), fallback)


def _sector_median(frame: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series, minimum: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Same-date sector median, returned in the original panel layout."""
    out = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=frame.index, columns=frame.columns)
    for group in labels.unique():
        cols = labels[labels == group].index
        if len(cols) < minimum:
            continue
        block = frame.loc[:, cols]
        med = block.median(axis=1).where(block.notna().sum(axis=1) >= minimum)
        out.loc[:, cols] = np.repeat(med.to_numpy()[:, None], len(cols), axis=1)
    return out


def _leave_one_out_sector_mean(ret: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Winsorized leave-one-out sector return, avoiding own-return contamination."""
    out = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)
    for group in labels.unique():
        cols = labels[labels == group].index
        if len(cols) < 5:
            continue
        block = ret.loc[:, cols]
        lo = block.quantile(0.10, axis=1)
        hi = block.quantile(0.90, axis=1)
        clipped = block.clip(lower=lo, upper=hi, axis=0)
        count = clipped.notna().sum(axis=1)
        total = clipped.sum(axis=1, skipna=True)
        for col in cols:
            own = clipped[col]
            others = count - own.notna().astype(float)
            loo = (total - own.fillna(0.0)) / others.replace(0.0, np.nan)
            out[col] = loo.where(others >= 4)
    return out


def _trailing_beta(y: pd.DataFrame, x: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal rolling beta estimated only from returns available before today."""
    yy = y.shift(1)
    xx = x.shift(1)
    paired = yy.notna() & xx.notna()
    yy = yy.where(paired)
    xx = xx.where(paired)
    count = paired.astype(float).rolling(40, min_periods=30).sum()
    sx = xx.rolling(40, min_periods=30).sum()
    sy = yy.rolling(40, min_periods=30).sum()
    sxx = (xx * xx).rolling(40, min_periods=30).sum()
    sxy = (xx * yy).rolling(40, min_periods=30).sum()
    cov = sxy - sx * sy / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    var = sxx - sx * sx / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return (cov / var.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.1, upper=2.5)


@register_factor
class SectorHandoffBasketResidualConvergence(BaseFactor):
    """Repair an idiosyncratic basket residual only when it deepens an unpaid sector catch-up."""

    factor_id = "sector_handoff_basket_residual_convergence"
    name = "Sector Handoff Residual Convergence"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Sector-relative intraday execution residual reversal conditioned on a "
        "prior weak-participation sector lag, normalized participation, and broad "
        "sector abnormal turnover."
    )
    window_length = 42
    inputs = ["open", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        open_ = data["open"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        labels = _static_labels(data["sector"].reindex(columns=close.columns))

        prev_close = close.shift(1)
        ret = close / prev_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        ret = ret.where((close > 0.0) & (prev_close > 0.0))
        sector_mode = _leave_one_out_sector_mean(ret, labels)
        beta = _trailing_beta(ret, sector_mode)

        safe_open = open_.where(open_ > 0.0)
        intraday = np.log(close.where(close > 0.0) / safe_open)
        sector_intraday = _sector_median(intraday, labels, 4)
        idio_residual = intraday - sector_intraday

        valid_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0)
        own_baseline = valid_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        volume_ratio = (valid_volume / own_baseline.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.05, 20.0)
        sector_ratio = _sector_median(volume_ratio, labels, 4)
        relative_participation = volume_ratio / sector_ratio.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        log_volume = np.log1p(valid_volume)
        hist = log_volume.shift(1)
        vol_mean = hist.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
        vol_std = hist.rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()
        abnormal_volume = (log_volume - vol_mean) / vol_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        abnormal_volume = abnormal_volume.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        sector_abnormal = _sector_median(abnormal_volume, labels, 4)
        sector_breadth = _sector_median(abnormal_volume.gt(0.0).astype(float), labels, 4)
        broad_basket = (sector_abnormal >= 0.15) & (sector_breadth >= 0.60)

        mode_lag = sector_mode.shift(1)
        stock_lag = ret.shift(1)
        initial_gap = beta * mode_lag - stock_lag
        response_gap = beta * (mode_lag + sector_mode) - (stock_lag + ret)
        mode_scale = sector_mode.shift(2).abs().rolling(40, min_periods=30).median()
        meaningful_mode = mode_lag.abs() >= 1.25 * mode_scale
        persistent_mode = (sector_mode * mode_lag > 0.0) & (sector_mode.abs() >= 0.20 * mode_scale)

        handoff = (
            (relative_participation.shift(1) <= 0.80)
            & (relative_participation >= 1.00)
            & (relative_participation > relative_participation.shift(1))
        )
        unpaid = (
            (initial_gap * mode_lag > 0.0)
            & (response_gap * mode_lag > 0.0)
        )

        repair = -idio_residual
        agreement = repair * response_gap > 0.0
        idio_scale = intraday.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()
        ret_scale = ret.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()
        normalized_repair = repair / idio_scale.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        gap_strength = (response_gap.abs() / ret_scale.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(upper=3.0)

        dollar_volume = (close * valid_volume).where(close > 0.0)
        liquidity = dollar_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        liquid = liquidity.ge(liquidity.quantile(0.20, axis=1), axis=0)

        eligible = (
            broad_basket
            & handoff
            & unpaid
            & meaningful_mode
            & persistent_mode
            & agreement
            & liquid
            & beta.notna()
        )
        score = (normalized_repair * gap_strength).where(eligible)
        return rank(score).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Sector Handoff Residual Convergence
programs.trading_idea: Broad sector turnover identifies synchronized basket execution, but an individual residual is not automatically reversible when it reflects genuine information. The child activates residual repair only for stocks that were previously under-responsive to an ongoing sector move on weak relative participation and whose participation has now normalized: a same-day idiosyncratic residual in the direction of further under-response is interpreted as temporary execution pressure layered on top of an unpaid sector-flow catch-up. Parent A supplies the directional common-flow debt, while Parent B identifies the transient stock-specific execution distortion; their agreement produces a near-term convergence trade neither a generic basket reversal nor a standalone sector-lag signal can isolate.
programs.description: Computes a beta-adjusted two-day sector response gap and requires a weak-to-normal relative-volume handoff during a broad sector abnormal-volume event. It ranks the reversal of the stock's sector-relative intraday residual only when that reversal direction agrees with the remaining sector response gap.

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank


def _industry_groups(industry: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[object, list[object]]:
    labels = industry.iloc[0] if not industry.empty else pd.Series(dtype=object)
    groups: dict[object, list[object]] = {}
    for column in industry.columns:
        label = labels.get(column, np.nan)
        if pd.notna(label):
            groups.setdefault(label, []).append(column)
    return groups


def _excluded_industry_return(
    ret: pd.DataFrame, groups: dict[object, list[object]]
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Equal-weight same-industry return excluding the target stock."""
    peer = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)
    for columns in groups.values():
        values = ret[columns]
        valid = values.notna()
        total = values.where(valid, 0.0).sum(axis=1)
        count = valid.sum(axis=1).astype(float)
        excluded_total = total.to_numpy()[:, None] - values.where(valid, 0.0).to_numpy()
        excluded_count = count.to_numpy()[:, None] - valid.astype(float).to_numpy()
        result = pd.DataFrame(
            excluded_total / np.where(excluded_count > 0.0, excluded_count, np.nan),
            index=ret.index,
            columns=columns,
        )
        peer.loc[:, columns] = result.where(excluded_count >= 3.0)
    return peer


def _trailing_beta(
    stock_ret: pd.DataFrame, peer_ret: pd.DataFrame, window: int, min_pairs: int
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """OLS beta estimated strictly from observations available before today."""
    x = peer_ret.shift(1)
    y = stock_ret.shift(1)
    valid = x.notna() & y.notna()
    count = valid.astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    x0 = x.where(valid, 0.0)
    y0 = y.where(valid, 0.0)
    sx = x0.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sy = y0.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sxx = (x0 * x0).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sxy = (x0 * y0).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    denominator = sxx - sx * sx / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    numerator = sxy - sx * sy / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return (numerator / denominator.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(count >= min_pairs)


def _surprise_direction(
    eps_surprise: pd.DataFrame,
    eps_estimate: pd.DataFrame,
    revenue_surprise: pd.DataFrame,
    revenue_estimate: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Robust cross-sectional signed consensus-surprise state."""
    eps = eps_surprise / eps_estimate.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    revenue = revenue_surprise / revenue_estimate.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    combined = 0.5 * eps.clip(-2.0, 2.0) + 0.5 * revenue.clip(-2.0, 2.0)
    return 2.0 * combined.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 1.0


@register_factor
class IndustryShockSurpriseIgnitionGap(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "industry_shock_surprise_ignition_gap"
    name = "Surprise-Aligned Industry Catch-Up Ignition"
    category = "statistical_arbitrage"
    description = (
        "Ranks beta-implied industry-response gaps when a high-participation, "
        "surprise-aligned directional bar begins resolving an industry shock."
    )
    window_length = 42
    inputs = [
        "open",
        "high",
        "low",
        "close",
        "volume",
        "industry",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        stock_ret = (close / previous_close - 1.0).where(
            (close > 0.0) & (previous_close > 0.0)
        )
        peer_ret = _excluded_industry_return(stock_ret, _industry_groups(data["industry"]))
        beta = _trailing_beta(stock_ret, peer_ret, 40, 25)

        prior_peer_vol = peer_ret.shift(1).rolling(40, min_periods=25).std()
        shock_z = peer_ret.abs() / prior_peer_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        shock_strength = ((shock_z - 1.0) / 2.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

        gap = beta * peer_ret - stock_ret
        prior_stock_vol = stock_ret.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()
        standardized_gap = gap / prior_stock_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        surprise = _surprise_direction(
            data["epsSurprise"],
            data["epsEstimate"],
            data["revenueSurprise"],
            data["revenueEstimate"],
        )
        surprise_shock_alignment = (
            np.sign(surprise) * np.sign(peer_ret)
        ).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

        prior_median_volume = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        relative_volume = volume / prior_median_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        participation = ((relative_volume - 1.0) / 1.5).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

        bar_range = high - low
        body_alignment = (
            np.sign(surprise) * (close - open_) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        ).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        endpoint = 2.0 * (close - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        endpoint_alignment = (np.sign(surprise) * endpoint).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        information_ignition = participation * (0.5 * body_alignment + 0.5 * endpoint_alignment)

        raw = standardized_gap * shock_strength * surprise_shock_alignment * information_ignition
        valid = (
            raw.notna()
            & (bar_range > 0.0)
            & (volume > 0.0)
            & (prior_median_volume > 0.0)
            & surprise.notna()
        )
        return rank(raw.where(valid)).reindex_like(close).fillna(0.0)

programs.trading_idea: A common industry shock can leave a constituent below its beta-implied adjustment when its initial response is incomplete, especially before attention reaches the name. The residual becomes more credible when a subsequent high-participation directional bar agrees with the stock's latest earnings-and-revenue surprise: that bar is an information-rich ignition event rather than noise, while the remaining industry-response gap supplies the unpriced catch-up. Neither parent alone distinguishes a generic surprise-confirmed bar from one with an externally anchored residual repricing opportunity, nor a generic industry lag from one where informed local participation has begun resolving it.
programs.description: Computes each stock's lagged-beta residual versus a stock-excluded industry shock, then emphasizes residuals only when the shock, latest normalized surprise, and a high-volume endpoint/body bar share direction. The result is cross-sectionally ranked and defensively returns zero for unavailable or insufficient-history observations.

programs.code:
"""The factor trades temporary deviations from a stock's own pre-specified historical response to a contemporaneous broad sector move, rather than assuming that all firms should have identical sector exposure. A stock is favored when its intraday sector-relative return is muted versus its lagged sector-response elasticity and its relative trading participation is converging from a prior under-participation state toward the sector norm. The intended mechanism is gradual completion of correlated risk-transfer or execution flow after an initially uneven allocation across liquid names, while historical response adjustment, sector-neutral construction, and a liquidity screen reduce exposure to persistent differences in sector beta, firm information, and implementation costs."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _finite(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Replace non-finite numeric values with missing values."""
    return df.where(np.isfinite(df))


def _sector_labels(sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Extract static sector labels without using future market observations."""
    labels = sector.iloc[0].copy()
    labels = labels.where(labels.notna(), pd.Series(sector.columns, index=sector.columns))
    return labels


def _leave_one_out_mean(
    values: pd.DataFrame,
    valid: pd.DataFrame,
    labels: pd.Series,
    min_others: int,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Causal same-date leave-one-out sector means and other-name counts."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns, dtype=float)
    other_count = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=values.index, columns=values.columns)

    for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        cols = labels.index[labels == label]
        if len(cols) == 0:
            continue

        x = values.loc[:, cols]
        v = valid.loc[:, cols] & x.notna()
        total = x.where(v).sum(axis=1, min_count=1)
        count = v.sum(axis=1).astype(float)
        own = x.where(v, 0.0)
        others = count.to_frame().reindex(columns=cols, fill_value=0.0) - v.astype(float)
        loo = total.to_frame().reindex(columns=cols, fill_value=np.nan) - own
        loo = loo / others.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        usable = v & (others >= float(min_others))

        result.loc[:, cols] = loo.where(usable)
        other_count.loc[:, cols] = others.where(v, 0.0)

    return result, other_count


def _sector_intraday_mean_and_breadth(
    intraday_return: pd.DataFrame,
    labels: pd.Series,
    min_others: int,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Compute leave-one-out intraday sector moves and sign breadth."""
    sector_move = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=intraday_return.index, columns=intraday_return.columns)
    breadth = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=intraday_return.index, columns=intraday_return.columns)

    for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        cols = labels.index[labels == label]
        if len(cols) == 0:
            continue

        x = intraday_return.loc[:, cols]
        valid = x.notna()
        count = valid.sum(axis=1).astype(float)
        total = x.where(valid).sum(axis=1, min_count=1)
        others = count.to_frame().reindex(columns=cols, fill_value=0.0) - valid.astype(float)
        loo = (total.to_frame().reindex(columns=cols, fill_value=np.nan) - x.where(valid, 0.0))
        loo = loo / others.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        positive = ((x > 0.0) & valid).sum(axis=1).astype(float)
        negative = ((x < 0.0) & valid).sum(axis=1).astype(float)
        pos_other = positive.to_frame().reindex(columns=cols, fill_value=0.0) - ((x > 0.0) & valid).astype(float)
        neg_other = negative.to_frame().reindex(columns=cols, fill_value=0.0) - ((x < 0.0) & valid).astype(float)

        b = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=x.index, columns=x.columns)
        b = b.where(~(loo > 0.0), pos_other / others.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        b = b.where(~(loo < 0.0), neg_other / others.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        usable = valid & (others >= float(min_others)) & (loo != 0.0)

        sector_move.loc[:, cols] = loo.where(valid & (others >= float(min_others)))
        breadth.loc[:, cols] = b.where(usable)

    return sector_move, breadth


def _sector_rank_weights(
    score: pd.DataFrame,
    retained: pd.DataFrame,
    labels: pd.Series,
    min_sector_size: int,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Form average-tie sector ranks, sector-neutral weights, and global L1 scaling."""
    preliminary = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=score.index, columns=score.columns)

    for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        cols = labels.index[labels == label]
        if len(cols) == 0:
            continue

        x = score.loc[:, cols].where(retained.loc[:, cols])
        count = x.notna().sum(axis=1)
        ranks = x.rank(axis=1, method="average")
        scaled_rank = (ranks.sub(1.0)).div((count - 1).replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)
        weights = (scaled_rank - 0.5).where(count >= min_sector_size, 0.0)
        preliminary.loc[:, cols] = weights.fillna(0.0)

    gross = preliminary.abs().sum(axis=1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return preliminary.div(gross, axis=0).fillna(0.0)


@register_factor
class SectorFlowElasticityRepair(BaseFactor):
    """Sector-neutral lagged-elasticity flow-repair signal."""

    factor_id = "sector_flow_elasticity_repair"
    name = "Lagged Sector Response Convergence"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Uses a lagged leave-one-out sector response elasticity to identify "
        "under-responsive intraday moves, amplified when relative volume "
        "participation converges toward the sector norm; produces liquidity-"
        "screened, sector-neutral L1-normalized weights."
    )
    window_length = 22
    inputs = ["open", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = _finite(data["close"].astype(float))
        open_ = _finite(data["open"].astype(float))
        volume = _finite(data["volume"].astype(float))
        labels = _sector_labels(data["sector"])

        valid_price = (close > 0.0) & (open_ > 0.0)
        intraday = (close / open_ - 1.0).where(valid_price)

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        daily_return = (close / prior_close - 1.0).where((close > 0.0) & (prior_close > 0.0))

        sector_intraday, breadth = _sector_intraday_mean_and_breadth(
            intraday, labels, 8
        )
        sector_daily, _ = _leave_one_out_mean(
            daily_return, daily_return.notna(), labels, 8
        )

        paired = daily_return.notna() & sector_daily.notna()
        numerator = (daily_return * sector_daily).where(paired)
        denominator = (sector_daily * sector_daily).where(paired)
        pair_count = paired.astype(float).rolling(20, min_periods=1).sum().shift(1)
        beta_num = numerator.rolling(20, min_periods=1).sum().shift(1)
        beta_den = denominator.rolling(20, min_periods=1).sum().shift(1)
        beta = (beta_num / beta_den.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(
            (pair_count >= 15.0) & (beta_den > 1.0e-10)
        ).clip(-3.0, 3.0)

        positive_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0)
        baseline_count = positive_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=1).count()
        baseline_volume = positive_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=1).mean()
        participation = (
            np.log1p(volume.where(volume >= 0.0)) - np.log1p(baseline_volume)
        ).where(baseline_count >= 15.0)
        participation = _finite(participation)

        sector_participation, _ = _leave_one_out_mean(
            participation, participation.notna(), labels, 8
        )
        relative_participation = (participation - sector_participation).where(
            participation.notna() & sector_participation.notna()
        )
        prior_participation = relative_participation.shift(1).rolling(
            5, min_periods=4
        ).mean()
        convergence = (
            -prior_participation * (relative_participation - prior_participation)
        ).where(relative_participation.notna() & prior_participation.notna())

        q_low = convergence.quantile(0.05, axis=1)
        q_high = convergence.quantile(0.95, axis=1)
        q_winsor = convergence.clip(lower=q_low, upper=q_high, axis=0)
        q_mean = q_winsor.mean(axis=1)
        q_std = q_winsor.std(axis=1, ddof=0)
        z_q = q_winsor.sub(q_mean, axis=0).div(q_std.replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0)
        z_q = z_q.where(q_std > 0.0, 0.0).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
        multiplier = (1.0 + 0.5 * z_q).clip(0.0, 2.5)

        residual = intraday - beta * sector_intraday
        under_response = -np.sign(sector_intraday) * residual
        score = (breadth * under_response * multiplier).where(
            breadth.notna()
            & under_response.notna()
            & multiplier.notna()
            & (sector_intraday != 0.0)
        )

        dollar_volume = (close * volume).where((close > 0.0) & (volume >= 0.0))
        liquidity_count = dollar_volume.rolling(21, min_periods=1).count()
        liquidity = dollar_volume.rolling(21, min_periods=1).mean().where(
            liquidity_count >= 15.0
        )
        eligible = score.notna() & liquidity.notna()
        liquidity_rank = liquidity.where(eligible).rank(axis=1, pct=True, method="average")
        retained = eligible & (liquidity_rank >= 0.30)

        return _sector_rank_weights(score, retained, labels, 10)
programs.name: Lagged Sector Response Convergence
programs.trading_idea: The factor trades temporary deviations from a stock's own pre-specified historical response to a contemporaneous broad sector move, rather than assuming that all firms should have identical sector exposure. A stock is favored when its intraday sector-relative return is muted versus its lagged sector-response elasticity and its relative trading participation is converging from a prior under-participation state toward the sector norm. The intended mechanism is gradual completion of correlated risk-transfer or execution flow after an initially uneven allocation across liquid names, while historical response adjustment, sector-neutral construction, and a liquidity screen reduce exposure to persistent differences in sector beta, firm information, and implementation costs.
programs.description: Decision time is the close of bar t; the forecast return is close-to-close from immediately after t through t+6. All inputs use only bars dated t or earlier. Let r_i,d = close_i,d / close_i,d-1 - 1 and g_i,t = close_i,t / open_i,t - 1. For each stock i, define its leave-one-out sector set as all other eligible stocks with the same static sector label. A sector observation is valid only when at least 8 other names have non-missing required inputs. Define G_-i,t as the equal-weighted mean of g_j,t across that leave-one-out set, and define sector breadth B_-i,t as the fraction of those names for which sign(g_j,t) equals sign(G_-i,t); if G_-i,t = 0, set the final signal to zero. Define a_i,d = log((volume_i,d + 1) / (mean(volume_i,d-20 through d-1) + 1)); require at least 15 positive-volume observations in that 20-bar baseline. Define A_-i,t as the leave-one-out sector mean of a_j,t and stock-relative participation p_i,t = a_i,t - A_-i,t. Define prior relative participation pbar_i,t as the mean of p_i,d for d = t-5 through t-1, requiring at least 4 valid observations, and define participation-convergence q_i,t = -pbar_i,t * (p_i,t - pbar_i,t). Thus q is positive when a stock that had been relatively under-participating moves toward the sector participation level, or when prior over-participation subsides. Define the lagged sector-response elasticity beta_i,t using only d = t-20 through t-1: beta_i,t = sum(r_i,d * R_-i,d) / sum(R_-i,d^2), where R_-i,d is the leave-one-out equal-weighted sector close-to-close return on d. Require at least 15 valid paired observations and sum(R_-i,d^2) greater than 1e-10; winsorize beta_i,t to [-3, 3]. The contemporaneous intraday residual is e_i,t = g_i,t - beta_i,t * G_-i,t. The signed under-response component is u_i,t = -sign(G_-i,t) * e_i,t, so a positive value means the stock moved less in the direction of its own historically estimated sector response. Winsorize q cross-sectionally each day at the 5th and 95th percentiles among valid stocks, standardize it to z_q using that same day's cross-sectional mean and standard deviation, cap z_q to [-3, 3], and set m_i,t = clip(1 + 0.5 * z_q, 0, 2.5). The raw score is S_i,t = B_-i,t * u_i,t * m_i,t. To limit implementation risk, retain only stocks in the top 70% of the eligible universe by mean(close_i,d * volume_i,d) over d = t-20 through t, requiring at least 15 valid observations. Within each sector with at least 10 retained stocks, rank S_i,t from 0 to 1 using average ranks for ties and form sector-neutral preliminary weights w_i,t = rank_sector(S_i,t) - 0.5. Normalize weights across all retained sectors so that sum(abs(w_i,t)) = 1; sectors failing the minimum-count rule receive zero weight. Higher scores are expected to have higher subsequent six-bar returns. This is mechanically distinct from a simple sector abnormal-volume residual-repair signal because the trade requires a fixed lagged leave-one-out response elasticity, an intraday residual relative to that elasticity, and a separately defined five-bar relative-participation convergence multiplier.

programs.code:
"""Broad, contemporaneous sector participation can create short-lived relative-price pressure even when it does not uniquely identify ETF or benchmark flow. The signal therefore does not infer dealer inventory or classify the common shock as passive flow; it tests the narrower proposition that a stock's sector-beta-adjusted one-day move is more likely to reverse when peers move coherently, sector volume is broadly elevated, and the stock's own volume does not corroborate an idiosyncratic information event. A positive score forecasts a positive six-bar return because it is the negative of the stock's standardized sector-relative residual return."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _empty_like(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Create a numeric, panel-aligned all-missing result."""
    return pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=frame.index, columns=frame.columns, dtype=float)


def _sector_labels(sector: pd.DataFrame, close: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Extract one static sector label per ticker without assuming first-row coverage."""
    if sector.empty:
        return pd.Series(np.nan, index=close.columns, dtype=object)
    filled = sector.reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).ffill().bfill()
    if filled.empty:
        return pd.Series(np.nan, index=close.columns, dtype=object)
    return filled.iloc[0]


@register_factor
class SectorLiquiditySynchronyImpactRepair(BaseFactor):
    """Sector-relative residual reversal conditioned on synchronized liquidity."""

    factor_id = "sector_liquidity_synchrony_impact_repair"
    name = "Sector Synchrony Residual Reversal"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Negated, volatility-standardized leave-one-out sector residual return, "
        "activated by coherent broad sector turnover and reduced when the stock's "
        "own abnormal volume corroborates an idiosyncratic event."
    )
    window_length = 121
    inputs = ["close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].astype(float)
        volume = data["volume"].astype(float).reindex_like(close)
        sector = data["sector"].reindex_like(close)
        result = _empty_like(close)

        if close.empty:
            return result

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        valid_price = (close > 0.0) & (prior_close > 0.0)
        valid_volume = volume > 0.0
        ret = (close / prior_close - 1.0).where(valid_price).clip(-0.20, 0.20)
        base_eligible = valid_price & valid_volume & ret.notna()

        # AV uses only prior positive raw-volume observations, preserving the
        # intended robustness to level changes without inferring split factors.
        prior_positive_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0).shift(1)
        prior_volume_median = prior_positive_volume.rolling(
            60, min_periods=40
        ).median()
        av = (volume / prior_volume_median).where(valid_volume)
        av = av.where(prior_volume_median > 0.0)
        log_av = np.log(av).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
        core_eligible = base_eligible & av.notna()

        labels = _sector_labels(sector, close)
        usable_labels = labels.dropna()
        if usable_labels.empty:
            return result

        loo_return = _empty_like(close)
        sector_groups: list[tuple[object, list[object]]] = []
        for label in pd.unique(usable_labels):
            columns = list(labels[labels == label].index)
            if columns:
                sector_groups.append((label, columns))

        # Leave-one-out sector returns are calculated independently for every
        # date from contemporaneously eligible peers only.
        for _, columns in sector_groups:
            group_ret = ret.loc[:, columns]
            group_core = core_eligible.loc[:, columns]
            masked_ret = group_ret.where(group_core)
            total_return = masked_ret.sum(axis=1, min_count=1)
            count = group_core.sum(axis=1).astype(float)
            peer_count = count.to_frame().values - group_core.astype(float).values
            numerator = total_return.to_frame().values - group_ret.values
            loo_values = numerator / np.where(peer_count > 0.0, peer_count, np.nan)
            loo = pd.DataFrame(loo_values, index=close.index, columns=columns)
            loo_return.loc[:, columns] = loo.where(group_core & (peer_count >= 7.0))

        # All beta inputs are shifted one bar: beta and residual volatility at
        # t are strictly estimates from t-60 through t-1.
        lagged_ret = ret.shift(1)
        lagged_loo = loo_return.shift(1)
        paired_count = (lagged_ret.notna() & lagged_loo.notna()).rolling(
            60, min_periods=1
        ).sum()
        covariance = lagged_ret.rolling(60, min_periods=40).cov(lagged_loo)
        sector_variance = lagged_loo.rolling(60, min_periods=40).var()
        beta_raw = covariance / sector_variance.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        beta_raw = beta_raw.where(paired_count >= 40.0)
        beta = 0.5 * beta_raw + 0.5

        residual = ret - beta * loo_return
        lagged_residual = residual.shift(1)
        residual_count = lagged_residual.notna().rolling(60, min_periods=1).sum()
        residual_sigma = lagged_residual.rolling(60, min_periods=40).std()
        residual_sigma = residual_sigma.where(residual_count >= 40.0)
        residual_sigma = residual_sigma.where(residual_sigma > 0.0)

        eligible = (
            core_eligible
            & beta_raw.notna()
            & residual.notna()
            & residual_sigma.notna()
        )

        # Sector state is constructed only from names satisfying all individual
        # history requirements. A sector must retain at least eight such names.
        sector_weight = _empty_like(close)
        sector_valid = pd.DataFrame(False, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        for _, columns in sector_groups:
            group_eligible = eligible.loc[:, columns]
            group_count = group_eligible.sum(axis=1)
            enough_names = group_count >= 8

            group_ret = ret.loc[:, columns].where(group_eligible)
            group_av = av.loc[:, columns].where(group_eligible)
            mean_return = group_ret.mean(axis=1)
            mean_abs_return = group_ret.abs().mean(axis=1)
            coherence = mean_return.abs() / mean_abs_return.replace(0.0, np.nan)
            breadth = (group_av > 1.0).sum(axis=1) / group_count.replace(0, np.nan)
            turnover = group_av.median(axis=1)
            dispersion = group_ret.std(axis=1, ddof=1)
            prior_dispersion_median = dispersion.shift(1).rolling(
                60, min_periods=40
            ).median()

            turnover_component = 1.0 - np.exp(
                -np.maximum(np.log(turnover), 0.0)
            )
            state = (
                coherence
                * breadth
                * turnover_component
                / (1.0 + dispersion / prior_dispersion_median.replace(0.0, np.nan))
            )
            state = state.where(
                enough_names
                & prior_dispersion_median.notna()
                & (prior_dispersion_median > 0.0)
            )

            state_values = np.repeat(state.to_numpy()[:, None], len(columns), axis=1)
            sector_weight.loc[:, columns] = state_values
            valid_values = np.repeat(enough_names.to_numpy()[:, None], len(columns), axis=1)
            sector_valid.loc[:, columns] = valid_values

        noncorroboration = np.exp(-np.maximum(log_av, 0.0))
        raw_signal = (
            -(residual / residual_sigma)
            * sector_weight
            * noncorroboration
        ).where(eligible & sector_valid)

        # Cross-sectional winsorization occurs before sector-relative ranking.
        lower = raw_signal.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
        upper = raw_signal.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
        winsorized = raw_signal.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)

        for _, columns in sector_groups:
            group_values = winsorized.loc[:, columns]
            group_mask = eligible.loc[:, columns] & sector_valid.loc[:, columns]
            ranked = group_values.where(group_mask).rank(
                axis=1, method="average", pct=True
            )
            result.loc[:, columns] = (2.0 * ranked - 1.0).where(group_mask)

        return result
programs.name: Sector Synchrony Residual Reversal
programs.trading_idea: Broad, contemporaneous sector participation can create short-lived relative-price pressure even when it does not uniquely identify ETF or benchmark flow. The signal therefore does not infer dealer inventory or classify the common shock as passive flow; it tests the narrower proposition that a stock's sector-beta-adjusted one-day move is more likely to reverse when peers move coherently, sector volume is broadly elevated, and the stock's own volume does not corroborate an idiosyncratic information event. A positive score forecasts a positive six-bar return because it is the negative of the stock's standardized sector-relative residual return.
programs.description:
Use the static `sector` field and form signals only for sectors having at least 8 eligible constituents on the signal date, where an eligible constituent has positive current and prior closes, positive current volume, and at least 40 valid observations in each required trailing 60-bar history. The signal is formed after the close of date t and may be traded no earlier than the next eligible bar's open. Define each stock's close-to-close return as r_i,t = close_i,t / close_i,t-1 - 1, clipped to [-0.20, 0.20] for all beta, sector, coherence, dispersion, and residual calculations. For volume, use the feed-supplied raw `volume` only: no corporate-action-adjusted volume field is available and no split adjustment is inferred. Define AV_i,t = volume_i,t / median(volume_i,t-60,...,volume_i,t-1), requiring at least 40 positive prior-volume observations, then define a_i,t = clip(log(AV_i,t), -3, 3). This rolling-median normalization is deliberately robust to scale changes, while the clipping prevents a possible corporate-action-related volume discontinuity from dominating the factor.

For each stock i, construct its leave-one-out sector return R_-i,t as the equal-weighted mean of clipped returns of all other eligible same-sector names; require at least 7 such peers. Estimate beta_i,t using only bars t-60 through t-1 with at least 40 paired observations: beta_raw = cov(r_i, R_-i) / var(R_-i), where covariance and variance use the ordinary sample estimators and beta_raw is set missing if sector-return variance is zero. Apply fixed shrinkage beta_i,t = 0.5 * beta_raw + 0.5 * 1.0. The current residual is e_i,t = r_i,t - beta_i,t * R_-i,t. Standardize it by sigma_i,t, the sample standard deviation of the same beta-adjusted residual series over t-60 through t-1, requiring at least 40 observations and sigma_i,t > 0.

For each sector s, define abnormal-volume breadth B_s,t as the fraction of eligible constituents with AV_i,t > 1. Define sector turnover intensity T_s,t as the cross-sectional median of AV_i,t. Define return coherence C_s,t = abs(mean(r_i,t)) / mean(abs(r_i,t)) across eligible sector constituents, setting it missing when the denominator is zero. Define return dispersion D_s,t as the cross-sectional sample standard deviation of clipped returns and Dmed_s,t as the median of the prior 60 valid daily D_s values, requiring at least 40 observations and Dmed_s,t > 0. The continuous sector-state weight is W_s,t = C_s,t * B_s,t * [1 - exp(-max(log(T_s,t), 0))] / [1 + D_s,t / Dmed_s,t]. The stock-specific non-corroboration weight is G_i,t = exp(-max(a_i,t, 0)); thus ordinary or below-normal own volume receives weight 1, while unusually high own participation smoothly reduces the reversal score. The raw signal is S_i,t = -[e_i,t / sigma_i,t] * W_s,t * G_i,t.

Each day, winsorize valid raw S values at the cross-sectional 1st and 99th percentiles of the eligible universe. Convert the winsorized values to within-sector percentile ranks, using average ranks for ties, and map them to [-1, 1] as final_score_i,t = 2 * percentile_rank_within_sector(S_i,t) - 1. No same-close execution is assumed. This definition is formula-level distinct from `sector_basket_volume_residual_repair`: it requires a leave-one-out, 60-bar shrunk-beta residual standardized by prior residual volatility and combines continuous coherence, turnover intensity, breadth, dispersion, and own-volume non-corroboration weights. The accepted factor's exact signal definition must not be reused, substituted, or relabeled under this factor id.

programs.code:
"""This is a conditional sector-relative underreaction signal, not an identification claim that synchronized volume is necessarily ETF or basket demand. When turnover surprises are broad and mutually similar across a sector, an individual stock that moves materially less than its trailing-beta-implied sector response may have a temporarily incomplete response; the signal only retains cases where the stock-specific residual has low price impact per unit of abnormal volume, reducing exposure to likely firm-specific information. The distinguishing exposure versus sector_basket_volume_residual_repair is continuous sector-wide volume-surprise homogeneity combined with an explicit low-idiosyncratic-impact information screen, rather than a direct basket-flow interpretation or a generic residual-repair gate."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _leave_one_out_sector_return(
    ret: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Equal-weight leave-one-out sector returns with at least seven peers."""
    ret_values = ret.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    sector_values = sector.to_numpy(dtype=object)
    result = np.full(ret_values.shape, np.nan, dtype=float)

    for t in range(ret_values.shape[0]):
        row_ret = ret_values[t]
        row_sector = sector_values[t]
        groups: dict[object, list[int]] = {}

        for j, label in enumerate(row_sector):
            if pd.isna(label):
                continue
            groups.setdefault(label, []).append(j)

        for members in groups.values():
            member_idx = np.asarray(members, dtype=int)
            values = row_ret[member_idx]
            valid = np.isfinite(values)
            count = int(valid.sum())
            if count < 8:
                continue

            total = values[valid].sum()
            peer_count = count - 1
            valid_idx = member_idx[valid]
            result[t, valid_idx] = (total - row_ret[valid_idx]) / peer_count

    return pd.DataFrame(result, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)


def _prior_volume_location_scale(
    volume: pd.DataFrame, lookback: int
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Trailing t-60..t-1 log-volume median and MAD scale, computed causally."""
    volume_values = volume.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    log_volume = np.full(volume_values.shape, np.nan, dtype=float)
    positive_finite = (volume_values > 0.0) & np.isfinite(volume_values)
    log_volume[positive_finite] = np.log1p(volume_values[positive_finite])

    medians = np.full(volume_values.shape, np.nan, dtype=float)
    scales = np.full(volume_values.shape, np.nan, dtype=float)

    for t in range(volume_values.shape[0]):
        start = max(0, t - lookback)
        history = log_volume[start:t]
        if history.shape[0] == 0:
            continue

        counts = np.isfinite(history).sum(axis=0)
        enough = counts >= 40
        if not enough.any():
            continue

        selected = history[:, enough]
        median = np.nanmedian(selected, axis=0)
        mad = np.nanmedian(np.abs(selected - median[None, :]), axis=0)
        medians[t, enough] = median
        scales[t, enough] = np.maximum(1.4826 * mad, 0.10)

    return (
        pd.DataFrame(medians, index=volume.index, columns=volume.columns),
        pd.DataFrame(scales, index=volume.index, columns=volume.columns),
    )


def _sector_synchronization(
    abnormal_volume: pd.DataFrame,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute B*A*H by current-date sector among eligible names only."""
    a_values = abnormal_volume.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    eligible_values = eligible.to_numpy(dtype=bool)
    sector_values = sector.to_numpy(dtype=object)
    result = np.zeros(a_values.shape, dtype=float)

    for t in range(a_values.shape[0]):
        row_sector = sector_values[t]
        groups: dict[object, list[int]] = {}
        for j, label in enumerate(row_sector):
            if not eligible_values[t, j] or pd.isna(label):
                continue
            groups.setdefault(label, []).append(j)

        for members in groups.values():
            if len(members) < 8:
                continue
            member_idx = np.asarray(members, dtype=int)
            values = a_values[t, member_idx]
            values = values[np.isfinite(values)]
            if values.size < 8:
                continue

            breadth = float(np.mean(values >= 1.0))
            intensity = float(np.mean(np.clip(values, 0.0, 3.0)) / 3.0)
            homogeneity = 1.0 - float(np.clip(np.std(values, ddof=0) / 3.0, 0.0, 1.0))
            result[t, member_idx] = breadth * intensity * homogeneity

    return pd.DataFrame(result, index=abnormal_volume.index, columns=abnormal_volume.columns)


@register_factor
class SectorSynchronyImpactElasticityBridge(BaseFactor):
    """Sector-relative underreaction conditioned on homogeneous volume shocks."""

    factor_id = "sector_synchrony_impact_elasticity_bridge"
    name = "Synchronized Sector Underreaction"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Sector-wide homogeneous abnormal turnover times a beta-adjusted return "
        "deficit, retaining only low-idiosyncratic-impact participation cases."
    )
    window_length = 61
    inputs = ["close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        sector = data["sector"]

        close_valid = close.where(close > 0.0)
        ret = (close_valid / close_valid.shift(1) - 1.0).clip(-0.20, 0.20)
        sector_ret = _leave_one_out_sector_return(ret, sector)

        paired = ret.notna() & sector_ret.notna()
        prior_pair = paired.astype(float).shift(1)
        pair_count = prior_pair.rolling(60, min_periods=1).sum()

        prior_r = ret.where(paired).shift(1)
        prior_sector_r = sector_ret.where(paired).shift(1)
        sum_r = prior_r.rolling(60, min_periods=1).sum()
        sum_sector = prior_sector_r.rolling(60, min_periods=1).sum()
        mean_r = sum_r / pair_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        mean_sector = sum_sector / pair_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        centered_cross = ((prior_r - mean_r) * (prior_sector_r - mean_sector)).rolling(
            60, min_periods=1
        ).sum()
        centered_sector_sq = ((prior_sector_r - mean_sector) ** 2).rolling(
            60, min_periods=1
        ).sum()
        beta = (centered_cross / (centered_sector_sq + 1.0e-6)).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
        beta = beta.where(pair_count >= 40.0)

        sigma = np.sqrt((prior_r ** 2).rolling(60, min_periods=1).sum() / pair_count.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        sigma = sigma.clip(lower=0.005).where(pair_count >= 40.0)

        prior_valid = (ret.notna() & (volume > 0.0) & np.isfinite(volume)).astype(float)
        prior_valid_count = prior_valid.shift(1).rolling(60, min_periods=1).sum()

        volume_median, volume_scale = _prior_volume_location_scale(volume, 60)
        finite_positive_volume = (volume > 0.0) & np.isfinite(volume)
        current_log_volume = np.log1p(volume.where(finite_positive_volume))
        abnormal_volume = ((current_log_volume - volume_median) / volume_scale).clip(-3.0, 3.0)

        base_eligible = (
            sector.notna()
            & (close > 0.0)
            & np.isfinite(close)
            & finite_positive_volume
            & (prior_valid_count >= 40.0)
            & abnormal_volume.notna()
        )
        synchronization = _sector_synchronization(abnormal_volume, base_eligible, sector)

        deficit = beta * sector_ret - ret
        residual = ret - beta * sector_ret
        abnormal_participation = abnormal_volume.clip(lower=0.25)
        impact = (residual.abs() / (sigma * abnormal_participation)).clip(0.0, 5.0)
        retention = 1.0 - impact / 5.0
        normalized_deficit = (deficit / (3.0 * sigma)).clip(-1.0, 1.0)

        valid_score = base_eligible & beta.notna() & sigma.notna() & sector_ret.notna() & ret.notna()
        score = (synchronization * retention * normalized_deficit).where(valid_score, 0.0)
        return score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Synchronized Sector Underreaction
programs.trading_idea: This is a conditional sector-relative underreaction signal, not an identification claim that synchronized volume is necessarily ETF or basket demand. When turnover surprises are broad and mutually similar across a sector, an individual stock that moves materially less than its trailing-beta-implied sector response may have a temporarily incomplete response; the signal only retains cases where the stock-specific residual has low price impact per unit of abnormal volume, reducing exposure to likely firm-specific information. The distinguishing exposure versus sector_basket_volume_residual_repair is continuous sector-wide volume-surprise homogeneity combined with an explicit low-idiosyncratic-impact information screen, rather than a direct basket-flow interpretation or a generic residual-repair gate.
programs.description:
Daily decision is made after the close of day t using only fields through t; positions may first be entered at open[t+1]. The target is the signed return over the fixed six-bar horizon following the decision.

Eligibility at t: ticker i must have a non-null static sector label, positive close[t], positive volume[t], and at least 40 prior valid daily return/volume observations in [t-60,t-1]. A sector is usable only if it has at least 8 eligible names at t. Sector membership is the sector label available at t.

Define clipped close return r[i,u] = clip(close[i,u] / close[i,u-1] - 1, -0.20, 0.20). For each stock and date u, define its leave-one-out sector return Rminus[i,u] as the equal-weight mean of r[j,u] over all valid same-sector peers j != i; it is missing unless at least 7 peers have valid returns. Thus each peer has weight 1 divided by the number of valid peers, and i never mechanically enters its own benchmark.

Estimate beta[i,t] using only paired observations of r[i,u] and Rminus[i,u] in u = t-60,...,t-1. Require at least 40 pairs. Let beta = sum((r-mean(r))*(Rminus-mean(Rminus))) / (sum((Rminus-mean(Rminus))^2) + 1e-6), then clip beta to [-3,3]. Let sigma[i,t] be the square root of the mean of r[i,u]^2 over those same paired observations, floored at 0.005. At t, the beta-adjusted response deficit is D[i,t] = beta[i,t]*Rminus[i,t] - r[i,t]. The contemporaneous idiosyncratic residual is e[i,t] = r[i,t] - beta[i,t]*Rminus[i,t] = -D[i,t].

For volume synchronization, define x[i,u] = log(1 + volume[i,u]). Using only positive-volume observations in [t-60,t-1], compute m[i,t] = median(x[i,u]) and s[i,t] = max(1.4826*median(abs(x[i,u]-m[i,t])), 0.10). Define abnormal-volume score a[i,t] = clip((x[i,t]-m[i,t])/s[i,t], -3, 3). For each eligible sector at t, define breadth B = count(a >= 1)/N, abnormal-volume intensity A = mean(clip(a,0,3))/3, and volume-surprise homogeneity H = 1 - clip(std(a)/3,0,1), where N is the number of eligible names in the sector and std uses population denominator N. The continuous synchronization state is S = B*A*H in [0,1]. Missing a values exclude the name from eligibility; zero or negative current volume makes the ticker ineligible.

To avoid treating a potentially informative firm-specific move as a catch-up opportunity, compute normalized residual impact Q[i,t] = clip(abs(e[i,t]) / (sigma[i,t]*max(a[i,t],0.25)), 0, 5). The impact retention weight is P[i,t] = 1 - Q[i,t]/5. This explicitly penalizes, rather than rewards, unusually large idiosyncratic price movement per unit of abnormal-volume participation. The final score is Score[i,t] = S[sector(i),t] * P[i,t] * clip(D[i,t]/(3*sigma[i,t]), -1, 1). Positive scores predict positive six-bar returns and negative scores predict negative six-bar returns. No quarterly or future data are used; all rolling baselines end at t-1, while the current-day close, return, and volume are observed before the next-open execution.

programs.code:
"""Price-led participation reservoirs released into directional price discovery.

Mechanism: a high-participation compression becomes a credible continuation
setup only when its preceding price-location/volume loop indicates that price
pressure led participation.  A subsequent same-direction range expansion then
marks release of informed, gradually diffused demand rather than a mechanical
volume-led displacement.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _finite_mad(values: np.ndarray) -> float:
    """Median absolute deviation for a trailing finite sample."""
    valid = values[np.isfinite(values)]
    if valid.size < 15:
        return np.nan
    center = np.median(valid)
    return float(np.median(np.abs(valid - center)))


def _abnormal_log_volume(volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal robust volume surprise relative to the preceding 20 bars."""
    clean = volume.where(volume >= 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    logged = np.log1p(clean)
    history = logged.shift(1)
    median = history.rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
    mad = history.rolling(20, min_periods=15).apply(_finite_mad, raw=True)
    scale = (1.4826 * mad).where(mad > 0.0)
    return ((logged - median) / scale).clip(lower=-3.0, upper=3.0)


def _oriented_area(x: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal ten-point closed shoelace area in chronological order."""
    area = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=x.index, columns=x.columns)
    for older_lag in range(9, 0, -1):
        newer_lag = older_lag - 1
        area = area + (
            x.shift(older_lag) * y.shift(newer_lag)
            - x.shift(newer_lag) * y.shift(older_lag)
        )
    area = area + (x * y.shift(9) - x.shift(9) * y)
    return 0.5 * area


@register_factor
class PriceLedReservoirReleaseConfirmation(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "price_led_reservoir_release_confirmation"
    name = "Price-Led Reservoir Release Confirmation"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks signed directional range releases following repeated high-volume, "
        "low-range directional bars, conditional on a directionally aligned "
        "price-led close-location/volume loop in the preceding state."
    )
    window_length = 35
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data["open"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        high = data["high"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        low = data["low"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        bar_valid = (
            open_.gt(0.0)
            & high.gt(0.0)
            & low.gt(0.0)
            & close.gt(0.0)
            & volume.gt(0.0)
            & high.ge(low)
        )
        bar_range = high - low
        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        range_fraction = (bar_range / prior_close).where(
            bar_valid & prior_close.gt(0.0) & bar_range.gt(0.0)
        )
        location = ((2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range).where(
            bar_valid & bar_range.gt(0.0)
        )

        abnormal_volume = _abnormal_log_volume(volume)
        path_valid = location.notna() & abnormal_volume.notna()
        complete_path = path_valid.rolling(10, min_periods=10).sum().eq(10.0)
        area = _oriented_area(location, abnormal_volume)
        endpoint_distance = (
            (location - location.shift(9)) ** 2
            + (abnormal_volume - abnormal_volume.shift(9)) ** 2
        )
        closure = np.exp(-0.5 * endpoint_distance)

        volume_base = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        range_base = range_fraction.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        relative_volume = volume / volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        relative_range = range_fraction / range_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        baseline_valid = (
            volume_base.gt(0.0)
            & range_base.gt(0.0)
            & relative_volume.notna()
            & relative_range.notna()
        )

        reservoir = (
            bar_valid
            & baseline_valid
            & relative_volume.ge(1.50)
            & relative_range.le(0.75)
            & location.abs().ge(0.50)
        )
        signed_reservoir = reservoir.astype(float) * location
        prior_count = reservoir.astype(float).shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        prior_directional_sum = signed_reservoir.shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        direction = np.sign(prior_directional_sum)
        directional_reservoir = (
            prior_count.ge(3.0)
            & direction.ne(0.0)
            & (prior_directional_sum.abs() / prior_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)).ge(0.60)
        )

        release = (
            bar_valid
            & baseline_valid
            & directional_reservoir
            & relative_range.ge(1.50)
            & location.abs().ge(0.50)
            & np.sign(location).eq(direction)
        )

        directional_loop = (
            direction * location.shift(1) * area.shift(1) * closure.shift(1)
        ).where(complete_path.shift(1))
        credibility = directional_loop.clip(lower=0.0, upper=4.0)
        release_strength = (
            (prior_count / 5.0)
            * (prior_directional_sum.abs() / prior_count.replace(0.0, np.nan))
            * relative_range.clip(upper=3.0)
        )
        raw = (direction * release_strength * np.tanh(credibility)).where(release, 0.0)
        raw = raw.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
        return raw.rank(axis=1, pct=True, method="average").fillna(0.5)
programs.name: Price-Led Reservoir Release Confirmation
programs.trading_idea: Directional range releases are more likely to continue when the preceding high-participation compression was part of a price-led participation loop: directional close pressure arrived first and volume followed, consistent with information diffusion rather than mechanical execution. The reservoir pattern alone cannot distinguish informed latent demand from liquidity-driven activity, while loop orientation alone does not identify a decisive price-discovery event. Conditioning the confirmed release on a directionally aligned, closed price-volume loop therefore selects releases where accumulated participation validates rather than merely causes the displacement.
programs.description: Detects repeated high-volume, low-range directional reservoir bars and a subsequent same-direction range release. It ranks the signed release only when the preceding ten-bar close-location/abnormal-volume loop is closed and directionally price-led.

programs.code:
"""This is a conditional short-horizon price-discovery signal rather than a claim that dealer inventory absorption is identified from daily bars. Repeated high-participation, low-range bars with directional close locations indicate that directional trading interest has persisted without proportional daily price movement; a later high-range bar closing in that same direction is treated as confirmation that the earlier price restraint has ended. The empirical prediction is continuation after confirmed directional range release, conditional on the prior compression-and-participation pattern."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_zscore(
    values: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Cross-sectionally z-score releases, using sector groups with >=10 names."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns)

    for row_number, timestamp in enumerate(values.index):
        row = values.iloc[row_number].to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=True)
        labels = sector.iloc[row_number].to_numpy(copy=False)
        eligible = np.isfinite(row)
        eligible_count = int(eligible.sum())
        if eligible_count == 0:
            continue

        full_values = row[eligible]
        full_mean = float(np.mean(full_values))
        full_std = float(np.std(full_values, ddof=0))
        if np.isfinite(full_std) and full_std > 0.0:
            z_row = (row - full_mean) / full_std
        else:
            z_row = np.zeros_like(row, dtype=float)
        z_row[~eligible] = np.nan

        valid_labels = pd.notna(labels)
        for label in pd.unique(labels[eligible & valid_labels]):
            group = eligible & (labels == label)
            group_count = int(group.sum())
            if group_count < 10:
                continue

            group_values = row[group]
            group_mean = float(np.mean(group_values))
            group_std = float(np.std(group_values, ddof=0))
            if np.isfinite(group_std) and group_std > 0.0:
                z_row[group] = (group_values - group_mean) / group_std
            else:
                z_row[group] = 0.0

        output.iloc[row_number] = z_row

    return output


def _decile_dollar_neutral_portfolio(scores: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Select equal-weighted top and bottom score deciles when at least 20 release names exist."""
    portfolio = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=scores.index, columns=scores.columns)

    for row_number in range(len(scores.index)):
        row = scores.iloc[row_number].to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
        eligible_indices = np.flatnonzero(np.isfinite(row))
        count = len(eligible_indices)
        if count < 20:
            continue

        side_size = int(np.floor(0.10 * count))
        if side_size < 1:
            continue

        ordering = np.argsort(row[eligible_indices], kind="mergesort")
        short_indices = eligible_indices[ordering[:side_size]]
        long_indices = eligible_indices[ordering[-side_size:]]

        weights = np.zeros_like(row, dtype=float)
        weights[long_indices] = 1.0 / side_size
        weights[short_indices] = -1.0 / side_size
        portfolio.iloc[row_number] = weights

    return portfolio


@register_factor
class DirectionalAbsorptionReservoirRelease(BaseFactor):
    """Confirmed directional range releases following high-participation compression."""

    factor_id = "directional_absorption_reservoir_release"
    name = "Directional Range-Release Continuation"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Identifies directional reservoirs of high relative volume and low "
        "relative range, then holds a dollar-neutral decile portfolio after a "
        "same-direction high-range release confirms price discovery."
    )
    window_length = 26
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        sector = data["sector"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

        bar_valid = (
            open_.gt(0.0)
            & high.gt(0.0)
            & low.gt(0.0)
            & close.gt(0.0)
            & volume.gt(0.0)
            & high.ge(low)
        )
        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        range_fraction = ((high - low) / previous_close).where(
            bar_valid & previous_close.gt(0.0)
        )
        close_location = (
            2.0 * (close - low) / (high - low) - 1.0
        ).where(high.gt(low), 0.0)
        close_location = close_location.where(bar_valid)

        baseline_volume = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        baseline_range = range_fraction.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        relative_volume = volume / baseline_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        relative_range = range_fraction / baseline_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        current_baseline_valid = (
            baseline_volume.notna()
            & baseline_range.notna()
            & baseline_volume.gt(0.0)
            & baseline_range.gt(0.0)
        )
        candidate_valid = (
            bar_valid
            & current_baseline_valid
            & relative_volume.notna()
            & relative_range.notna()
            & close_location.notna()
        )

        reservoir = (
            candidate_valid
            & relative_volume.ge(1.50)
            & relative_range.le(0.75)
            & close_location.abs().ge(0.50)
        )
        reservoir_value = reservoir.astype(float) * close_location
        reservoir_count = reservoir.astype(float).shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        directional_sum = reservoir_value.shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        all_candidates_valid = (
            candidate_valid.astype(float)
            .shift(1)
            .rolling(5, min_periods=5)
            .sum()
            .eq(5.0)
        )

        direction = np.sign(directional_sum)
        directional_reservoir = (
            all_candidates_valid
            & reservoir_count.ge(3.0)
            & direction.ne(0.0)
            & (directional_sum.abs() / reservoir_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)).ge(0.60)
        )

        dollar_volume = (close * volume).where(bar_valid)
        median_dollar_volume = dollar_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        base_eligible = (
            bar_valid
            & current_baseline_valid
            & median_dollar_volume.notna()
            & median_dollar_volume.gt(0.0)
            & all_candidates_valid
        )
        dollar_volume_rank = median_dollar_volume.where(base_eligible).rank(
            axis=1, pct=True
        )
        liquid_universe = base_eligible & dollar_volume_rank.ge(0.30)

        release = (
            liquid_universe
            & directional_reservoir
            & relative_range.ge(1.50)
            & close_location.abs().ge(0.50)
            & np.sign(close_location).eq(direction)
        )
        reservoir_strength = directional_sum.abs() / reservoir_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        raw = (
            direction
            * (reservoir_count / 5.0)
            * reservoir_strength
            * relative_range.clip(upper=3.0)
        ).where(release)

        lower = raw.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
        upper = raw.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
        winsorized = raw.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0).where(release)
        scores = _sector_zscore(winsorized, sector)
        return _decile_dollar_neutral_portfolio(scores)
programs.name: Directional Range-Release Continuation
programs.trading_idea: This is a conditional short-horizon price-discovery signal rather than a claim that dealer inventory absorption is identified from daily bars. Repeated high-participation, low-range bars with directional close locations indicate that directional trading interest has persisted without proportional daily price movement; a later high-range bar closing in that same direction is treated as confirmation that the earlier price restraint has ended. The empirical prediction is continuation after confirmed directional range release, conditional on the prior compression-and-participation pattern.
programs.description: All quantities are computed separately for stock i at the close of date t using only observations dated t or earlier. Let rnge_q=(high_q-low_q)/close_{q-1}, requiring close_{q-1}>0, and let clv_q=2*(close_q-low_q)/(high_q-low_q)-1 when high_q>low_q; set clv_q=0 for zero-range bars. Define relative volume rv_q=volume_q/median(volume_{q-20},...,volume_{q-1}) and relative range rr_q=rnge_q/median(rnge_{q-20},...,rnge_{q-1}). A prior reservoir bar q is one satisfying rv_q>=1.50, rr_q<=0.75, and abs(clv_q)>=0.50. At t, inspect q in {t-5,...,t-1}. Let N_t be the number of reservoir bars, S_t=sum(reservoir_indicator_q*clv_q), and d_t=sign(S_t). A stock has a valid directional reservoir only if N_t>=3, abs(S_t)/N_t>=0.60, and d_t is nonzero. The current date is a release bar only if rr_t>=1.50, abs(clv_t)>=0.50, and sign(clv_t)=d_t. The raw signed signal is raw_t=d_t*(N_t/5)*(abs(S_t)/N_t)*min(rr_t,3.0) for valid release bars and is missing otherwise; it is not assigned a zero for non-release stocks. This construction uses no future release labeling: the release condition is evaluated on the current bar t itself. Eligibility requires valid positive OHLCV observations, all required 20-bar baseline observations for t and the five reservoir candidates, nonzero baseline median volume and range, and 20-day median dollar volume median(close*volume over t-20 through t-1) in the top 70% of the contemporaneous eligible universe. Missing or invalid observations make the stock ineligible. Each day, winsorize raw_t at the 1st and 99th percentiles among eligible release stocks, then z-score it within sector; sectors with fewer than 10 eligible release stocks use the full eligible-universe z-score instead. Go long the highest-score decile and short the lowest-score decile of eligible release stocks, equal-weighted within side and dollar-neutral; if fewer than 20 eligible release stocks exist, hold no new signal portfolio. The signal is formed after the close of t, and performance is measured from the next bar onward, such as open_{t+1} through close_{t+6}, so no same-bar return is included.

programs.code:
"""This is a conditional sector-relative mean-reversion hypothesis, not an identification of attention-driven information assimilation. When a sector's daily returns are unusually dominated by one common principal-component mode, extreme contemporaneous deviations from that mode may represent temporary relative-price dislocations and revert over the following six trading bars. The hypothesis is deliberately disabled during unusually volatile sector-wide conditions, where PC residuals are more likely to represent heterogeneous exposures, firm-specific news, liquidity stress, or adverse-selection risk rather than temporary dislocations."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_pc_panels(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Compute causal sector-PC residuals, synchronization, and range medians.

    A stock enters a sector PCA only when all returns in its own trailing
    60-observation window are available.  Residuals at every date are computed
    independently using only that date's trailing return history.
    """
    index = close.index
    columns = close.columns
    n_dates = len(index)
    n_assets = len(columns)

    close_values = close.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
    high_values = high.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
    low_values = low.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
    sector_values = sector.to_numpy(dtype=object, copy=False)

    returns_values = np.full((n_dates, n_assets), np.nan, dtype=float)
    if n_dates > 1:
        prior = close_values[:-1]
        current = close_values[1:]
        valid_price = (
            np.isfinite(current)
            & np.isfinite(prior)
            & (prior != 0.0)
        )
        returns_values[1:] = np.where(
            valid_price,
            current / prior - 1.0,
            np.nan,
        )

    residual_values = np.full((n_dates, n_assets), np.nan, dtype=float)
    synchronization_values = np.full((n_dates, n_assets), np.nan, dtype=float)
    range_median_values = np.full((n_dates, n_assets), np.nan, dtype=float)

    for t in range(59, n_dates):
        return_window = returns_values[t - 59 : t + 1]
        complete_history = np.isfinite(return_window).all(axis=0)
        labels = sector_values[t]
        has_label = pd.notna(labels)

        if not np.any(complete_history & has_label):
            continue

        for label in pd.unique(labels[has_label]):
            members = np.flatnonzero((labels == label) & complete_history)
            if members.size < 8:
                continue

            sample = return_window[:, members]
            means = sample.mean(axis=0)
            scales = sample.std(axis=0, ddof=1)
            usable = np.isfinite(scales) & (scales > 0.0)
            members = members[usable]
            if members.size < 8:
                continue

            sample = return_window[:, members]
            means = sample.mean(axis=0)
            scales = sample.std(axis=0, ddof=1)
            standardized = (sample - means) / scales
            correlation = standardized.T @ standardized / 59.0
            correlation = (correlation + correlation.T) * 0.5

            try:
                eigenvalues, eigenvectors = np.linalg.eigh(correlation)
            except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
                continue

            leading_index = int(np.argmax(eigenvalues))
            leading_value = float(eigenvalues[leading_index])
            leading_vector = eigenvectors[:, leading_index]
            current_x = standardized[-1]
            mode_score = float(np.dot(leading_vector, current_x))
            residual_values[t, members] = current_x - leading_vector * mode_score
            synchronization_values[t, members] = leading_value / float(members.size)

            current_close = close_values[t, members]
            current_high = high_values[t, members]
            current_low = low_values[t, members]
            valid_range = (
                np.isfinite(current_close)
                & np.isfinite(current_high)
                & np.isfinite(current_low)
                & (current_close != 0.0)
            )
            if np.any(valid_range):
                ranges = (
                    (current_high[valid_range] - current_low[valid_range])
                    / current_close[valid_range]
                )
                ranges = ranges[np.isfinite(ranges)]
                if ranges.size:
                    range_median_values[t, members] = float(np.median(ranges))

    return (
        pd.DataFrame(residual_values, index=index, columns=columns),
        pd.DataFrame(synchronization_values, index=index, columns=columns),
        pd.DataFrame(range_median_values, index=index, columns=columns),
    )


def _sector_tail_portfolio(
    standardized: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Create equal-gross sector tail portfolios from sector-standardized alpha."""
    index = standardized.index
    columns = standardized.columns
    scores = standardized.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
    labels_values = sector.to_numpy(dtype=object, copy=False)
    output = np.zeros(scores.shape, dtype=float)

    for t in range(len(index)):
        labels = labels_values[t]
        valid_labels = pd.notna(labels)
        if not np.any(valid_labels):
            continue

        for label in pd.unique(labels[valid_labels]):
            members = np.flatnonzero((labels == label) & np.isfinite(scores[t]))
            if members.size == 0:
                continue

            n_side = max(1, int(np.ceil(0.20 * members.size)))
            ordered = members[np.argsort(scores[t, members], kind="mergesort")]
            short_members = ordered[:n_side]
            long_members = ordered[-n_side:]
            output[t, long_members] = 0.5 / float(long_members.size)
            output[t, short_members] = -0.5 / float(short_members.size)

    return pd.DataFrame(output, index=index, columns=columns)


@register_factor
class SectorEigenmodeLaggedAssimilation(BaseFactor):
    """Conditional sector-PC residual-reversion tail portfolio."""

    factor_id = "sector_eigenmode_lagged_assimilation"
    name = "Conditional Sector-PC Residual Reversion"
    category = "statistical_arbitrage"
    description = (
        "Uses trailing sector correlation eigenmodes to identify standardized "
        "return residuals from a dominant common sector mode, then takes "
        "sector-neutral tail positions only in synchronized, non-stressed sectors."
    )
    window_length = 79
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        low = data["low"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        sector = data["sector"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

        residual, synchronization, sector_range = _sector_pc_panels(
            close,
            high,
            low,
            sector,
        )

        residual_volatility = residual.rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()
        raw_alpha = -residual / residual_volatility.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        range_threshold = sector_range.rolling(60, min_periods=60).quantile(0.90)
        active = (
            (synchronization >= 0.30)
            & (sector_range <= range_threshold)
            & np.isfinite(raw_alpha)
        )
        active_alpha = raw_alpha.where(active)

        lower = active_alpha.quantile(0.025, axis=1)
        upper = active_alpha.quantile(0.975, axis=1)
        winsorized = active_alpha.copy()
        for t in range(len(winsorized.index)):
            lo = lower.iloc[t]
            hi = upper.iloc[t]
            if np.isfinite(lo) and np.isfinite(hi):
                winsorized.iloc[t] = winsorized.iloc[t].clip(lower=lo, upper=hi)

        standardized_values = np.full(winsorized.shape, np.nan, dtype=float)
        score_values = winsorized.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
        label_values = sector.to_numpy(dtype=object, copy=False)
