from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor

def _cs_zscore(values: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    lower = values.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
    upper = values.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
    clipped = values.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)
    mean = clipped.mean(axis=1)
    std = clipped.std(axis=1, ddof=0).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return clipped.sub(mean, axis=0).div(std, axis=0)

def _industry_revision_residual(eps_revision: pd.DataFrame, sales_revision: pd.DataFrame, industry: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal same-date industry cross-sectional residual of EPS revision."""
    labels = industry.iloc[0].reindex(eps_revision.columns)
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=eps_revision.index, columns=eps_revision.columns)
    for timestamp in eps_revision.index:
        y = eps_revision.loc[timestamp]
        x = sales_revision.loc[timestamp]
        residual = pd.Series(np.nan, index=eps_revision.columns, dtype=float)
        assigned = pd.Series(False, index=eps_revision.columns)
        for group in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
            cols = labels.index[labels == group]
            valid = y.loc[cols].notna() & x.loc[cols].notna()
            use = valid.index[valid]
            if len(use) < 6:
                continue
            xv = x.loc[use]
            yv = y.loc[use]
            xc = xv - xv.mean()
            denom = float((xc * xc).sum())
            if denom > 0.0:
                beta = float((xc * (yv - yv.mean())).sum() / denom)
                residual.loc[use] = yv - (yv.mean() + beta * xc)
            else:
                residual.loc[use] = yv - yv.mean()
            assigned.loc[use] = True
        fallback = ~assigned & y.notna() & x.notna()
        use = fallback.index[fallback]
        if len(use) >= 12:
            xv = x.loc[use]
            yv = y.loc[use]
            xc = xv - xv.mean()
            denom = float((xc * xc).sum())
            if denom > 0.0:
                beta = float((xc * (yv - yv.mean())).sum() / denom)
                residual.loc[use] = yv - (yv.mean() + beta * xc)
            else:
                residual.loc[use] = yv - yv.mean()
        output.loc[timestamp] = residual
    return output

def _prior_two_day_leg(frame: pd.DataFrame, lag: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Two-session leg ending strictly before the event day."""
    return frame.shift(lag).rolling(2, min_periods=2).sum()

@register_factor
class ConfirmedRevisionAnticipationExhaustionReversal(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = 'confirmed_revision_anticipation_exhaustion_rever'
    name = 'Confirmed Revision Anticipation Exhaustion'
    category = 'mean_reversion'
    description = 'Fades cash-confirmed residual revision news when an aligned pre-report return-volume impact acceleration has already exhausted.'
    window_length = 21
    inputs = ['close', 'volume', 'epsActual', 'revenueActual', 'epsEstimate', 'revenueEstimate', 'epsSurprise', 'revenueSurprise', 'operatingCashFlowGrowth', 'industry']
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data['close']
        volume = data['volume'].reindex_like(close).fillna(0.0)
        safe_close = close.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        ret = safe_close.div(safe_close.shift(1)).sub(1.0)
        ret = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_actual = data['epsActual'].reindex_like(close)
        revenue_actual = data['revenueActual'].reindex_like(close)
        event = eps_actual.notna() & (eps_actual.ne(eps_actual.shift(1)) | eps_actual.shift(1).isna()) | revenue_actual.notna() & (revenue_actual.ne(revenue_actual.shift(1)) | revenue_actual.shift(1).isna())
        eps_est = data['epsEstimate'].reindex_like(close)
        revenue_est = data['revenueEstimate'].reindex_like(close)
        eps_lag = eps_est.shift(21)
        revenue_lag = revenue_est.shift(21)
        valid_revision = eps_est.notna() & eps_lag.notna() & (eps_lag.abs() >= 0.01) & revenue_est.notna() & revenue_lag.notna() & (revenue_lag.abs() >= 1000000.0)
        eps_revision = ((eps_est - eps_lag) / eps_lag.abs()).where(valid_revision)
        sales_revision = ((revenue_est - revenue_lag) / revenue_lag.abs()).where(valid_revision)
        residual_revision = _industry_revision_residual(_cs_zscore(eps_revision), _cs_zscore(sales_revision), data['industry'].reindex_like(close))
        eps_surprise = data['epsSurprise'].reindex_like(close)
        revenue_surprise = data['revenueSurprise'].reindex_like(close)
        cash_growth = data['operatingCashFlowGrowth'].reindex_like(close)
        eps_scaled = eps_surprise.div(eps_est.abs().clip(lower=0.05))
        revenue_scaled = revenue_surprise.div(revenue_est.abs().clip(lower=1000000.0))
        eps_z = _cs_zscore(eps_scaled.where(event))
        revenue_z = _cs_zscore(revenue_scaled.where(event))
        cash_z = _cs_zscore(cash_growth.where(event))
        positive = (eps_z > 0.0) & (revenue_z > 0.0) & (cash_z > 0.0)
        negative = (eps_z < 0.0) & (revenue_z < 0.0) & (cash_z < 0.0)
        news_sign = positive.astype(float) - negative.astype(float)
        confirmation_strength = np.minimum(np.minimum(eps_z.abs(), revenue_z.abs()), cash_z.abs())
        credible_news = news_sign * residual_revision > 0.0
        sigma = np.sqrt(ret.pow(2).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean())
        rel_volume = volume.div(volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan))
        participation = np.sign(ret) * rel_volume
        mature = ret.shift(1).rolling(12, min_periods=12).sum().div(np.sqrt(12.0) * sigma.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        pre_direction = np.sign(mature)
        old_ret = _prior_two_day_leg(ret, 5)
        mid_ret = _prior_two_day_leg(ret, 3)
        late_ret = _prior_two_day_leg(ret, 1)
        old_part = _prior_two_day_leg(participation, 5)
        mid_part = _prior_two_day_leg(participation, 3)
        late_part = _prior_two_day_leg(participation, 1)
        old_impact = (pre_direction * old_ret / sigma).div((pre_direction * old_part).replace(0.0, np.nan))
        mid_impact = (pre_direction * mid_ret / sigma).div((pre_direction * mid_part).replace(0.0, np.nan))
        late_impact = (pre_direction * late_ret / sigma).div((pre_direction * late_part).replace(0.0, np.nan))
        convexity = (mid_impact - old_impact).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        aligned_legs = (pre_direction * old_ret > 0.0) & (pre_direction * mid_ret > 0.0) & (pre_direction * late_ret > 0.0) & (pre_direction * old_part > 0.0) & (pre_direction * mid_part > 0.0) & (pre_direction * late_part > 0.0)
        mature_run = rank(mature.abs()) >= 0.75
        convex_rank = rank(convexity.where(aligned_legs & mature_run))
        exhausted = late_impact < mid_impact
        anticipation_state = aligned_legs & mature_run & (convex_rank >= 0.75) & exhausted & (pre_direction == news_sign)
        score = (-news_sign * confirmation_strength * convex_rank).where(event & credible_news & anticipation_state)
        return rank(score).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Confirmed Revision Anticipation Exhaustion
programs.trading_idea: A cash-confirmed, industry-residual analyst revision identifies a credible earnings-information direction, while the pre-report return-volume impact path identifies whether that direction has already been aggressively anticipated. When an aligned pre-event run displayed accelerating impact but then a weakening final response to participation, the report acts as a buy-the-rumor/sell-the-fact resolution catalyst: marginal informed demand is exhausted and late attention-driven positioning must unwind. Neither parent alone distinguishes a credible disclosure from an already crowded anticipatory move; their interaction isolates credible news arriving after the market has consumed its liquidity and attention buffer.
programs.description: The signal detects report-date EPS, revenue, and operating-cash-flow confirmation of an industry-residual EPS-estimate revision, then selects names with an aligned mature pre-event return-volume impact convexity that has just exhausted. It ranks the expected reversal against the confirmed-news direction.

"""Sector-flow catch-up conditioned on transient basket execution residuals."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank


def _static_labels(sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Obtain one static sector label per ticker."""
    if sector.empty:
        return pd.Series(index=sector.columns, dtype=object)
    labels = sector.ffill().bfill().iloc[-1].astype(object)
    fallback = pd.Series(
        ["__missing_" + str(col) for col in sector.columns],
        index=sector.columns,
        dtype=object,
    )
    return labels.where(labels.notna(), fallback)


def _sector_median(frame: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series, minimum: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Same-date sector median, returned in the original panel layout."""
    out = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=frame.index, columns=frame.columns)
    for group in labels.unique():
        cols = labels[labels == group].index
        if len(cols) < minimum:
            continue
        block = frame.loc[:, cols]
        med = block.median(axis=1).where(block.notna().sum(axis=1) >= minimum)
        out.loc[:, cols] = np.repeat(med.to_numpy()[:, None], len(cols), axis=1)
    return out


def _leave_one_out_sector_mean(ret: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Winsorized leave-one-out sector return, avoiding own-return contamination."""
    out = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)
    for group in labels.unique():
        cols = labels[labels == group].index
        if len(cols) < 5:
            continue
        block = ret.loc[:, cols]
        lo = block.quantile(0.10, axis=1)
        hi = block.quantile(0.90, axis=1)
        clipped = block.clip(lower=lo, upper=hi, axis=0)
        count = clipped.notna().sum(axis=1)
        total = clipped.sum(axis=1, skipna=True)
        for col in cols:
            own = clipped[col]
            others = count - own.notna().astype(float)
            loo = (total - own.fillna(0.0)) / others.replace(0.0, np.nan)
            out[col] = loo.where(others >= 4)
    return out


def _trailing_beta(y: pd.DataFrame, x: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal rolling beta estimated only from returns available before today."""
    yy = y.shift(1)
    xx = x.shift(1)
    paired = yy.notna() & xx.notna()
    yy = yy.where(paired)
    xx = xx.where(paired)
    count = paired.astype(float).rolling(40, min_periods=30).sum()
    sx = xx.rolling(40, min_periods=30).sum()
    sy = yy.rolling(40, min_periods=30).sum()
    sxx = (xx * xx).rolling(40, min_periods=30).sum()
    sxy = (xx * yy).rolling(40, min_periods=30).sum()
    cov = sxy - sx * sy / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    var = sxx - sx * sx / count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return (cov / var.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.1, upper=2.5)


@register_factor
class SectorHandoffBasketResidualConvergence(BaseFactor):
    """Repair an idiosyncratic basket residual only when it deepens an unpaid sector catch-up."""

    factor_id = "sector_handoff_basket_residual_convergence"
    name = "Sector Handoff Residual Convergence"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Sector-relative intraday execution residual reversal conditioned on a "
        "prior weak-participation sector lag, normalized participation, and broad "
        "sector abnormal turnover."
    )
    window_length = 42
    inputs = ["open", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        open_ = data["open"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        labels = _static_labels(data["sector"].reindex(columns=close.columns))

        prev_close = close.shift(1)
        ret = close / prev_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        ret = ret.where((close > 0.0) & (prev_close > 0.0))
        sector_mode = _leave_one_out_sector_mean(ret, labels)
        beta = _trailing_beta(ret, sector_mode)

        safe_open = open_.where(open_ > 0.0)
        intraday = np.log(close.where(close > 0.0) / safe_open)
        sector_intraday = _sector_median(intraday, labels, 4)
        idio_residual = intraday - sector_intraday

        valid_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0)
        own_baseline = valid_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        volume_ratio = (valid_volume / own_baseline.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.05, 20.0)
        sector_ratio = _sector_median(volume_ratio, labels, 4)
        relative_participation = volume_ratio / sector_ratio.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        log_volume = np.log1p(valid_volume)
        hist = log_volume.shift(1)
        vol_mean = hist.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
        vol_std = hist.rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()
        abnormal_volume = (log_volume - vol_mean) / vol_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        abnormal_volume = abnormal_volume.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        sector_abnormal = _sector_median(abnormal_volume, labels, 4)
        sector_breadth = _sector_median(abnormal_volume.gt(0.0).astype(float), labels, 4)
        broad_basket = (sector_abnormal >= 0.15) & (sector_breadth >= 0.60)

        mode_lag = sector_mode.shift(1)
        stock_lag = ret.shift(1)
        initial_gap = beta * mode_lag - stock_lag
        response_gap = beta * (mode_lag + sector_mode) - (stock_lag + ret)
        mode_scale = sector_mode.shift(2).abs().rolling(40, min_periods=30).median()
        meaningful_mode = mode_lag.abs() >= 1.25 * mode_scale
        persistent_mode = (sector_mode * mode_lag > 0.0) & (sector_mode.abs() >= 0.20 * mode_scale)

        handoff = (
            (relative_participation.shift(1) <= 0.80)
            & (relative_participation >= 1.00)
            & (relative_participation > relative_participation.shift(1))
        )
        unpaid = (
            (initial_gap * mode_lag > 0.0)
            & (response_gap * mode_lag > 0.0)
        )

        repair = -idio_residual
        agreement = repair * response_gap > 0.0
        idio_scale = intraday.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()
        ret_scale = ret.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()
        normalized_repair = repair / idio_scale.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        gap_strength = (response_gap.abs() / ret_scale.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(upper=3.0)

        dollar_volume = (close * valid_volume).where(close > 0.0)
        liquidity = dollar_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        liquid = liquidity.ge(liquidity.quantile(0.20, axis=1), axis=0)

        eligible = (
            broad_basket
            & handoff
            & unpaid
            & meaningful_mode
            & persistent_mode
            & agreement
            & liquid
            & beta.notna()
        )
        score = (normalized_repair * gap_strength).where(eligible)
        return rank(score).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Sector Handoff Residual Convergence
programs.trading_idea: Broad sector turnover identifies synchronized basket execution, but an individual residual is not automatically reversible when it reflects genuine information. The child activates residual repair only for stocks that were previously under-responsive to an ongoing sector move on weak relative participation and whose participation has now normalized: a same-day idiosyncratic residual in the direction of further under-response is interpreted as temporary execution pressure layered on top of an unpaid sector-flow catch-up. Parent A supplies the directional common-flow debt, while Parent B identifies the transient stock-specific execution distortion; their agreement produces a near-term convergence trade neither a generic basket reversal nor a standalone sector-lag signal can isolate.
programs.description: Computes a beta-adjusted two-day sector response gap and requires a weak-to-normal relative-volume handoff during a broad sector abnormal-volume event. It ranks the reversal of the stock's sector-relative intraday residual only when that reversal direction agrees with the remaining sector response gap.

"""A large daily price displacement on volume that is low relative to the stock's own recent volume and range history is treated as a weak-resiliency event rather than a direct observation of displayed order-book depth. Continuation is hypothesized only when the displacement closes decisively in its direction and occurs amid elevated recent instability in this relative depth measure, conditions intended to identify persistent liquidity-supply withdrawal rather than a routine, well-cleared information event. The signal is explicitly a conditional short-horizon continuation hypothesis and must be evaluated after next-bar execution costs and capacity constraints."""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor

def _relative_depth_instability_score(close: pd.DataFrame, high: pd.DataFrame, low: pd.DataFrame, volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Construct the causal relative-depth shock score before cross-sectional scaling."""
    previous_close = close.shift(1)
    bar_range = high - low
    normalized_range = bar_range / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    finite_close = np.isfinite(close)
    finite_previous_close = np.isfinite(previous_close)
    finite_high = np.isfinite(high)
    finite_low = np.isfinite(low)
    finite_volume = np.isfinite(volume)
    finite_range = np.isfinite(normalized_range)
    volume_valid = finite_volume & volume.gt(0.0)
    range_valid = finite_previous_close & previous_close.gt(0.0) & finite_high & finite_low & high.gt(low) & finite_range & normalized_range.gt(0.0)
    valid_volume = volume.where(volume_valid)
    valid_range = normalized_range.where(range_valid)
    volume_base = valid_volume.shift(1).rolling(21, min_periods=1).median()
    range_base = valid_range.shift(1).rolling(21, min_periods=1).median()
    volume_count = volume_valid.astype(float).shift(1).rolling(22, min_periods=1).sum()
    range_count = range_valid.astype(float).shift(1).rolling(19, min_periods=1).sum()
    eligible = finite_close & finite_previous_close & previous_close.gt(0.0) & volume_valid & range_valid & volume_count.ge(15.0) & range_count.ge(15.0) & np.isfinite(volume_base) & np.isfinite(range_base) & volume_base.gt(0.0) & range_base.gt(0.0)
    relative_depth = volume / volume_base / (normalized_range / range_base.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    depth_valid = eligible & np.isfinite(relative_depth) & relative_depth.gt(0.0)
    log_depth = np.log(relative_depth.where(depth_valid))
    instability = log_depth.rolling(11, min_periods=8).std()
    close_location = 2.0 * (close - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
    signed_return = np.sign(close / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0)
    directional_alignment = (signed_return * close_location).clip(lower=0.0)
    confirmation = signed_return * directional_alignment
    shock_strength = (-log_depth).clip(lower=0.0)
    raw = shock_strength * instability * confirmation
    raw = raw.where(eligible & np.isfinite(instability) & np.isfinite(raw))
    return raw

@register_factor
class RelativeDepthShockContinuation(BaseFactor):
    """Conditional continuation after unstable relative-depth withdrawal shocks."""
    factor_id = 'depth_proxy_instability_jump_continuation_j'
    name = 'Relative Depth Shock Continuation'
    category = 'microstructure'
    description = 'Cross-sectionally winsorized and standardized conditional continuation signal for decisive price moves occurring on unusually low relative depth amid unstable recent liquidity conditions.'
    window_length = 21
    inputs = ['close', 'high', 'low', 'volume']
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data['close']
        raw = _relative_depth_instability_score(close, data['high'], data['low'], data['volume'])
        lower = raw.quantile(0.05, axis=1)
        upper = raw.quantile(0.95, axis=1)
        winsorized = raw.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)
        cross_mean = winsorized.mean(axis=1)
        cross_std = winsorized.std(axis=1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        standardized = winsorized.sub(cross_mean, axis=0).div(cross_std, axis=0)
        return standardized.where(np.isfinite(standardized))
programs.name: Relative Depth Shock Continuation (jitter)
programs.trading_idea: A large daily price displacement on volume that is low relative to the stock's own recent volume and range history is treated as a weak-resiliency event rather than a direct observation of displayed order-book depth. Continuation is hypothesized only when the displacement closes decisively in its direction and occurs amid elevated recent instability in this relative depth measure, conditions intended to identify persistent liquidity-supply withdrawal rather than a routine, well-cleared information event. The signal is explicitly a conditional short-horizon continuation hypothesis and must be evaluated after next-bar execution costs and capacity constraints.
programs.description: At the completion of day t, define normalized range r_t = (high_t - low_t) / close_{t-1}. A stock is eligible only when close_{t-1} > 0, high_t > low_t, volume_t > 0, and at least 15 valid observations exist in each of the prior 20 completed daily bars. Let Vbase_t and Rbase_t be the medians of valid volume and normalized range, respectively, over days t-20 through t-1. Define relative depth q_t = (volume_t / Vbase_t) / (r_t / Rbase_t) and log relative depth d_t = log(q_t); observations with nonpositive or nonfinite inputs, including zero range, are missing rather than imputed. Define depth-shock strength D_t = max(0, -d_t), so unusually low volume relative to an unusually large range receives a positive value. Define instability I_t as the sample standard deviation of d over days t-9 through t, requiring at least 8 valid observations. Define close location CLV_t = 2 * (close_t - low_t) / (high_t - low_t) - 1 and signed return sign_t = sign(close_t / close_{t-1} - 1). Define directional-extreme confirmation A_t = sign_t * max(0, sign_t * CLV_t), which is positive for an upward return closing near the high, negative for a downward return closing near the low, and zero when return direction and close location disagree. The raw score is S_t = D_t * I_t * A_t. Each day, winsorize S_t cross-sectionally at the 5th and 95th percentiles among eligible stocks, then standardize it by the same-day cross-sectional mean and standard deviation; this standardized value is the factor. The signal is formed only after all OHLCV information for day t is complete, entered no earlier than the next executable bar/session (for example, day t+1 open), and evaluated over the fixed six-bar horizon measured from that entry.

"""Reversal after a mature idiosyncratic arrival depletes relative depth.

A prior rare, sector-idiosyncratic signed-volume arrival represents an already
revealed directional-information state.  When a later same-direction bar moves
far on unusually little relative depth, the move is interpreted as terminal
liquidity depletion rather than fresh information and is faded.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _reset_ewma(mark: pd.DataFrame, alpha: float) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal EWMA that resets after missing observations rather than bridging gaps."""
    values = mark.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
    n_rows, n_cols = values.shape
    out = np.full((n_rows, n_cols), np.nan, dtype=float)
    state = np.zeros(n_cols, dtype=float)
    active = np.zeros(n_cols, dtype=bool)

    for t in range(n_rows):
        x = values[t]
        valid = np.isfinite(x)
        continuing = valid & active
        starting = valid & ~active
        state[continuing] = (1.0 - alpha) * state[continuing] + alpha * x[continuing]
        state[starting] = alpha * x[starting]
        out[t, valid] = state[valid]
        active = valid

    return pd.DataFrame(out, index=mark.index, columns=mark.columns)


def _sector_residual(
    value: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Same-day sector-median residual, requiring a minimally broad peer set."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=value.index, columns=value.columns, dtype=float)
    for t in range(len(value.index)):
        row = value.iloc[t]
        groups = sector.iloc[t]
        usable = row.where(row.notna() & groups.notna())
        median = usable.groupby(groups).transform("median")
        count = usable.notna().groupby(groups).transform("sum")
        result.iloc[t] = (usable - median).where(count >= 5)
    return result


@register_factor
class MatureArrivalDepthDepletionReversal(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "mature_arrival_depth_depletion_reversal"
    name = "Mature Arrival Depth-Depletion Reversal"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Fades a decisive low-relative-depth displacement only when it aligns "
        "with a decayed prior rare signed-volume arrival that is idiosyncratic "
        "to the stock's sector."
    )
    window_length = 81
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        sector = data["sector"]

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        bar_range = high - low
        valid_price = (
            np.isfinite(close)
            & np.isfinite(prior_close)
            & np.isfinite(high)
            & np.isfinite(low)
            & close.gt(0.0)
            & prior_close.gt(0.0)
            & high.gt(low)
        )
        valid_bar = valid_price & np.isfinite(volume) & volume.gt(0.0)

        positive_volume = volume.where(volume.gt(0.0) & np.isfinite(volume))
        prior_vol_median = positive_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).median().shift(1)
        q = volume / prior_vol_median.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        q95 = q.rolling(60, min_periods=45).quantile(0.95).shift(1)

        close_location = (
            (2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        ).clip(lower=-1.0, upper=1.0)
        direction = np.sign(close / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0)

        rare = valid_bar & np.isfinite(q) & np.isfinite(q95) & q.ge(q95)
        arrival_mark = (
            direction
            * close_location.abs()
            * np.log(q.clip(lower=1.0, upper=6.0))
        )
        # Valid ordinary bars decay the state; invalid bars reset it.
        arrival_input = pd.DataFrame(
            np.where(valid_bar, 0.0, np.nan), index=close.index, columns=close.columns
        )
        arrival_input = arrival_input.where(~rare, arrival_mark)
        prior_arrival_state = _reset_ewma(arrival_input, 0.18).shift(1)
        idio_arrival = _sector_residual(prior_arrival_state, sector)

        normalized_range = bar_range / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        valid_range = valid_bar & np.isfinite(normalized_range) & normalized_range.gt(0.0)
        range_base = normalized_range.where(valid_range).shift(1).rolling(
            20, min_periods=15
        ).median()
        volume_base = positive_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()

        relative_depth = (volume / volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)) / (
            normalized_range / range_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        valid_depth = (
            valid_range
            & np.isfinite(relative_depth)
            & relative_depth.gt(0.0)
            & np.isfinite(range_base)
            & range_base.gt(0.0)
            & np.isfinite(volume_base)
            & volume_base.gt(0.0)
        )
        log_depth = np.log(relative_depth.where(valid_depth))
        instability = log_depth.rolling(10, min_periods=8).std()
        depletion = (-log_depth).clip(lower=0.0)

        decisive_alignment = (direction * close_location).clip(lower=0.0)
        same_direction_maturity = (direction * idio_arrival).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)

        # Negative current direction is deliberately used: mature, aligned thin
        # moves are inventory/depth exhaustion and are expected to mean-revert.
        raw = (
            -direction
            * depletion
            * instability
            * decisive_alignment
            * same_direction_maturity
        )
        eligible = (
            valid_depth
            & np.isfinite(instability)
            & np.isfinite(idio_arrival)
            & sector.notna()
            & np.isfinite(raw)
        )
        raw = raw.where(eligible)

        signal = raw.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        return signal.where(np.isfinite(signal))
programs.name: Mature Arrival Depth-Depletion Reversal
programs.trading_idea: A rare, sector-idiosyncratic high-volume directional arrival is treated as a state variable indicating that information has already been revealed and one-sided trading has recently consumed liquidity. A subsequent same-direction displacement on unusually thin relative depth is therefore more likely a terminal liquidity concession or inventory-driven overshoot than a new information event, and should reverse over the fixed six-bar horizon. Weak-depth shocks alone confound fresh news with exhaustion, while abnormal-volume arrivals alone do not identify whether the later move is occurring into depleted rather than replenished liquidity.
programs.description: The factor forms a decayed, sector-idiosyncratic state from prior rare signed abnormal-volume arrivals, then conditions a current decisive low-relative-depth shock on alignment with that prior state. It ranks the opposite of the aligned shock direction, favoring reversal after mature directional flow encounters depleted liquidity.

"""The hypothesis is not that daily range directly identifies order-book depth, but that a stock-specific jump in realized price impact becomes informative when it coincides with two consecutive same-sided close-location signals under ordinary, rather than extreme, turnover. This combination is a falsifiable proxy for a persistent execution imbalance: a one-day information repricing need not produce repeated directional closing pressure, whereas a constrained buyer or seller working through reduced liquidity should. The prediction is directional continuation over the next six daily bars only when the current impact-elasticity shock is above both the stock's own recent history and its sector's contemporaneous state."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _winsorized_cross_sectional_impact(
    impact: pd.DataFrame, eligible: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Winsorize eligible daily impacts only when at least 20 names qualify."""
    masked = impact.where(eligible)
    eligible_count = masked.notna().sum(axis=1)
    lower = masked.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
    upper = masked.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
    winsorized = masked.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)
    return winsorized.where(eligible_count.ge(20), axis=0)


def _sector_residual(
    values: pd.DataFrame, sectors: pd.Series
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Return contemporaneous sector-median residuals and valid group counts."""
    groups = sectors.reindex(values.columns)
    transposed = values.T
    sector_median = transposed.groupby(groups, sort=False).transform("median").T
    sector_count = (
        values.notna()
        .astype(float)
        .T.groupby(groups, sort=False)
        .transform("sum")
        .T
    )
    return values - sector_median, sector_count


@register_factor
class IdiosyncraticDepthWithdrawalDirectionalCarry(BaseFactor):
    """Directional carry from idiosyncratic impact acceleration and persistent close pressure."""

    factor_id = "idiosyncratic_depth_withdrawal_directional_carry"
    name = "Persistent Directional Impact-Acceleration Carry"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks directional close-location pressure when normalized range impact "
        "is elevated versus both the stock's trailing impact distribution and "
        "its contemporaneous sector, subject to ordinary-turnover filters."
    )
    window_length = 21
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume", "sharesOutstanding", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        shares = data["sharesOutstanding"]

        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        bar_range = high - low
        safe_shares = shares.where(shares.gt(0))
        turnover = volume / safe_shares

        clv_valid = (
            close.gt(0)
            & high.notna()
            & low.notna()
            & volume.gt(0)
            & shares.gt(0)
            & high.gt(low)
            & turnover.ge(0.001)
            & turnover.le(0.10)
        )
        close_location = ((2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        close_location = close_location.clip(lower=-1.0, upper=1.0).where(clv_valid)

        impact_eligible = clv_valid & previous_close.gt(0)
        normalized_range = bar_range / previous_close.where(previous_close.gt(0))
        impact = normalized_range / np.sqrt(turnover.where(turnover.gt(0)))
        impact = impact.where(impact_eligible)

        winsorized_impact = _winsorized_cross_sectional_impact(impact, impact_eligible)

        prior_impacts = winsorized_impact.shift(1)
        history_count = prior_impacts.rolling(20, min_periods=15).count()
        history_median = prior_impacts.rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        acceleration = np.log(
            winsorized_impact / history_median.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        ).where(history_count.ge(15))

        # Sector is static in this feed; forward fill handles sparse static labels.
        sector_labels = data["sector"].ffill().iloc[-1]
        sector_residual, sector_count = _sector_residual(acceleration, sector_labels)
        sector_residual = sector_residual.where(sector_count.ge(5))

        prior_direction_valid = clv_valid.shift(1).fillna(False)
        directional_persistence = (
            close_location.abs().ge(0.5)
            & close_location.shift(1).abs().ge(0.5)
            & close_location.mul(close_location.shift(1)).gt(0)
            & prior_direction_valid
        )

        raw_score = (
            close_location * sector_residual.clip(lower=0.0)
        ).where(directional_persistence & sector_residual.notna(), 0.0)
        raw_score = raw_score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)

        # Rank only active observations while retaining the economically meaningful sign.
        active = raw_score.ne(0.0)
        magnitude_rank = raw_score.abs().where(active).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        signal = (np.sign(raw_score) * magnitude_rank).where(active, 0.0)
        return signal.reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).astype(float)

This combination is a falsifiable proxy for a persistent execution imbalance: a one-day information repricing need not produce repeated directional closing pressure, whereas a constrained buyer or seller working through reduced liquidity should. The prediction is directional continuation over the next six daily bars only when the current impact-elasticity shock is above both the stock's own recent history and its sector's contemporaneous state.
programs.description: Form the signal after the close of day t and enter no earlier than the next executable bar's open. For each stock, require positive non-missing close(t-1), high(t), low(t), close(t), volume(t), and sharesOutstanding(t), with high(t) > low(t), volume(t) > 0, sharesOutstanding(t) > 0, and turnover TO(t)=volume(t)/sharesOutstanding(t) in [0.001, 0.10]. Define signed close location CLV(t)=(2*close(t)-high(t)-low(t))/(high(t)-low(t)), bounded to [-1,1], and normalized range R(t)=(high(t)-low(t))/close(t-1). Define raw impact elasticity I(t)=R(t)/sqrt(TO(t)). On each date, winsorize I(t) to the 1st and 99th percentiles across all eligible stocks; if fewer than 20 eligible stocks exist, assign no signal that date. For each stock, require at least 15 valid winsorized I observations in days t-20 through t-1 and define A(t)=log(Iwins(t)/median(Iwins(t-20:t-1))). Compute the sector residual E(t)=A(t)-median(A(t)) among eligible stocks in the same sector, requiring at least 5 valid stocks in that sector. Require the prior day also to have valid CLV and ordinary turnover, with abs(CLV(t)) >= 0.5, abs(CLV(t-1)) >= 0.5, and CLV(t)*CLV(t-1) > 0. The raw score is CLV(t)*max(E(t),0) when all conditions hold, and zero otherwise; missing, zero-range, zero-volume, invalid-share, or failed-universe observations receive no signal. Positive scores indicate long candidates and negative scores indicate short candidates; portfolio construction should cross-sectionally rank the nonzero scores after the close and execute at the next bar, never at the signal-day close.

"""Delayed coherent-disclosure liquidity-loop assimilation signal.

Mechanism: coherent dual earnings disclosures provide a fundamental direction, but
same-day announcement absorption is often a short-lived reaction.  A delayed,
directionally agreeing price-volume loop is interpreted as continuing information
transmission and is amplified only during the post-announcement assimilation window.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _report_updates(fields: list[pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causally identify first observations and subsequent report updates."""
    event = pd.DataFrame(False, index=fields[0].index, columns=fields[0].columns)
    for field in fields:
        clean = field.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        prior = clean.shift(1)
        event = event | (clean.notna() & (prior.isna() | clean.ne(prior)))
    return event


def _event_snapshot(value: pd.DataFrame, event: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Carry the latest report-date observation forward without averaging filings."""
    return value.where(event).ffill()


def _abnormal_log_volume(volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Prior-window standardized participation, excluding the current bar from baseline."""
    clean = volume.where(volume > 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    log_volume = np.log1p(clean)
    prior = log_volume.shift(1)
    mean = prior.rolling(18, min_periods=10).mean()
    scale = prior.rolling(18, min_periods=10).std().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return ((log_volume - mean) / scale).clip(-3.0, 3.0).fillna(0.0)


def _oriented_loop(x: pd.DataFrame, y: pd.DataFrame, length: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Trailing polygonal signed area of the pressure-participation path."""
    area = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=x.index, columns=x.columns)
    for lag in range(length - 1, 0, -1):
        area = area + (
            x.shift(lag).fillna(0.0) * y.shift(lag - 1).fillna(0.0)
            - x.shift(lag - 1).fillna(0.0) * y.shift(lag).fillna(0.0)
        )
    area = area + (
        x.fillna(0.0) * y.shift(length - 1).fillna(0.0)
        - x.shift(length - 1).fillna(0.0) * y.fillna(0.0)
    )
    return 0.5 * area


@register_factor
class CoherentDisclosureDelayedLoopFilter(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "coherent_disclosure_delayed_loop_filter"
    name = "Delayed Disclosure Loop Filter"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks price-location and abnormal-volume loop transmission, amplified "
        "only by coherent dual earnings/revenue disclosures during their delayed "
        "post-event assimilation window."
    )
    window_length = 28
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "volume",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        high = data["high"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        low = data["low"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        bar_range = high - low
        pressure = (2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        pressure = pressure.where(bar_range > 0.0).clip(-1.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)
        abnormal_volume = _abnormal_log_volume(volume)

        area = _oriented_loop(pressure, abnormal_volume, 9)
        endpoint_distance = (
            (pressure - pressure.shift(8).fillna(pressure)).pow(2)
            + (abnormal_volume - abnormal_volume.shift(8).fillna(abnormal_volume)).pow(2)
        )
        closure = np.exp(-0.5 * endpoint_distance).fillna(0.0)
        loop_signal = pressure * np.tanh(area / 4.0) * closure

        eps_surprise = data["epsSurprise"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue_surprise = data["revenueSurprise"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        event = _report_updates([
            data["epsActual"],
            data["revenueActual"],
            eps_surprise,
            revenue_surprise,
        ])

        eps_s = _event_snapshot(eps_surprise, event)
        rev_s = _event_snapshot(revenue_surprise, event)
        eps_e = _event_snapshot(eps_estimate, event)
        rev_e = _event_snapshot(revenue_estimate, event)

        eps_scale = eps_e.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        rev_scale = rev_e.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        eps_z = np.tanh(eps_s / eps_scale)
        rev_z = np.tanh(rev_s / rev_scale)
        agreement = eps_z.mul(rev_z).gt(0.0)
        direction = np.sign(eps_z + rev_z).fillna(0.0)
        magnitude = np.sqrt(eps_z.abs() * rev_z.abs())
        balance = (
            2.0 * eps_z.abs().combine(rev_z.abs(), np.minimum)
            / (eps_z.abs() + rev_z.abs()).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        coherence = (magnitude * balance).where(agreement, 0.0).fillna(0.0)

        positions = np.arange(len(close.index), dtype=float)[:, None]
        position_frame = pd.DataFrame(
            np.repeat(positions, close.shape[1], axis=1),
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        )
        event_position = position_frame.where(event).ffill()
        event_age = position_frame - event_position
        delayed_window = event_age.ge(2.0) & event_age.le(10.0)
        freshness = np.exp(-(event_age - 2.0).clip(lower=0.0) / 5.0).where(
            delayed_window, 0.0
        ).fillna(0.0)

        directional_agreement = (direction * pressure).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        amplification = 1.0 + 1.35 * coherence * freshness * directional_agreement
        raw_score = (loop_signal * amplification).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        raw_score = raw_score.fillna(0.0)
        return raw_score.rank(axis=1, ascending=True, pct=True, method="average")

The child therefore uses Parent A's price-location/abnormal-volume circulation as the tradable transmission state, while allowing only a fresh-but-not-immediate coherent disclosure to amplify loops whose current close pressure agrees with the disclosure direction. This interaction isolates delayed information diffusion after the noisy first reaction: the surprise alone does not identify whether the market is still transmitting it, while the liquidity loop alone cannot distinguish informed continuation from transient execution flow.

"""The revised mechanism is post-earnings-announcement drift rather than an inference from an OHLC path. A newly available positive earnings surprise can be incorporated gradually because investors update heterogeneous valuation models and may initially underreact to information that conflicts with prior beliefs or requires revisions to longer-run earnings expectations; negative surprises should analogously continue downward. This directly observes the fundamental-information shock that the original path-efficiency signal could only speculate about, while avoiding a claim that daily ranges identify parent-order execution or market-maker behavior."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _fresh_event_percentile(
    eps_surprise: pd.DataFrame,
    eps_estimate: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return event-masked signed percentile surprise scores using only t and t-1."""
    prior_surprise = eps_surprise.shift(1)
    available = eps_surprise.notna()
    changed = prior_surprise.isna() | ((eps_surprise - prior_surprise).abs() > 1e-12)
    event = available & changed

    denominator = eps_estimate.abs().where(eps_estimate.abs() >= 0.01, 0.01)
    standardized = eps_surprise / denominator
    eligible = event & standardized.notna()

    eligible_count = eligible.sum(axis=1)
    ranked = standardized.where(eligible).rank(axis=1, method="average", ascending=True)
    percentile = ranked.div(eligible_count.replace(0, np.nan), axis=0)

    valid_cross_section = eligible_count >= 10
    score = (2.0 * percentile - 1.0).where(eligible, 0.0)
    score = score.where(valid_cross_section, 0.0)
    return score.fillna(0.0).astype(float)


@register_factor
class FreshEpsSurpriseDrift(BaseFactor):
    """Ranks newly released standardized EPS surprises for post-earnings drift."""

    factor_id = "fresh_eps_surprise_drift"
    name = "Fresh Earnings-Surprise Drift"
    category = "momentum"
    description = (
        "On fresh EPS-surprise availability or revision dates, rank standardized "
        "surprises cross-sectionally and take signed percentile exposure; scores "
        "are zero for non-events and when fewer than ten fresh events exist."
    )
    window_length = 2
    inputs = ["close", "epsSurprise", "epsEstimate"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        eps_surprise = data["epsSurprise"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        return _fresh_event_percentile(eps_surprise, eps_estimate).reindex_like(close).fillna(0.0)

"""The intended incremental mechanism is a valuation-conditioned subset of short-horizon price-volume reversals: a high-activity move is treated as potentially excessive only when it moves a stock further away from its latest public earnings or cash-flow anchor and no newly available financial report or estimate update is observed. Cheap stocks with recent declines and expensive stocks with recent gains are expected to mean revert over the next six trading days when the move occurs on elevated volume but outside an observable information-update window. This does not assert that all high-volume moves are uninformed; it deliberately excludes names with observable contemporaneous earnings, revenue, cash-flow, balance-sheet, or consensus-estimate updates.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _winsorize_cross_section(
    values: pd.DataFrame, eligible: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Winsorize eligible observations at row-wise 1st and 99th percentiles."""
    masked = values.where(eligible).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    lower = masked.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
    upper = masked.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
    return masked.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0).where(eligible)


def _report_or_estimate_update(
    fields: list[pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Flag new reported values or changes in point-in-time field levels."""
    update = pd.DataFrame(False, index=fields[0].index, columns=fields[0].columns)
    for field in fields:
        current = field.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        previous = current.shift(1)
        changed = current.notna() & (previous.isna() | current.ne(previous))
        update = update | changed.fillna(False)
    return update


@register_factor
class AttentionWeightedValuationOvershoot(BaseFactor):
    """High-volume valuation dislocations outside observable information-update windows."""

    factor_id = "attention_weighted_valuation_overshoot"
    name = "No-Report Valuation-Return Dislocation"
    category = "mean_reversion"
    description = (
        "Equal-dollar decile portfolio of high-volume five-day valuation-return "
        "dislocations, excluding stocks on financial-report or estimate-update "
        "days and the following five trading days."
    )
    window_length = 26
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "earningsYield",
        "freeCashFlowYield",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "revenue",
        "eps",
        "operatingIncome",
        "netIncome",
        "freeCashFlow",
        "totalAssets",
        "totalDebt",
        "totalEquity",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        earnings_yield = data["earningsYield"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        fcf_yield = data["freeCashFlowYield"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        valuation_yield = earnings_yield.where(earnings_yield.notna(), fcf_yield)

        prior_close_count = (
            close.notna().shift(1).rolling(25, min_periods=25).sum()
        )
        has_history = prior_close_count.eq(25)
        eligible = (
            close.notna()
            & volume.notna()
            & valuation_yield.notna()
            & has_history
        )

        five_day_return = close / close.shift(5).replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        prior_volume_median = volume.shift(1).where(volume.shift(1) > 0.0).rolling(
            20, min_periods=20
        ).median()
        safe_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0)
        abnormal_volume = np.log(safe_volume / prior_volume_median.replace(0.0, np.nan))

        valuation_winsor = _winsorize_cross_section(valuation_yield, eligible)
        volume_winsor = _winsorize_cross_section(abnormal_volume, eligible)

        valuation_rank = valuation_winsor.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        return_rank = five_day_return.where(eligible).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        valuation_signal = 2.0 * valuation_rank - 1.0
        return_signal = 2.0 * return_rank - 1.0
        attention = volume_winsor.clip(lower=0.0)
        score = attention * (valuation_signal - return_signal)

        update_fields = [
            data["epsActual"],
            data["revenueActual"],
            data["epsSurprise"],
            data["revenueSurprise"],
            data["epsEstimate"],
            data["revenueEstimate"],
            data["revenue"],
            data["eps"],
            data["operatingIncome"],
            data["netIncome"],
            data["freeCashFlow"],
            data["totalAssets"],
            data["totalDebt"],
            data["totalEquity"],
        ]
        update_today = _report_or_estimate_update(update_fields)
        blocked = update_today.astype(float).rolling(6, min_periods=1).max().gt(0.0)

        active = eligible & score.notna() & ~blocked
        active_count = active.sum(axis=1)
        enough_names = active_count.ge(20)

        score_rank = score.where(active).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        long_mask = active & score_rank.ge(0.9) & enough_names
        short_mask = active & score_rank.le(0.1) & enough_names

        long_count = long_mask.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan)
        short_count = short_mask.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan)
        long_weight = long_mask.astype(float).div(long_count, axis=0)
        short_weight = short_mask.astype(float).div(short_count, axis=0)

        signal = (long_weight - short_weight).fillna(0.0)
        return signal.reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).astype(float)

programs.description: At each decision date, form the eligible universe from stocks with non-missing close, volume, a valuation yield, and at least 25 prior daily bars; rank all eligible stocks cross-sectionally. Define abnormal-volume intensity as a = log(volume[t] / median(volume[t-20:t-1])); winsorize a cross-sectionally at the 1st and 99th percentiles and set A = max(a, 0), so below-baseline volume receives zero weight. Rank 5-day returns and map that rank to R = 2*rank - 1. Among remaining eligible names, hold an equal-dollar long portfolio in the top score decile and an equal-dollar short portfolio in the bottom score decile, rebalanced daily; require at least 20 non-excluded eligible names, otherwise hold no position.

"""The hypothesis is that a downside continuation effect is concentrated in firms that had a demonstrably calm pre-event trading state but then jointly exhibit balance-sheet fragility, a meaningful break below recent price support, unusually high turnover, and a close near the session low. The proposed mechanism is not that volume alone identifies informed trading: rather, the full interaction marks a transition in which a previously low-risk narrative becomes less credible and persistent supply is revealed by both turnover and end-of-day price pressure. Its distinct testable contribution is incremental six-day negative return prediction from this five-way interaction after comparing it with its individual fragility, volatility-state, downside-break, volume, and close-location components.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _completed_ohlcv_history(
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Require a complete current-plus-prior-20-bar positive OHLCV history."""
    valid_bar = (
        open_.gt(0.0)
        & high.gt(0.0)
        & low.gt(0.0)
        & close.gt(0.0)
        & volume.gt(0.0)
    )
    count = valid_bar.astype(float).rolling(21, min_periods=21).sum()
    return count.eq(21.0)


def _portfolio_weights(active: pd.DataFrame, score: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Form equal-dollar long-low-score, short-high-score decile weights."""
    active_score = score.where(active)
    score_rank = rank(active_score)
    active_count = active.astype(float).sum(axis=1)

    long_mask = active & score_rank.le(0.10)
    short_mask = active & score_rank.ge(0.90)
    long_count = long_mask.astype(float).sum(axis=1)
    short_count = short_mask.astype(float).sum(axis=1)

    tradable = (
        active_count.ge(20.0)
        & long_count.ge(2.0)
        & short_count.ge(2.0)
    )

    long_weights = long_mask.astype(float).div(long_count.replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0)
    short_weights = short_mask.astype(float).div(short_count.replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0)
    weights = long_weights - short_weights
    return weights.where(tradable, 0.0).fillna(0.0)


@register_factor
class CalmFragilityTurnoverIgnition(BaseFactor):
    """Market-neutral continuation portfolio following calm-state fragility ignition."""

    factor_id = "calm_fragility_turnover_ignition"
    name = "Calm-Fragility Distribution Continuation"
    category = "momentum"
    description = (
        "After a calm realized-range regime, identifies financially fragile names "
        "breaking prior support on exceptional turnover with closes near the low; "
        "goes long the lowest fragility/break scores and short the highest scores "
        "among activated names."
    )
    window_length = 21
    inputs = [
        "open",
        "high",
        "low",
        "close",
        "volume",
        "marketCap",
        "debtToEquity",
        "currentRatio",
        "interestCoverage",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        market_cap = data["marketCap"]
        debt_to_equity = data["debtToEquity"]
        current_ratio = data["currentRatio"]
        interest_coverage = data["interestCoverage"]

        history_ok = _completed_ohlcv_history(open_, high, low, close, volume)
        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        prior_volume = volume.shift(1)

        log_range_sq = np.log(high.div(low.replace(0.0, np.nan))).pow(2)
        realized_range_vol = np.sqrt(
            log_range_sq.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        )
        prior_dollar_volume = (close * volume).shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        prior_volume_mean = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        prior_close_min = prior_close.rolling(20, min_periods=20).min()

        current_range = high - low
        close_location = close.sub(low).div(current_range.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        break_severity = (
            prior_close_min.div(close.replace(0.0, np.nan)).sub(1.0).clip(lower=0.0)
        )
        abnormal_turnover = volume.div(prior_volume_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan))

        eligible = (
            history_ok
            & close.gt(0.0)
            & high.gt(0.0)
            & low.gt(0.0)
            & volume.gt(0.0)
            & market_cap.gt(0.0)
            & market_cap.notna()
            & debt_to_equity.notna()
            & current_ratio.notna()
            & interest_coverage.notna()
            & prior_dollar_volume.ge(1_000_000.0)
            & realized_range_vol.notna()
        )

        calm = rank(realized_range_vol.where(eligible)).le(0.30)
        fragility = (
            0.45 * rank(debt_to_equity.where(eligible))
            + 0.30 * (1.0 - rank(current_ratio.where(eligible)))
            + 0.25 * (1.0 - rank(interest_coverage.where(eligible)))
        )
        break_rank = rank(break_severity.where(eligible))

        active = (
            eligible
            & calm
            & break_severity.ge(0.02)
            & abnormal_turnover.ge(2.0)
            & close_location.le(0.25)
            & current_range.gt(0.0)
        )
        score = 0.65 * fragility + 0.35 * break_rank

        return _portfolio_weights(active, score).reindex_like(close).fillna(0.0)

If at least 20 names are activated, form an equal-dollar market-neutral portfolio: short the top decile of activated names by S_t and long the bottom decile of activated names by S_t, with at least two names required on each side; otherwise hold no position. The signal is calculated only after day t has closed, entered no earlier than the next bar's open (t+1 open), and exited at the open six daily bars after entry. High S_t is expected to predict lower subsequent returns.

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_relative(values: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Subtract each name's contemporaneous sector mean using only that row."""
    result = values.copy()
    labels = pd.unique(sector.to_numpy().ravel())
    for label in labels:
        if pd.isna(label):
            continue
        membership = sector.eq(label).fillna(False)
        group_mean = values.where(membership).mean(axis=1)
        centered = values.sub(group_mean, axis=0)
        result = result.mask(membership, centered)
    return result


def _decayed_impulse(impulse: pd.DataFrame, decay: float) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal exponentially decayed event state, evaluated panel-wise by date."""
    output = np.zeros(impulse.shape, dtype=float)
    state = np.zeros(impulse.shape[1], dtype=float)
    values = impulse.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0).to_numpy(dtype=float)
    for t in range(values.shape[0]):
        state = decay * state + values[t]
        state = np.clip(state, -3.0, 3.0)
        output[t] = state
    return pd.DataFrame(output, index=impulse.index, columns=impulse.columns)


@register_factor
class CleanDeliveryRevisionRecognitionLag(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "clean_delivery_revision_recognition_lag"
    name = "Clean Delivery Revision Recognition Lag"
    category = "momentum"
    description = (
        "Carries forward analyst revisions that received weak next-day sector-relative "
        "recognition, while discounting positive revisions when recent sales delivery "
        "shows receivable, inventory, debt, or cash-conversion pressure."
    )
    window_length = 20
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "sector",
        "receivables",
        "inventory",
        "totalDebt",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "revenue",
        "totalAssets",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps = data["epsEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue_est = data["revenueEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        sector = data["sector"]
        receivables = data["receivables"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        inventory = data["inventory"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        debt = data["totalDebt"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        ocf = data["operatingCashFlow"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue = data["revenue"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        assets = data["totalAssets"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        prior_eps = eps.shift(1)
        prior_revenue_est = revenue_est.shift(1)
        eps_event = eps.notna() & prior_eps.notna() & eps.ne(prior_eps)
        revenue_event = (
            revenue_est.notna()
            & prior_revenue_est.notna()
            & revenue_est.ne(prior_revenue_est)
        )

        eps_revision = ((eps - prior_eps) / (prior_eps.abs() + 0.01)).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        revenue_revision = (
            (revenue_est - prior_revenue_est)
            / (prior_revenue_est.abs() + 1_000_000.0)
        ).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        revision_weight = eps_event.astype(float) * (2.0 / 3.0) + revenue_event.astype(float) * (1.0 / 3.0)
        revision = (
            eps_revision.where(eps_event, 0.0) * (2.0 / 3.0)
            + revenue_revision.where(revenue_event, 0.0) * (1.0 / 3.0)
        ).div(revision_weight.replace(0.0, np.nan))

        prior_revenue = revenue.shift(1)
        prior_receivables = receivables.shift(1)
        prior_inventory = inventory.shift(1)
        prior_debt = debt.shift(1)
        prior_ocf = ocf.shift(1)
        report_update = revenue.notna() & prior_revenue.notna() & revenue.ne(prior_revenue)

        receivable_pressure = ((receivables - prior_receivables) / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-0.5, 0.5)
        inventory_pressure = ((inventory - prior_inventory) / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-0.5, 0.5)
        debt_pressure = ((debt - prior_debt) / assets.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-0.5, 0.5)
        prior_ocf_margin = prior_ocf / prior_revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        ocf_pressure = (-(ocf / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan) - prior_ocf_margin)).clip(-0.5, 0.5)

        pressure_raw = (
            receivable_pressure.fillna(0.0)
            + inventory_pressure.fillna(0.0)
            + debt_pressure.fillna(0.0)
            + ocf_pressure.fillna(0.0)
        ) / 4.0
        report_pressure = np.tanh(4.0 * pressure_raw).where(report_update)
        persistent_pressure = report_pressure.ffill(limit=180).fillna(0.0)

        daily_return = close.pct_change().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        sector_return = _sector_relative(daily_return, sector)
        revision_lag = revision.shift(1)
        volatility = daily_return.rolling(20, min_periods=5).std().fillna(0.03).clip(lower=0.005)
        aligned_response = np.sign(revision_lag) * sector_return
        recognition_gap = (1.0 - aligned_response / (2.0 * volatility)).clip(0.0, 2.0)

        quality_lag = persistent_pressure.shift(1).fillna(0.0)
        positive_cleanliness = (1.0 - quality_lag.clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.85)).clip(0.15, 1.0)
        cleanliness = positive_cleanliness.where(revision_lag.gt(0.0), 1.0)
        valid_impulse = revision_lag.notna() & close.gt(0.0) & sector_return.notna()
        impulse = (revision_lag * recognition_gap * cleanliness).where(valid_impulse, 0.0)

        carried_signal = _decayed_impulse(impulse, 0.82)
        ranked = 2.0 * rank(carried_signal.where(close.gt(0.0))) - 1.0
        return ranked.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _report_event(actual: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """First public bar of a newly reported EPS value."""
    prior = actual.shift(1)
    return actual.notna() & (prior.isna() | actual.ne(prior))


def _pressure_release_state(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Completed downside move followed by a causal cooling of realized range."""
    prior_close = close.shift(1)
    valid = (
        close.gt(0.0)
        & prior_close.gt(0.0)
        & high.notna()
        & low.notna()
    )
    ret = (close / prior_close - 1.0).where(valid)
    bar_range = ((high - low) / prior_close).where(valid)

    downside = (-ret.rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum().shift(3)).clip(lower=0.0)
    shock_range = bar_range.rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean().shift(3)
    baseline = bar_range.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean().shift(6)
    current_range = bar_range.rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean()

    usable = baseline.gt(0.0)
    range_excess = (shock_range / baseline - 1.0).where(usable).clip(lower=0.0)
    cooling = (1.0 - current_range / baseline).where(usable).clip(lower=0.0)
    return downside * range_excess * cooling


@register_factor
class OperatingNoveltyPressureAssimilation(BaseFactor):
    """Novel operating-supported earnings delivery released into cooling pressure."""

    factor_id = "operating_novelty_pressure_assimilation"
    name = "Operating Novelty Pressure Assimilation"
    category = "momentum"
    description = (
        "Holds revision-unanticipated EPS surprises when cash quality and operating "
        "support validate the delivery and a completed downside-range shock is cooling."
    )
    window_length = 258
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "epsActual",
        "epsEstimate",
        "freeCashFlow",
        "incomeQuality",
        "operatingIncome",
        "incomeBeforeTax",
        "incomeTaxExpense",
        "marketCap",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_actual = data["epsActual"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        operating_income = data["operatingIncome"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        pretax_income = data["incomeBeforeTax"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        tax_expense = data["incomeTaxExpense"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        market_cap = data["marketCap"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        free_cash_flow = data["freeCashFlow"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        income_quality = data["incomeQuality"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        event = _report_event(eps_actual)
        surprise = (
            (eps_actual - eps_estimate) / (eps_estimate.abs() + 0.01)
        ).clip(-1.0, 1.0)

        prior_estimate = eps_estimate.shift(20)
        revision = (
            (eps_estimate - prior_estimate) / (prior_estimate.abs() + 0.01)
        ).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        anticipated = (np.sign(surprise) * revision).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        novelty = surprise * (1.0 - anticipated.fillna(0.0))

        annual_operating_income = operating_income.shift(252)
        annual_pretax_income = pretax_income.shift(252)
        annual_tax_expense = tax_expense.shift(252)
        safe_cap = market_cap.where(market_cap.gt(0.0))

        current_etr = (tax_expense / pretax_income.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 0.50)
        annual_etr = (annual_tax_expense / annual_pretax_income.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 0.50)
        operating_support = (operating_income - annual_operating_income) / safe_cap
        tax_support = (-pretax_income * (current_etr - annual_etr)) / safe_cap

        operating_character = (
            rank(operating_support) - rank(tax_support)
        ).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        credibility_weight = (
            0.5 + 0.5 * np.sign(surprise) * operating_character
        ).clip(0.0, 1.0)

        cash_state = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        cash_state = cash_state.where(
            ~(free_cash_flow.gt(0.0) & income_quality.ge(1.0)), 1.0
        )
        cash_state = cash_state.where(
            ~(free_cash_flow.le(0.0) | income_quality.le(0.0)), -1.0
        )
        cash_weight = (
            1.0 + 0.5 * np.sign(surprise) * cash_state
        ).clip(0.5, 1.5)

        pressure = _pressure_release_state(close, data["high"], data["low"]).shift(1)
        pressure_weight = 0.25 + rank(pressure)

        eligible = (
            event
            & surprise.notna()
            & eps_estimate.notna()
            & free_cash_flow.notna()
            & income_quality.notna()
            & pretax_income.gt(0.0)
            & annual_pretax_income.gt(0.0)
            & operating_support.notna()
            & tax_support.notna()
            & pressure_weight.notna()
        )

        event_signal = (
            novelty * cash_weight * credibility_weight * pressure_weight
        ).where(eligible, 0.0)
        held_signal = event_signal.rolling(6, min_periods=1).sum()
        return held_signal.reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).replace(
            [np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan
        ).fillna(0.0).astype(float)

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _release_event(actual: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """First public bar of a changed reported actual, using only current/past data."""
    prior = actual.shift(1)
    return actual.notna() & (prior.isna() | actual.ne(prior))


def _bounded_surprise(
    surprise: pd.DataFrame,
    estimate: pd.DataFrame,
    actual: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Scale reported surprise by public estimate and reported magnitudes."""
    denom = estimate.abs() + actual.abs()
    valid = surprise.notna() & estimate.notna() & actual.notna() & denom.gt(0.0)
    return (surprise / denom.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-1.0, 1.0).where(valid)


def _downside_dislocation(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal abnormal-volume downside stress, interpreted here as a repair state."""
    ret = close.pct_change().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    prior_ret = ret.shift(1)
    sigma = prior_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()

    positive_volume = volume.where(volume.gt(0.0))
    average_volume = positive_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
    relative_volume = volume / average_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    bar_range = high - low
    close_location = (2.0 * (close - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)) - 1.0
    downside = (-ret / sigma.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0)
    low_close = (-close_location).clip(lower=0.0)
    volume_excess = np.log(relative_volume).clip(lower=0.0)

    daily = downside * low_close * volume_excess
    valid = sigma.gt(0.0) & average_volume.gt(0.0) & bar_range.gt(0.0)
    return daily.where(valid).rolling(3, min_periods=2).mean().clip(upper=10.0)


@register_factor
class CashAnchoredDownsideDislocationRepair(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "cash_anchored_downside_dislocation_repair"
    name = "Cash-Anchored Downside Dislocation Repair"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Long credible, unanticipated positive cash-supported delivery when it is "
        "followed by abnormal downside volume stress and closes near the bar low."
    )
    window_length = 26
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "volume",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "freeCashFlow",
        "incomeQuality",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_actual = data["epsActual"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue_actual = data["revenueActual"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        eps_surprise = _bounded_surprise(
            data["epsSurprise"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan),
            eps_estimate,
            eps_actual,
        )
        revenue_surprise = _bounded_surprise(
            data["revenueSurprise"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan),
            revenue_estimate,
            revenue_actual,
        )
        surprise_count = eps_surprise.notna().astype(float) + revenue_surprise.notna().astype(float)
        combined_surprise = (eps_surprise.fillna(0.0) + revenue_surprise.fillna(0.0)).div(
            surprise_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )

        eps_revision = (
            (eps_estimate - eps_estimate.shift(20))
            / (eps_estimate.shift(20).abs() + 0.01)
        ).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        revenue_revision = (
            (revenue_estimate - revenue_estimate.shift(20))
            / (revenue_estimate.shift(20).abs() + 1000000.0)
        ).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        revision_count = eps_revision.notna().astype(float) + revenue_revision.notna().astype(float)
        revision = (eps_revision.fillna(0.0) + revenue_revision.fillna(0.0)).div(
            revision_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )

        anticipated_positive = revision.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0).fillna(0.0)
        positive_novelty = combined_surprise.clip(lower=0.0) * (1.0 - anticipated_positive)

        free_cash_flow = data["freeCashFlow"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        income_quality = data["incomeQuality"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        cash_valid = free_cash_flow.gt(0.0) & income_quality.ge(0.8)
        release = _release_event(eps_actual) | _release_event(revenue_actual)
        event_score = positive_novelty.where(release & cash_valid)

        delayed_event_state = event_score.shift(1).rolling(3, min_periods=1).max()
        stress = _downside_dislocation(close, data["high"], data["low"], data["volume"])
        signal = delayed_event_state * np.log1p(stress)

        return signal.reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).replace(
            [np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan
        ).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Cash-Anchored Downside Dislocation Repair
programs.trading_idea: Downside volume stress is not uniformly bad news: it can be a temporary liquidity-vacuum or capitulation event when it occurs immediately after a genuinely positive, cash-supported earnings delivery that was not already anticipated by consensus revisions. The child goes long the conflict between credible positive fundamental news and next-day high-volume selling into the low, because forced de-risking and delayed recognition can temporarily dominate the information signal before prices repair over the next week. Parent A alone cannot distinguish justified bad-news selling from an erroneous liquidity dislocation, while Parent B alone cannot identify when an under-recognized disclosure is being actively displaced by asymmetric downside liquidity pressure.
programs.description: The factor identifies positive cash-validated earnings/revenue surprises with limited prior estimate anticipation, carries that event state for three bars, and multiplies it by contemporaneous downside return, low-close, and abnormal-volume stress. High values represent credible good-news releases followed by unusually severe adverse price discovery, and are expected to precede rebound returns.
