from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _numeric(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return frame.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")


def _sector_leave_one_out(
    stock_return: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=stock_return.index, columns=stock_return.columns)
    labels = pd.unique(sector.to_numpy().ravel())
    for label in labels:
        if pd.isna(label):
            continue
        members = sector.eq(label)
        valid = members & stock_return.notna() & np.isfinite(stock_return)
        total = stock_return.where(valid, 0.0).sum(axis=1)
        count = valid.sum(axis=1).astype(float)
        own = stock_return.where(valid, 0.0)
        peer_sum = total.to_frame().reindex(columns=stock_return.columns)
        peer_count = count.to_frame().reindex(columns=stock_return.columns)
        peer_sum.columns = stock_return.columns
        peer_count.columns = stock_return.columns
        peer_sum = peer_sum.sub(own)
        peer_count = peer_count.sub(valid.astype(float))
        peer_return = peer_sum.div(peer_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(peer_count >= 2.0)
        result = result.where(~members, peer_return)
    return result


def _cs_rank(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return frame.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).rank(axis=1, pct=True)


@register_factor
class RevisionRejectionFragilityCascade(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "revision_rejection_fragility_cascade"
    name = "Revision Rejection Fragility Cascade"
    category = "momentum"
    description = (
        "High-risk positive revisions with tax-led earnings support and weak cash debt "
        "coverage, confirmed by abnormal-volume idiosyncratic selling in a sector decline."
    )
    window_length = 63
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "sector",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "operatingIncome",
        "revenue",
        "incomeBeforeTax",
        "incomeTaxExpense",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "totalDebt",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = _numeric(data["close"])
        volume = _numeric(data["volume"])
        eps_estimate = _numeric(data["epsEstimate"])
        revenue_estimate = _numeric(data["revenueEstimate"])
        operating_income = _numeric(data["operatingIncome"])
        revenue = _numeric(data["revenue"])
        pretax = _numeric(data["incomeBeforeTax"])
        tax = _numeric(data["incomeTaxExpense"])
        operating_cash_flow = _numeric(data["operatingCashFlow"])
        total_debt = _numeric(data["totalDebt"])
        sector = data["sector"]

        safe_close = close.where(close > 0.0)
        stock_return = safe_close.div(safe_close.shift(1)).sub(1.0)
        sector_return = _sector_leave_one_out(stock_return, sector)

        downside = (sector_return < 0.0) & stock_return.notna() & sector_return.notna()
        beta_num = (stock_return * sector_return).where(downside).rolling(40, min_periods=8).sum()
        beta_den = (sector_return * sector_return).where(downside).rolling(40, min_periods=8).sum()
        downside_beta = beta_num.div(beta_den.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.5).fillna(1.0)
        residual_move = stock_return.rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum().sub(
            downside_beta.mul(sector_return.rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum())
        )

        recent_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0).rolling(3, min_periods=2).mean()
        base_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0).shift(3).rolling(15, min_periods=8).median()
        volume_excess = np.log(recent_volume.div(base_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan))).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0)
        selling_pressure = (-residual_move).clip(lower=0.0).mul(1.0 + volume_excess.fillna(0.0))
        market_rejection = selling_pressure.where(sector_return.rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum() < 0.0, 0.0)

        eps_lag = eps_estimate.shift(21)
        revenue_lag = revenue_estimate.shift(21)
        eps_revision = eps_estimate.sub(eps_lag).div(eps_lag.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan))
        revenue_revision = revenue_estimate.sub(revenue_lag).div(revenue_lag.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan))
        margin = operating_income.div(revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        margin_change = margin.sub(margin.shift(1))
        tax_rate = tax.div(pretax.where(pretax > 0.0))
        tax_rate_decline = tax_rate.shift(1).sub(tax_rate)

        report_change = (
            operating_income.ne(operating_income.shift(1))
            | revenue.ne(revenue.shift(1))
            | pretax.ne(pretax.shift(1))
            | tax.ne(tax.shift(1))
        )
        valid_event = (
            eps_revision.gt(0.0)
            & revenue_revision.notna()
            & margin_change.notna()
            & tax_rate_decline.notna()
            & pretax.gt(0.0)
            & report_change
        )

        cash_debt = operating_cash_flow.div(total_debt.where(total_debt > 0.0))
        fragility = 1.0 - _cs_rank(cash_debt.clip(lower=-1.0, upper=2.0))
        weak_operating_confirmation = 1.0 - 0.5 * (
            _cs_rank(revenue_revision.where(valid_event)) + _cs_rank(margin_change.where(valid_event))
        )
        tax_lightness = _cs_rank(tax_rate_decline.where(valid_event))
        revision_strength = _cs_rank(eps_revision.where(valid_event))

        disclosure_risk = revision_strength.mul(tax_lightness).mul(weak_operating_confirmation).mul(fragility.fillna(0.5))
        active_risk = disclosure_risk.where(valid_event).ffill(limit=5).fillna(0.0)
        score = active_risk.mul(market_rejection.fillna(0.0))
        return _cs_rank(score).fillna(0.0).reindex_like(close).astype(float)

A gap-up that closes back toward or below the open, or a gap-down that closes back toward or above the open, indicates that the opening displacement was not sustained by the subsequent session's price formation. from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_conditional_rank(
    values: pd.DataFrame,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Rank eligible values by sector, using the universe rank for small sectors."""
    universe_values = values.where(eligible)
    universe_rank = universe_values.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    output = universe_rank.copy()

    labels = sector.fillna("__UNKNOWN__")
    unique_labels = pd.unique(labels.to_numpy().ravel())

    for label in unique_labels:
        if pd.isna(label):
            continue
        member = labels.eq(label)
        group_eligible = eligible & member
        group_count = group_eligible.sum(axis=1)
        group_rank = values.where(group_eligible).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        selected_rank = group_rank.where(group_count.ge(10), universe_rank)
        output = output.where(~member, selected_rank)

    return output.where(eligible).astype(float)


@register_factor
class AuctionImpactEfficiencyCompletionUnwind(BaseFactor):
    """Ranks abnormal-participation opening gaps that reverse within the session."""

    factor_id = "auction_impact_efficiency_completion_unwind"
    name = "Gap Rejection Under Abnormal Participation"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "At the close, identifies liquid names with abnormal-volume opening "
        "gaps whose signed open-to-close move rejects the gap, ranking the "
        "resulting temporary-pressure score within sector with a universe-rank "
        "fallback for small sectors."
    )
    window_length = 21
    inputs = ["open", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_price = data["open"]
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        sector = data["sector"]

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        prior_median_volume = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()

        base_eligible = (
            close.gt(0.0)
            & open_price.gt(0.0)
            & volume.gt(0.0)
            & prior_close.gt(0.0)
            & prior_median_volume.gt(0.0)
        )

        dollar_volume = close * volume
        liquidity_cutoff = dollar_volume.where(base_eligible).quantile(0.30, axis=1)
        eligible = base_eligible & dollar_volume.ge(liquidity_cutoff, axis=0)

        safe_prior_close = prior_close.clip(lower=1.0e-6)
        safe_open = open_price.clip(lower=1.0e-6)
        gap = np.log(open_price.where(open_price.gt(0.0)) / safe_prior_close).clip(
            lower=-0.20, upper=0.20
        )
        intraday_return = np.log(close.where(close.gt(0.0)) / safe_open).clip(
            lower=-0.20, upper=0.20
        )

        participation_ratio = volume / prior_median_volume.clip(lower=1.0)
        participation = np.log(participation_ratio.where(participation_ratio.gt(0.0)))
        participation = participation.clip(lower=-3.0, upper=3.0).clip(lower=0.0)

        rejection = (-np.sign(gap) * intraday_return).clip(lower=0.0)
        raw_score = (gap * rejection * participation).where(eligible)

        lower_bound = raw_score.quantile(0.02, axis=1)
        upper_bound = raw_score.quantile(0.98, axis=1)
        winsorized = raw_score.clip(lower=lower_bound, upper=upper_bound, axis=0)

        return _sector_conditional_rank(winsorized, eligible, sector)

programs.trading_idea: The signal treats a high-participation opening gap that is materially rejected during the same daily bar as evidence of potentially temporary opening price pressure, rather than as proof of dealer inventory accumulation or a completed auction. A gap-up that closes back toward or below the open, or a gap-down that closes back toward or above the open, indicates that the opening displacement was not sustained by the subsequent session's price formation. The proposed mechanism is therefore short-lived liquidity-demand imbalance and price-pressure reversal; informed disagreement, news assimilation, and intermediary inventory are possible but not identified from daily OHLCV alone.
programs.description: At the close of day t, define the eligible universe as tickers with positive close_t, open_t, volume_t, close_{t-1}, and at least 20 valid prior daily volume observations. Define 20-day prior median volume M_t = median(volume_{t-20}, ..., volume_{t-1}) and require M_t > 0. Define dollar volume DV_t = close_t * volume_t and retain only names whose DV_t is at or above the cross-sectional 30th percentile among otherwise eligible names, to avoid signals in the least tradable tail. Compute the signed opening gap g_t = clip(log(open_t / max(close_{t-1}, 1e-6)), -0.20, 0.20), and the same-day open-to-close return d_t = clip(log(close_t / max(open_t, 1e-6)), -0.20, 0.20). Compute abnormal-participation intensity a_t = max(0, clip(log(volume_t / max(M_t, 1.0)), -3.0, 3.0)); only above-median volume contributes. Compute signed gap rejection R_t = max(0, -sign(g_t) * d_t), which is positive only when the intraday move opposes the opening gap. The raw directional pressure score is S_t = g_t * R_t * a_t. Thus, a positive S_t is an abnormal-volume upward opening gap rejected downward during the day and is expected to have negative subsequent return; a negative S_t is the symmetric downward-gap rejection and is expected to have positive subsequent return. Winsorize S_t cross-sectionally at its 2nd and 98th percentiles, then rank it within sector as a percentile rank; for sectors with fewer than 10 eligible names, use the full-universe percentile rank instead. Trade equal-weight long positions in the lowest decile of ranked S_t and equal-weight short positions in the highest decile, subject to normal borrow and transaction-cost controls. The signal is computed only after day-t close and entered no earlier than the next tradable bar's open, t+1; positions are held for six daily bars and exited at the open of t+7. This differs from volume_time_impact_convexity_exhaustion because it does not use a volume-to-small-continuation ratio or classify merely weak continuation as exhaustion: it requires a signed intraday rejection of the opening displacement. It also differs from opening_inventory_camouflage_persistence and signed_closing_location_absorption_backlog by making the prior-close-to-open gap and its same-bar directional rejection jointly necessary, rather than treating closing location or low-impact volume alone as sufficient. The signal may still be correlated with those factors, so incremental efficacy and correlation versus those reference signals should be verified in research before deployment; no unobservable dealer-inventory interpretation is assumed by the formula.

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_shock_gate(
    ret: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
    lookback: int,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Return causal sector-shock direction and member eligibility.

    A sector is active only when its current robust equal-weight return is a
    large trailing mode innovation with broad sign agreement.  Member beta is
    estimated exclusively from observations preceding the current bar.
    """
    index = ret.index
    columns = ret.columns
    n_rows, n_cols = ret.shape
    directions = np.zeros((n_rows, n_cols), dtype=float)
    eligible = np.zeros((n_rows, n_cols), dtype=bool)
    ret_values = ret.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    labels_values = sector.reindex(index=index, columns=columns).ffill().bfill().to_numpy()
    sector_mode = np.full((n_rows, n_cols), np.nan, dtype=float)

    for t in range(n_rows):
        labels = labels_values[t]
        for label in pd.unique(labels):
            if pd.isna(label):
                continue
            positions = np.flatnonzero(labels == label)
            current = ret_values[t, positions]
            finite = np.isfinite(current)
            if finite.sum() < 10:
                continue
            values = current[finite]
            lower, upper = np.percentile(values, [10.0, 90.0])
            sector_return = float(np.mean(np.clip(values, lower, upper)))
            sector_mode[t, positions] = sector_return

    for t in range(lookback, n_rows):
        labels = labels_values[t]
        for label in pd.unique(labels):
            if pd.isna(label):
                continue
            positions = np.flatnonzero(labels == label)
            if positions.size < 10:
                continue
            mode_history = sector_mode[t - lookback:t, positions[0]]
            valid_mode = np.isfinite(mode_history)
            if valid_mode.sum() < int(0.75 * lookback):
                continue
            mode_std = float(np.std(mode_history[valid_mode], ddof=1))
            current_mode = sector_mode[t, positions[0]]
            if not np.isfinite(mode_std) or mode_std <= 0.0 or not np.isfinite(current_mode):
                continue
            if abs(current_mode) < 1.5 * mode_std:
                continue
            current_members = ret_values[t, positions]
            finite_members = np.isfinite(current_members)
            if finite_members.sum() < 10:
                continue
            breadth = np.mean(
                np.sign(current_members[finite_members]) == np.sign(current_mode)
            )
            if breadth < 0.65:
                continue

            history_mode = mode_history
            for pos in positions:
                history_stock = ret_values[t - lookback:t, pos]
                paired = np.isfinite(history_stock) & np.isfinite(history_mode)
                if paired.sum() < int(0.75 * lookback):
                    continue
                x = history_mode[paired]
                y = history_stock[paired]
                x_centered = x - np.mean(x)
                denominator = float(np.dot(x_centered, x_centered))
                if denominator <= 0.0:
                    continue
                beta = float(np.dot(x_centered, y - np.mean(y)) / denominator)
                if np.isfinite(beta) and beta >= 0.30:
                    directions[t, pos] = float(np.sign(current_mode))
                    eligible[t, pos] = True

    return (
        pd.DataFrame(directions, index=index, columns=columns),
        pd.DataFrame(eligible, index=index, columns=columns),
    )


@register_factor
class SectorShockCounterflowAbsorptionRelay(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "sector_shock_counterflow_absorption_relay"
    name = "Sector Shock Counterflow Absorption Relay"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Targets persistent low-impact closing pressure opposing a broad, "
        "beta-relevant sector shock, where local execution absorption should "
        "unwind toward the common sector repricing."
    )
    window_length = 60
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        safe_close = close.where(close > 0.0)
        ret = safe_close.pct_change()
        direction, sector_eligible = _sector_shock_gate(ret, data["sector"], 60)

        bar_range = high - low
        valid_range = bar_range > 0.0
        safe_range = bar_range.where(valid_range)
        closing_location = (2.0 * (close - low) / safe_range - 1.0).where(valid_range, 0.0)
        displacement = ((close - open_).abs() / safe_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        absorption = (1.0 - displacement).where(valid_range, 0.0)

        prior_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0).shift(1)
        median_volume = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        volume_count = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).count()
        abnormal_volume = (volume / median_volume - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0)
        abnormal_volume = abnormal_volume.where(volume_count >= 15, 0.0)

        daily_pressure = (closing_location * absorption * abnormal_volume).fillna(0.0)
        persistent_pressure = daily_pressure.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()

        relative_volume = volume / median_volume
        moderate_participation = relative_volume.ge(0.50) & relative_volume.le(1.20)
        opposing_pressure = (-persistent_pressure * direction).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0)
        signal = direction * opposing_pressure

        valid = (
            sector_eligible
            & moderate_participation
            & valid_range
            & close.gt(0.0)
            & volume.gt(0.0)
            & persistent_pressure.notna()
        )
        return signal.where(valid, 0.0).fillna(0.0).astype(float)

programs.trading_idea: A broad, coherent sector shock establishes the direction of common-information repricing, but historically sector-sensitive names can temporarily move against that shock when closing-auction liquidity absorbs idiosyncratic execution flow. The child buys names with absorbed negative closing pressure during a positive sector shock and shorts names with absorbed positive closing pressure during a negative shock, expecting the temporary counterflow to unwind toward the sector mode over six bars. Parent A alone cannot distinguish transient idiosyncratic pressure from a genuine common repricing, while Parent B identifies the common-shock state but lacks a direct execution footprint identifying which members are locally delayed.

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _finite(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return frame.where(np.isfinite(frame))


def _update_mask(fields: list[pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Availability-date update indicator for point-in-time quarterly fields."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(False, index=fields[0].index, columns=fields[0].columns)
    for field in fields:
        previous = field.shift(1)
        unchanged = field.eq(previous) | (field.isna() & previous.isna())
        result = result | (~unchanged)
    return result


def _transition_entropy(states: pd.DataFrame, valid: pd.DataFrame, window: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Normalized causal conditional entropy for 3 return signs x 3 volume states."""
    prior = states.shift(1)
    pair_valid = valid & valid.shift(1).fillna(False)
    complete = pair_valid.astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum().eq(float(window))
    entropy = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=states.index, columns=states.columns)

    for source in range(9):
        source_event = pair_valid & prior.eq(float(source))
        source_count = source_event.astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
        for target in range(9):
            transition = source_event & states.eq(float(target))
            count = transition.astype(float).rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
            probability = count / source_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
            term = -(count / float(window)) * np.log(probability.where(count.gt(0.0)))
            entropy = entropy.add(term.fillna(0.0), fill_value=0.0)

    return entropy.div(np.log(9.0)).where(complete)


@register_factor
class SmoothDisclosureFlowEntropyCarry(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "smooth_disclosure_flow_entropy_carry"
    name = "Disclosure-Conditioned Entropy Flow Carry"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Fresh equity-supply disclosures are carried for six bars only when low-entropy "
        "return-volume dynamics and repeated close pressure confirm an unabsorbed directional flow."
    )
    window_length = 70
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "volume",
        "marketCap",
        "sharesGrowth",
        "netStockIssuance",
        "stockBasedCompensation",
        "shareRepurchase",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = _finite(data["close"])
        high = _finite(data["high"])
        low = _finite(data["low"])
        volume = _finite(data["volume"])
        market_cap = _finite(data["marketCap"])
        shares_growth = _finite(data["sharesGrowth"])
        issuance = _finite(data["netStockIssuance"])
        sbc = _finite(data["stockBasedCompensation"])
        repurchase = _finite(data["shareRepurchase"])

        supply_fields = [shares_growth, issuance, sbc, repurchase]
        report_update = _update_mask(supply_fields)
        valid_cap = market_cap.gt(0.0)
        issuance_ratio = (issuance / market_cap.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-0.25, 0.25).fillna(0.0)
        sbc_ratio = (sbc / market_cap.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-0.25, 0.25).fillna(0.0)
        repurchase_ratio = (repurchase / market_cap.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-0.25, 0.25).fillna(0.0)
        disclosed_supply = (
            0.45 * shares_growth.clip(-0.25, 0.25).fillna(0.0)
            + 0.30 * issuance_ratio
            + 0.15 * sbc_ratio
            + 0.10 * repurchase_ratio
        )
        event = report_update & valid_cap & disclosed_supply.ne(0.0)
        event_supply = disclosed_supply.where(event)

        n_rows = len(close.index)
        clock = pd.DataFrame(
            np.broadcast_to(np.arange(n_rows, dtype=float)[:, None], close.shape).copy(),
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        )
        last_event_clock = clock.where(event).ffill()
        carried_supply = event_supply.ffill()
        age = clock - last_event_clock
        freshness = ((6.0 - age) / 6.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        fresh_event = last_event_clock.notna() & age.ge(0.0) & age.le(5.0)

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        ret_valid = close.gt(0.0) & prior_close.gt(0.0)
        ret = (close / prior_close - 1.0).where(ret_valid)
        ret_sign = pd.DataFrame(
            np.where(ret.gt(0.0), 1.0, np.where(ret.lt(0.0), -1.0, 0.0)),
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        ).where(ret_valid)

        positive_volume = volume.where(volume.gt(0.0))
        volume_base = positive_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
        relative_volume = (positive_volume / volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 6.0)
        rv_valid = relative_volume.notna() & volume_base.gt(0.0)
        prior_rv = relative_volume.shift(1)
        low_cut = prior_rv.rolling(35, min_periods=35).quantile(1.0 / 3.0)
        high_cut = prior_rv.rolling(35, min_periods=35).quantile(2.0 / 3.0)
        bins_ready = low_cut.notna() & high_cut.notna()
        volume_bin = pd.DataFrame(
            np.select(
                [relative_volume.le(low_cut), relative_volume.le(high_cut)],
                [0.0, 1.0],
                default=2.0,
            ),
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        ).where(rv_valid & bins_ready)
        state_valid = ret_valid & rv_valid & bins_ready
        states = ((ret_sign + 1.0) * 3.0 + volume_bin).where(state_valid)
        entropy = _transition_entropy(states, state_valid, 45)
        entropy_weight = ((0.72 - entropy) / 0.72).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0).fillna(0.0)

        bar_range = high - low
        close_location = (2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        close_location = close_location.mask(bar_range.eq(0.0), 0.0).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        signed_pressure = (ret_sign * close_location.abs()).where(ret_valid)
        pressure = signed_pressure.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        pressure_sign = np.sign(pressure)
        confirmation = (
            (np.sign(signed_pressure).eq(pressure_sign) & signed_pressure.ne(0.0))
            .astype(float)
            .rolling(5, min_periods=5)
            .mean()
            .fillna(0.0)
        )

        supply_direction = np.sign(carried_supply)
        alignment = (-supply_direction * pressure_sign).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        participation = ((relative_volume - 1.0) / 1.5).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0).fillna(0.0)
        magnitude = carried_supply.abs().clip(0.0, 0.30)
        signal = (
            pressure_sign
            * magnitude
            * freshness.fillna(0.0)
            * entropy_weight
            * confirmation
            * participation
            * alignment
        ).where(fresh_event, 0.0)

        return signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)

"""The signal treats persistent, directionally coherent closing pressure accompanied by broadly distributed abnormal participation as a proxy for a gradual liquidity-demand imbalance, without claiming to identify a specific parent order or distinguish it perfectly from news diffusion. Its continuation prediction is conditional: pressure is more credible when recent return-volume states are predictable and excess participation is spread across the episode rather than concentrated in the decision-day bar. A terminal relative-volume concentration and acceleration penalizes the signal because rapid one-bar participation shocks are more exposed to immediate information incorporation, adverse selection, and reversal risk."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _conditional_entropy_gate(
    log_return: pd.DataFrame,
    relative_volume: pd.DataFrame,
    state_valid: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal 19-transition, Laplace-smoothed conditional state entropy."""
    positive_return = (log_return >= 0.0).astype(float)
    elevated_volume = (relative_volume >= 1.0).astype(float)
    states = 2.0 * positive_return + elevated_volume

    # A transition aligned at t is from state[t-1] to state[t].
    source = states.shift(1)
    valid_entropy = state_valid.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() == 20

    entropy = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=states.index, columns=states.columns)
    for source_state in range(4):
        source_mask = source == float(source_state)
        source_count = source_mask.astype(float).rolling(19, min_periods=19).sum()
        weight = source_count / 19.0

        conditional_entropy = pd.DataFrame(
            0.0, index=states.index, columns=states.columns
        )
        for destination_state in range(4):
            transitions = (
                source_mask & (states == float(destination_state))
            ).astype(float)
            count = transitions.rolling(19, min_periods=19).sum()
            probability = (1.0 + count) / (4.0 + source_count)
            conditional_entropy = conditional_entropy - probability * np.log(probability)

        entropy = entropy + weight * conditional_entropy

    normalized = entropy / np.log(4.0)
    return normalized.where(valid_entropy)


@register_factor
class EntropyGatedDistributedPressureCarry(BaseFactor):
    """Entropy-gated closing-pressure carry with distributed-volume confirmation."""

    factor_id = "entropy_gated_distributed_pressure_carry"
    name = "Distributed Pressure Carry"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks persistent signed close-location pressure conditional on predictable "
        "return-volume states and broadly distributed abnormal participation, while "
        "penalizing terminal relative-volume concentration and acceleration."
    )
    window_length = 40
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        return_valid = close.gt(0.0) & prior_close.gt(0.0)
        log_return = np.log(close / prior_close).where(return_valid)

        bar_range = high - low
        location_valid = high.notna() & low.notna() & close.notna()
        close_location = ((2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range).where(
            bar_range.ne(0.0), 0.0
        )
        close_location = close_location.where(location_valid)

        # The shifted mean ensures x_u uses volume through u-1 only.
        volume_baseline = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().shift(1)
        volume_valid = volume.notna() & volume_baseline.gt(0.0)
        relative_volume = (volume / volume_baseline).where(volume_valid)

        pressure_valid = return_valid & volume_valid & location_valid
        pressure = (close_location * log_return.abs() * relative_volume).where(
            pressure_valid
        )

        pressure_window_valid = (
            pressure_valid.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum() == 5
        )
        directional_pressure = pressure.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        absolute_pressure = pressure.abs().rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        coherence = pressure.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum().abs() / (
            absolute_pressure + 1.0e-12
        )

        state_valid = return_valid & volume_valid
        entropy = _conditional_entropy_gate(log_return, relative_volume, state_valid)
        predictability = 1.0 - entropy

        mean_relative_volume = relative_volume.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        excess_participation = (mean_relative_volume - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0)

        total_participation = relative_volume.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        shares = relative_volume / total_participation
        squared_share_sum = (shares * shares).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        distribution = (1.0 - squared_share_sum) / (1.0 - 1.0 / 5.0)

        terminal_share = shares
        terminal_concentration = (
            (terminal_share - 1.0 / 5.0) / (1.0 - 1.0 / 5.0)
        ).clip(lower=0.0)

        prior_episode_mean = relative_volume.shift(1).rolling(4, min_periods=4).mean()
        acceleration_valid = prior_episode_mean.gt(0.0)
        acceleration = (relative_volume / prior_episode_mean - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0)
        bounded_acceleration = acceleration / (1.0 + acceleration)
        terminal_penalty = terminal_concentration * bounded_acceleration

        distributed_valid = (
            volume_valid.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum() == 5
        ) & total_participation.gt(0.0) & acceleration_valid
        valid = pressure_window_valid & distributed_valid & entropy.notna()

        raw_score = (
            directional_pressure
            * coherence
            * predictability
            * excess_participation
            * distribution
            * (1.0 - terminal_penalty)
        ).where(valid)

        percentile_rank = raw_score.rank(axis=1, method="average", pct=True)
        return (2.0 * percentile_rank - 1.0).astype(float)
programs.name: Distributed Pressure Carry
programs.trading_idea: The signal treats persistent, directionally coherent closing pressure accompanied by broadly distributed abnormal participation as a proxy for a gradual liquidity-demand imbalance, without claiming to identify a specific parent order or distinguish it perfectly from news diffusion. Its continuation prediction is conditional: pressure is more credible when recent return-volume states are predictable and excess participation is spread across the episode rather than concentrated in the decision-day bar. A terminal relative-volume concentration and acceleration penalizes the signal because rapid one-bar participation shocks are more exposed to immediate information incorporation, adverse selection, and reversal risk.
programs.description: At decision bar t, use only bars ending at or before t; enter no earlier than the next tradable bar. Define daily log return r_u=log(close_u/close_{u-1}) and close-location l_u=(2*close_u-high_u-low_u)/(high_u-low_u), setting l_u=0 when high_u=low_u. Define relative volume x_u=volume_u/mean(volume_{u-20},...,volume_{u-1}); observations with a nonpositive or missing baseline are invalid. Define signed close-location pressure q_u=l_u*abs(r_u)*x_u. Over the five bars u=t-4,...,t, define directional pressure P=mean(q_u) and directional coherence C=abs(sum(q_u))/(sum(abs(q_u))+1e-12). Define the four return-volume states S_u=(I[r_u>=0], I[x_u>=1]). Estimate normalized one-step conditional entropy from the 19 transitions over u=t-19,...,t-1: n_ij=1+sum(I[S_u=i,S_{u+1}=j]) for i,j in the four states, p_ij=n_ij/sum_j(n_ij), w_i=sum(I[S_u=i])/19, and H=-sum_i w_i*sum_j p_ij*log(p_ij)/log(4). Thus 1-H is the predictable-state weight, with Laplace smoothing fixed at one count per transition. Define five-bar excess participation E=max(0,mean(x_{t-4},...,x_t)-1). To measure distributed participation, set a_u=x_u/sum_{k=t-4}^t x_k and D=(1-sum_{u=t-4}^t a_u^2)/(1-1/5), which equals one for equal participation and zero when one bar contains all participation. Define terminal concentration B=max(0,(a_t-1/5)/(1-1/5)) and terminal acceleration A=max(0,x_t/mean(x_{t-4},...,x_{t-1})-1); convert acceleration to a bounded penalty A/(1+A), and set T=B*A/(1+A). The raw score is R=P*C*(1-H)*E*D*(1-T). For each date, discard invalid names, rank R cross-sectionally using average ranks, and map the percentile rank to the final factor score F=2*rank_pct(R)-1. Positive scores indicate upward distributed pressure and negative scores indicate downward distributed pressure. The construction has fixed 5-, 19-transition-, and 20-bar windows and no fitted thresholds beyond the economically defined relative-volume reference of one.

programs.code:
"""The factor tests a narrower, observable version of the original idea: a directional high-volume close and confirming next-day gap may leave short-lived price pressure when the following session probes against that direction on distinctly lower volume but still closes on the pressure side of the prior close. Daily bars cannot identify auction transfers, dealer inventory, or parent orders; those are only possible interpretations. The distinct testable prediction is that incomplete, low-participation rejection of a recent directional impulse is more likely to continue than a high-participation reversal or a full reclaim of the prior close."""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor

def _acceptance_score(open_: pd.DataFrame, high: pd.DataFrame, low: pd.DataFrame, close: pd.DataFrame, volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute the causal, completed-bar low-participation acceptance score."""
    previous_close = close.shift(1)
    returns = close / previous_close - 1.0
    volume_mean = volume.rolling(19, min_periods=15).mean()
    volrel = volume / volume_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return_volatility = returns.rolling(21, min_periods=20).std()
    price_floor = 0.001 * previous_close
    raw_range = high - low
    bar_range = raw_range.where(raw_range >= price_floor, price_floor)
    bar_range = bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    clv = (close - low) / bar_range
    r_previous = returns.shift(1)
    sigma_previous = return_volatility.shift(1)
    volrel_previous = volrel.shift(1)
    initiating_clv = clv.shift(1)
    initiating_volume = volume.shift(1)
    direction = np.sign(r_previous)
    opening_extension = direction * (open_ / previous_close - 1.0)
    upward_pullback = (open_ - low) / bar_range
    downward_pullback = (high - open_) / bar_range
    pullback = upward_pullback.where(direction > 0.0, downward_pullback)
    acceptance = direction * (close - previous_close) / bar_range
    volume_ratio = volume / initiating_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    valid_prices = close.gt(0.0) & previous_close.gt(0.0) & open_.gt(0.0) & high.gt(0.0) & low.gt(0.0)
    valid_history = sigma_previous.gt(0.0) & volume_mean.gt(0.0)
    valid_volume = volume.gt(0.0) & initiating_volume.gt(0.0)
    initiating_location = (direction > 0.0) & initiating_clv.ge(0.7) | (direction < 0.0) & initiating_clv.le(0.3)
    qualifies = direction.ne(0.0) & valid_prices & valid_history & valid_volume & r_previous.abs().ge(0.75 * sigma_previous) & volrel_previous.ge(1.25) & initiating_location & opening_extension.ge(0.002) & pullback.ge(0.3) & acceptance.ge(0.0) & volume_ratio.le(0.75) & volrel.le(1.0)
    standardized_impulse = (r_previous.abs() / sigma_previous).clip(upper=3.0)
    capped_participation = volrel_previous.clip(upper=3.0)
    retained_acceptance = acceptance.clip(lower=0.0)
    raw_score = direction * standardized_impulse * capped_participation * pullback * retained_acceptance
    raw_score = raw_score.where(qualifies, 0.0)
    return raw_score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)

@register_factor
class PartialAuctionAcceptanceInventoryTransfer(BaseFactor):
    """Continuation after a low-participation adverse probe accepts a prior impulse."""
    factor_id = 'partial_auction_acceptance_inventory_transfer_j'
    name = 'Low-Participation Gap Acceptance'
    category = 'microstructure'
    description = 'Ranks qualifying directional gap extensions whose adverse intraday probe occurs on reduced participation but closes on the prior pressure side, indicating incomplete rejection and likely continuation.'
    window_length = 21
    inputs = ['open', 'high', 'low', 'close', 'volume']
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data['close']
        raw_score = _acceptance_score(data['open'], data['high'], data['low'], close, data['volume'])
        qualifies = raw_score.ne(0.0)
        ranked = raw_score.where(qualifies).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        signal = (2.0 * ranked - 1.0).where(qualifies, 0.0)
        return signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

Daily bars cannot identify auction transfers, dealer inventory, or parent orders; those are only possible interpretations. The distinct testable prediction is that incomplete, low-participation rejection of a recent directional impulse is more likely to continue than a high-participation reversal or a full reclaim of the prior close.
programs.description: At the completion of day t, define r_t = close_t / close_{t-1} - 1, range_t = max(high_t - low_t, 0.001 * close_{t-1}), clv_t = (close_t - low_t) / range_t, and volrel_t = volume_t / mean(volume_{t-19:t}, min_periods=15). All rolling means use only bars through t. Let d = sign(r_{t-1}); require d != 0, abs(r_{t-1}) >= 0.75 * rolling_std(close.pct_change(), 20)_{t-1}, volrel_{t-1} >= 1.25, and close-location confirmation on the initiating bar: clv_{t-1} >= 0.70 when d=+1 or clv_{t-1} <= 0.30 when d=-1. Require a confirming opening extension on day t: d * (open_t / close_{t-1} - 1) >= 0.002. Define the adverse intraday excursion as pullback_t = (open_t - low_t) / range_t for d=+1 and pullback_t = (high_t - open_t) / range_t for d=-1; require pullback_t >= 0.30, so the current bar actually tested against the gap direction. Define retained acceptance as accept_t = d * (close_t - close_{t-1}) / range_t; require accept_t >= 0, meaning the completed current close remains on the initiating-pressure side of the prior close, a computable replacement for the unavailable value-area claim. Require volume_t / volume_{t-1} <= 0.75 and volrel_t <= 1.00, so the adverse probe occurs with lower-than-initiation and no-abnormal current participation. For qualifying names, raw_score_t = d * min(abs(r_{t-1}) / rolling_std(close.pct_change(),20)_{t-1}, 3) * min(volrel_{t-1}, 3) * pullback_t * max(accept_t, 0); otherwise raw_score_t = 0. Replace undefined returns, zero/negative prices, zero volume, insufficient rolling-history observations, and non-finite scores with 0. Cross-sectionally rank raw_score_t each day using pct=True and transform to signal_t = 2 * rank_t - 1, with non-qualifiers retained at 0 rather than ranked. The signal is formed only after the completed close of day t and may be traded no earlier than the open of day t+1; it must not be executed at close_t. Positive scores indicate expected continuation in d over the fixed next 6 daily bars.

"""This is not interpreted as a uniquely identified dealer-inventory trade. Instead, a high-participation directional gap that is rejected intraday is treated as a liquidity-dislocation candidate only if the next two completed sessions accept the rejection-side price level while activity and realized range contract. That sequence identifies a short-lived latent-liquidity adjustment in which the original directional pressure has failed to reassert itself; the signal is entered only after confirmation and predicts continued movement in the accepted rejection direction over the following six bars."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _confirmed_rejection_score(
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Construct the completed two-session rejection-side acceptance signal."""
    safe_close = close.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    safe_open = open_.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    daily_range = (high - low) / safe_close
    prior_range = daily_range.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()

    prior_pressure = np.sign(np.log(close.shift(1) / safe_close.shift(4)))
    pressure_magnitude = (
        np.log(close.shift(1) / safe_close.shift(4)).abs()
        / prior_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    )

    prior_volume = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    participation = volume / prior_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    overnight_extension = (
        prior_pressure * (open_ / safe_close.shift(1) - 1.0)
        / prior_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    )
    intraday_rejection = (
        -prior_pressure * (close / safe_open - 1.0)
        / prior_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    )

    # At timestamp T, shift all event-date quantities from t=T-2 into T.
    event_pressure = prior_pressure.shift(2)
    event_magnitude = pressure_magnitude.shift(2)
    event_participation = participation.shift(2)
    event_extension = overnight_extension.shift(2)
    event_rejection = intraday_rejection.shift(2)
    event_open = open_.shift(2).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    event_range = daily_range.shift(2)
    event_volume = volume.shift(2)
    event_range_base = prior_range.shift(2)

    confirmation_1 = (
        event_pressure * (close.shift(1) / event_open - 1.0)
        / event_range_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    )
    confirmation_2 = (
        event_pressure * (close / event_open - 1.0)
        / event_range_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    )
    acceptance_strength = -(confirmation_1 + confirmation_2) / 2.0

    confirmation_volume = (volume.shift(1) + volume) / 2.0
    confirmation_volume_ratio = confirmation_volume / event_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    confirmation_range = (daily_range.shift(1) + daily_range) / 2.0
    range_ratio = confirmation_range / event_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    valid = (
        (event_range_base > 0.0)
        & (event_magnitude >= 1.5)
        & (event_participation >= 1.5)
        & (event_extension >= 0.5)
        & (event_rejection >= 0.5)
        & (confirmation_1 < 0.0)
        & (confirmation_2 < 0.0)
        & (confirmation_volume_ratio > 0.0)
        & (confirmation_volume_ratio <= 0.75)
        & (event_range > 0.0)
        & (confirmation_range > 0.0)
        & (range_ratio <= 0.75)
    )

    score = (
        -event_pressure
        * event_magnitude
        * event_participation
        * event_extension
        * event_rejection
        * acceptance_strength
        * (1.0 / confirmation_volume_ratio.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        * (event_range / confirmation_range.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    )
    return score.where(valid, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)


@register_factor
class ConfirmedRejectionSideAcceptance(BaseFactor):
    """Two-session acceptance after an exhausted directional gap rejection."""

    factor_id = "rejection_settlement_inventory_release"
    name = "Confirmed Rejection-Side Acceptance"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Scores directional gap-rejection events only after two completed "
        "sessions accept the rejection-side level with contracting volume and range."
    )
    window_length = 23
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        return _confirmed_rejection_score(
            data["open"],
            data["high"],
            data["low"],
            data["close"],
            data["volume"],
        )
programs.name: Confirmed Rejection-Side Acceptance
programs.trading_idea: This is not interpreted as a uniquely identified dealer-inventory trade. Instead, a high-participation directional gap that is rejected intraday is treated as a liquidity-dislocation candidate only if the next two completed sessions accept the rejection-side price level while activity and realized range contract. That sequence identifies a short-lived latent-liquidity adjustment in which the original directional pressure has failed to reassert itself; the signal is entered only after confirmation and predicts continued movement in the accepted rejection direction over the following six bars.
programs.description: For a factor timestamp T, define the rejection event at t = T-2 and use only data through the close of T. Let A_t be the mean of (high-low)/close over t-20 through t-1, require 20 valid observations, and define signed prior pressure p = sign(log(close[t-1]/close[t-4])). Define pressure magnitude P = abs(log(close[t-1]/close[t-4]))/A_t and require P >= 1.5. Define abnormal participation V = volume[t]/mean(volume[t-20:t-1]) and require V >= 1.5. Define overnight extension G = p*(open[t]/close[t-1]-1)/A_t and require G >= 0.5. Define intraday rejection R = -p*(close[t]/open[t]-1)/A_t and require R >= 0.5, so the event closes materially opposite the prior-pressure and overnight-extension direction. The fixed confirmation window is exactly t+1 and t+2 = T. A confirmation close is on the rejection side when p*(close[u]/open[t]-1) < 0 for each u in {t+1,t+2}; both days must satisfy this condition. Define confirmation-volume ratio CV = mean(volume[t+1:t+2])/volume[t] and require CV <= 0.75. Define event range ER = (high[t]-low[t])/close[t], confirmation range CR = mean((high[u]-low[u])/close[u] for u in {t+1,t+2}), and require CR/ER <= 0.75. If every condition holds, emit raw score S_T = -p * P * V * G * R * (-mean(p*(close[u]/open[t]-1)/A_t for u in {t+1,t+2})) * (1/CV) * (ER/CR); otherwise emit zero or NaN. Positive scores therefore forecast positive returns and correspond to going in the direction opposite the original three-day pressure. The signal is known only after the close of T=t+2, and the six-bar forecast begins at T+1, so neither confirmation bar overlaps the target. Its incremental construction versus same-day close-location, gap-rejection, volume-exhaustion, and volatility-cooling signals is the mandatory two-session rejection-side acceptance sequence, with predeclared volume and range contraction measured only during that completed confirmation window rather than used to forecast from the original event date.

"""Peer-anchored tax-character earnings delivery.

Mechanism: earnings headlines are assimilated more slowly when the surprise is
supported by seasonally comparable operating improvement rather than a tax-rate
change, and when that credible delivery resolves an industry-relative cash-flow
valuation discount or premium.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _seasonal_available_baseline(
    field: pd.DataFrame,
    minimum_days: int = 200,
    maximum_days: int = 450,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Latest disclosed observation 200--450 calendar days old, causally."""
    index = field.index
    rows, cols = field.shape
    if rows == 0:
        return field.copy(), pd.DataFrame(False, index=index, columns=field.columns)

    values = field.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
    changed = field.notna() & (field.shift(1).isna() | field.ne(field.shift(1)))
    positions = np.arange(rows, dtype=float)[:, None]
    disclosed_positions = np.where(changed.to_numpy(), positions, np.nan)
    last_disclosed = pd.DataFrame(
        disclosed_positions, index=index, columns=field.columns
    ).ffill().to_numpy()

    timestamps = index.asi8
    minimum_ns = int(minimum_days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000_000_000)
    maximum_ns = int(maximum_days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000_000_000)
    anchor_rows = np.searchsorted(timestamps, timestamps - minimum_ns, side="right") - 1

    source_positions = np.full((rows, cols), np.nan, dtype=float)
    usable = anchor_rows >= 0
    if usable.any():
        source_positions[usable] = last_disclosed[anchor_rows[usable]]

    valid_position = np.isfinite(source_positions)
    clipped = np.where(valid_position, source_positions, 0).astype(int)
    baseline_values = np.take_along_axis(values, clipped, axis=0)
    source_times = np.where(
        valid_position,
        timestamps[clipped],
        np.iinfo(np.int64).min,
    )
    in_range = valid_position & (source_times >= (timestamps - maximum_ns)[:, None])
    baseline_values = np.where(in_range, baseline_values, np.nan)

    return (
        pd.DataFrame(baseline_values, index=index, columns=field.columns),
        pd.DataFrame(in_range, index=index, columns=field.columns),
    )


def _industry_median(
    values: pd.DataFrame,
    industry: pd.DataFrame,
    minimum_names: int = 3,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Same-date industry median, omitted for insufficiently populated peers."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns)
    for row in range(len(values.index)):
        current = values.iloc[row]
        labels = industry.iloc[row]
        valid = current.notna() & np.isfinite(current) & labels.notna()
        if not valid.any():
            continue
        selected_values = current.loc[valid]
        selected_labels = labels.loc[valid]
        counts = selected_values.groupby(selected_labels).count()
        medians = selected_values.groupby(selected_labels).median()
        eligible_groups = counts[counts >= minimum_names].index
        if len(eligible_groups) == 0:
            continue
        mapped = selected_labels.map(medians.loc[eligible_groups])
        result.loc[values.index[row], mapped.index] = mapped.to_numpy()
    return result


def _decayed_event_carry(event_score: pd.DataFrame, days: int = 6) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Causally hold a report score through the six-session assimilation window."""
    rows, cols = event_score.shape
    position = pd.DataFrame(
        np.broadcast_to(np.arange(rows, dtype=float)[:, None], (rows, cols)),
        index=event_score.index,
        columns=event_score.columns,
    )
    last_event = position.where(event_score.notna()).ffill()
    age = position - last_event
    carried = event_score.ffill(limit=days) * np.exp(-age / 3.5)
    active = age.ge(0.0) & age.le(float(days))
    return carried.where(active), active


@register_factor
class PeerAnchoredTaxCharacterDelivery(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "peer_anchored_tax_character_delivery"
    name = "Peer-Anchored Tax-Character Delivery"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "A six-session decayed earnings-delivery signal that requires an EPS surprise "
        "to be operating-supported rather than tax-supported and directionally aligned "
        "with an industry-relative operating-cash-flow-yield valuation gap."
    )
    window_length = 450
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "epsActual",
        "epsEstimate",
        "incomeBeforeTax",
        "incomeTaxExpense",
        "revenue",
        "operatingIncome",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "marketCap",
        "industry",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        eps_actual = data["epsActual"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        pretax = data["incomeBeforeTax"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        tax = data["incomeTaxExpense"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue = data["revenue"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        operating_income = data["operatingIncome"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        operating_cash_flow = data["operatingCashFlow"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        market_cap = data["marketCap"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        industry = data["industry"]

        report_event = eps_actual.notna() & (
            eps_actual.shift(1).isna() | eps_actual.ne(eps_actual.shift(1))
        )

        pretax_base, pretax_ok = _seasonal_available_baseline(pretax)
        tax_base, tax_ok = _seasonal_available_baseline(tax)
        revenue_base, revenue_ok = _seasonal_available_baseline(revenue)
        operating_base, operating_ok = _seasonal_available_baseline(operating_income)

        current_etr = (tax / pretax.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 0.50)
        baseline_etr = (tax_base / pretax_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 0.50)
        tax_driven_change = (
            -pretax * (current_etr - baseline_etr) / market_cap.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        operating_change = (
            (operating_income - operating_base) / market_cap.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        eps_surprise = (
            (eps_actual - eps_estimate) / (eps_estimate.abs() + 0.01)
        ).clip(-3.0, 3.0)

        economically_meaningful = (
            pretax.gt(0.0)
            & pretax_base.gt(0.0)
            & revenue.gt(0.0)
            & revenue_base.gt(0.0)
            & pretax.abs().ge(0.01 * revenue)
            & pretax_base.abs().ge(0.01 * revenue_base)
            & market_cap.gt(0.0)
        )
        available = (
            pretax_ok & tax_ok & revenue_ok & operating_ok
            & eps_estimate.notna() & tax.notna() & tax_base.notna()
            & operating_change.notna() & tax_driven_change.notna()
            & eps_surprise.notna() & current_etr.notna() & baseline_etr.notna()
        )
        event_valid = report_event & economically_meaningful & available

        character = (
            (rank(eps_surprise.where(event_valid)) - 0.5)
            + (rank(operating_change.where(event_valid)) - 0.5)
            - (rank(tax_driven_change.where(event_valid)) - 0.5)
        )

        cash_yield = (operating_cash_flow / market_cap.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(
            operating_cash_flow.gt(0.0) & market_cap.gt(0.0)
        )
        peer_yield = _industry_median(cash_yield, industry, 3)
        anchor_gap = np.log(cash_yield / peer_yield).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        anchor_state = 2.0 * rank(anchor_gap) - 1.0

        alignment = np.sign(character) * anchor_state
        aligned = event_valid & anchor_state.notna() & alignment.gt(0.0)
        event_score = (character * alignment).where(aligned)

        carried, active = _decayed_event_carry(event_score, 6)
        exposure = (rank(carried.where(active)) - 0.5).where(active, 0.0)
        return exposure.fillna(0.0).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).astype(float)

programs.trading_idea: An earnings surprise should persist over the fixed six-session horizon when its reported headline is supported by seasonally comparable operating-income improvement rather than by a lower effective tax rate. That accounting-character signal is acted on only when it resolves an industry-relative operating-cash-flow-yield disagreement: operationally credible good news in a cash-flow-discounted stock, or tax/operationally weak news in a cash-flow-premium stock, gives investors a delayed and concrete peer-implied repricing path. Parent A identifies whether the headline deserves assimilation, while Parent B identifies whether that information has valuation room to travel; their interaction filters both unsupported surprises and already-fairly-priced deliveries.

It retains and exponentially carries for six sessions only signals whose direction agrees with the stock's industry-relative operating-cash-flow-yield discount or premium.

"""Conditional on being liquid enough to trade, an unusually large daily displacement achieved on below-normal participation is consistent with a temporary liquidity imbalance or incomplete price discovery rather than broad, persistent demand. The signal deliberately does not claim to identify signed order flow or dealer inventory; it tests the narrower prediction that extreme low-participation dislocations have weaker six-session continuation and, on average, partial reversal. Screening out sparse and very low-volume names makes the hypothesis about tradable dislocations rather than mechanical stale-price or bid-ask-bounce effects."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _lagged_positive_volume_baseline(volume: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Compute a causal 20-session positive-volume baseline ending at t-1."""
    lagged_volume = volume.shift(1)
    positive_lagged_volume = lagged_volume.where(lagged_volume > 0.0)
    positive_count = positive_lagged_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=1).count()
    baseline = positive_lagged_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
    return baseline, positive_count


@register_factor
class ParticipationNormalizedImpactRecoil(BaseFactor):
    """Liquidity-screened low-participation price-impact dislocation rank."""

    factor_id = "participation_normalized_impact_recoil"
    name = "Liquidity-Screened Low-Participation Recoil"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Cross-sectional rank of directional close-to-close impact scaled by "
        "intraday range and inverse current participation, restricted to names "
        "with adequate recent trading activity. Positive values identify upward "
        "low-participation dislocations expected to have weaker continuation or "
        "partial reversal over the next six sessions."
    )
    window_length = 21
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        valid_previous_close = previous_close > 0.0
        valid_range = high.notna() & low.notna() & (high >= low)

        close_return = close / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        range_fraction = (high - low) / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        valid_displacement = (
            valid_previous_close
            & valid_range
            & close_return.notna()
            & range_fraction.notna()
            & (range_fraction > 0.0)
        )

        volume_baseline, positive_history_count = _lagged_positive_volume_baseline(volume)
        valid_history = (positive_history_count >= 15.0) & (volume_baseline > 0.0)
        participation = volume / volume_baseline.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        impact = close_return * range_fraction / participation.clip(lower=0.10)

        baseline_cutoff = volume_baseline.where(valid_history).quantile(0.30, axis=1)
        sufficiently_liquid = volume_baseline.ge(baseline_cutoff, axis=0)
        eligible = (
            valid_displacement
            & valid_history
            & (volume > 0.0)
            & (volume >= 0.25 * volume_baseline)
            & sufficiently_liquid
            & impact.notna()
        )

        eligible_impact = impact.where(eligible)
        lower = eligible_impact.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
        upper = eligible_impact.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
        winsorized_impact = eligible_impact.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)

        return rank(winsorized_impact) - 0.5

programs.trading_idea: Conditional on being liquid enough to trade, an unusually large daily displacement achieved on below-normal participation is consistent with a temporary liquidity imbalance or incomplete price discovery rather than broad, persistent demand. The signal deliberately does not claim to identify signed order flow or dealer inventory; it tests the narrower prediction that extreme low-participation dislocations have weaker six-session continuation and, on average, partial reversal. Screening out sparse and very low-volume names makes the hypothesis about tradable dislocations rather than mechanical stale-price or bid-ask-bounce effects.
programs.description: At the close of completed session t, use corporate-action-adjusted OHLC prices as supplied by the feed and define close-to-close return r_t = close_t / close_{t-1} - 1. Define the intraday range fraction q_t = (high_t - low_t) / close_{t-1}, requiring close_{t-1} > 0, high_t >= low_t, and q_t > 0. Define Vbar20_t as the arithmetic mean of volume over sessions t-20 through t-1, requiring at least 15 positive-volume observations; define participation p_t = volume_t / Vbar20_t, requiring volume_t > 0 and Vbar20_t > 0. Define impact I_t = r_t * q_t / max(p_t, 0.10), so a given directional close-to-close displacement receives greater magnitude only when contemporaneous volume is low relative to the stock's own recent participation. Before cross-sectional ranking, winsorize I_t each day at the 1st and 99th percentiles among eligible names. Eligibility requires valid I_t, at least 15 valid trailing-volume observations, current volume at least 25% of Vbar20_t, and Vbar20_t at or above the cross-sectional 30th percentile among names with valid histories; these conditions exclude zero-volume and persistently sparse names while retaining temporary below-normal participation. The factor value is the daily cross-sectional percentile rank of winsorized I_t, mapped to [-0.5, 0.5]; positive values denote positive low-participation dislocations and are expected to predict lower subsequent returns, while negative values denote negative dislocations and are expected to predict higher subsequent returns. The signal is formed only after the completed t daily bar and may be traded no earlier than the next executable bar.

from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor

def _groups(industry: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[object, list[object]]:
    groups: dict[object, list[object]] = {}
    for column in industry.columns:
        observed = industry[column].dropna()
        if not observed.empty:
            groups.setdefault(observed.iloc[0], []).append(column)
    return groups

def _cs_zscore(values: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    lo = values.quantile(0.02, axis=1)
    hi = values.quantile(0.98, axis=1)
    clipped = values.clip(lower=lo, upper=hi, axis=0)
    mean = clipped.mean(axis=1)
    std = clipped.std(axis=1, ddof=0).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return clipped.sub(mean, axis=0).div(std, axis=0)

def _industry_revision_residual(eps_revision: pd.DataFrame, sales_revision: pd.DataFrame, groups: dict[object, list[object]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Cross-sectional, within-industry residual of EPS revisions on sales revisions."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=eps_revision.index, columns=eps_revision.columns)
    for columns in groups.values():
        if len(columns) < 6:
            continue
        y = eps_revision[columns]
        x = sales_revision[columns]
        valid = y.notna() & x.notna()
        count = valid.sum(axis=1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        x0 = x.where(valid, 0.0)
        y0 = y.where(valid, 0.0)
        x_mean = x0.sum(axis=1).div(count)
        y_mean = y0.sum(axis=1).div(count)
        xc = x.sub(x_mean, axis=0).where(valid, 0.0)
        yc = y.sub(y_mean, axis=0).where(valid, 0.0)
        denom = (xc * xc).sum(axis=1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        beta = (xc * yc).sum(axis=1).div(denom)
        residual = y.sub(y_mean, axis=0).sub(xc.mul(beta, axis=0))
        output.loc[:, columns] = residual.where(valid & count.ge(6.0), np.nan)
    return output

def _excluded_peer_returns(ret: pd.DataFrame, groups: dict[object, list[object]]) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    peer = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)
    breadth = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)
    for columns in groups.values():
        if len(columns) < 3:
            continue
        values = ret[columns]
        valid = values.notna()
        total = values.where(valid, 0.0).sum(axis=1)
        count = valid.sum(axis=1)
        excluded_count = count.to_numpy()[:, None] - valid.astype(float).to_numpy()
        excluded_sum = total.to_numpy()[:, None] - values.where(valid, 0.0).to_numpy()
        peer_values = excluded_sum / np.where(excluded_count > 0.0, excluded_count, np.nan)
        peer_frame = pd.DataFrame(peer_values, index=ret.index, columns=columns)
        peer.loc[:, columns] = peer_frame.where(excluded_count >= 2.0)
        positive = values.gt(0.0) & valid
        negative = values.lt(0.0) & valid
        pos_count = positive.sum(axis=1).to_numpy()[:, None] - positive.astype(float).to_numpy()
        neg_count = negative.sum(axis=1).to_numpy()[:, None] - negative.astype(float).to_numpy()
        peer_sign = np.sign(peer_frame.to_numpy())
        matching = np.where(peer_sign > 0.0, pos_count, np.where(peer_sign < 0.0, neg_count, 0.0))
        breadth.loc[:, columns] = pd.DataFrame(matching / np.where(excluded_count > 0.0, excluded_count, np.nan), index=ret.index, columns=columns)
    return (peer, breadth)

def _prior_beta(stock_ret: pd.DataFrame, peer_ret: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Thirty-bar beta using only observations available before the current bar."""
    x = peer_ret.shift(1)
    y = stock_ret.shift(1)
    paired = x.notna() & y.notna()
    count = paired.astype(float).rolling(31, min_periods=15).sum()
    x0 = x.where(paired, 0.0)
    y0 = y.where(paired, 0.0)
    sx = x0.rolling(31, min_periods=15).sum()
    sy = y0.rolling(31, min_periods=15).sum()
    sxx = (x0 * x0).rolling(33, min_periods=15).sum()
    sxy = (x0 * y0).rolling(32, min_periods=15).sum()
    denom = sxx - sx * sx.div(count.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    numer = sxy - sx * sy.div(count.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    return numer.div(denom.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(count.ge(15.0))

def _attention_deficit(close: pd.DataFrame, volume: pd.DataFrame, market_cap: pd.DataFrame, groups: dict[object, list[object]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    prior_median = volume.shift(1).rolling(14, min_periods=5).median()
    own_ratio = prior_median.div(volume.replace(0.0, np.nan))
    own_drought = np.log(own_ratio.where(own_ratio > 1.0)).clip(0.0, np.log(4.0))
    activity = (close * volume).where((close > 0.0) & (volume > 0.0)).rolling(6, min_periods=3).sum()
    lagged_cap = market_cap.shift(1).where(market_cap.shift(1) > 0.0)
    allocation = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
    for columns in groups.values():
        if len(columns) < 3:
            continue
        group_activity = activity[columns]
        group_cap = lagged_cap[columns]
        activity_share = group_activity.div(group_activity.sum(axis=1).replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0)
        cap_share = group_cap.div(group_cap.sum(axis=1).replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0)
        allocation.loc[:, columns] = np.log(cap_share.div(activity_share.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(cap_share.div(activity_share.replace(0.0, np.nan)) > 1.0)).clip(0.0, np.log(4.0)).fillna(0.0)
    return np.sqrt(own_drought.fillna(0.0) * allocation)

@register_factor
class CashConfirmedSparseAttentionPeerAssimilation(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = 'cash_confirmed_sparse_attention_peer_assimilatio_1'
    name = 'Cash-Confirmed Sparse-Attention Peer Assimilation'
    category = 'sentiment'
    description = 'Cash-confirmed residual estimate revisions are traded only when a sparse-attention stock underreacts to a broad, directionally aligned industry shock.'
    window_length = 45
    inputs = ['close', 'volume', 'marketCap', 'industry', 'epsActual', 'revenueActual', 'epsEstimate', 'revenueEstimate', 'epsSurprise', 'revenueSurprise', 'operatingCashFlowGrowth']
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data['close']
        volume = data['volume'].reindex_like(close)
        groups = _groups(data['industry'].reindex_like(close))
        eps_actual = data['epsActual'].reindex_like(close)
        revenue_actual = data['revenueActual'].reindex_like(close)
        event = eps_actual.notna() & eps_actual.ne(eps_actual.shift(1)) | revenue_actual.notna() & revenue_actual.ne(revenue_actual.shift(1))
        eps_est = data['epsEstimate'].reindex_like(close)
        sales_est = data['revenueEstimate'].reindex_like(close)
        eps_lag = eps_est.shift(19)
        sales_lag = sales_est.shift(22)
        eps_revision = ((eps_est - eps_lag) / eps_lag.abs()).where(eps_est.notna() & eps_lag.notna() & eps_lag.abs().ge(0.01))
        sales_revision = ((sales_est - sales_lag) / sales_lag.abs()).where(sales_est.notna() & sales_lag.notna() & sales_lag.abs().ge(1000000.0))
        residual = _industry_revision_residual(_cs_zscore(eps_revision), _cs_zscore(sales_revision), groups)
        eps_surprise = data['epsSurprise'].reindex_like(close)
        sales_surprise = data['revenueSurprise'].reindex_like(close)
        cash_growth = data['operatingCashFlowGrowth'].reindex_like(close)
        eps_z = _cs_zscore((eps_surprise / eps_est.abs().clip(lower=0.05)).where(event))
        sales_z = _cs_zscore((sales_surprise / sales_est.abs().clip(lower=1000000.0)).where(event))
        cash_z = _cs_zscore(cash_growth.where(event))
        positive = eps_z.gt(0.0) & sales_z.gt(0.0) & cash_z.gt(0.0)
        negative = eps_z.lt(0.0) & sales_z.lt(0.0) & cash_z.lt(0.0)
        confirmation = positive.astype(float) - negative.astype(float)
        strength = pd.concat([eps_z.abs(), sales_z.abs(), cash_z.abs()]).groupby(level=0).min().reindex_like(close)
        previous_close = close.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        stock_ret = close.div(previous_close).sub(1.0).where(close.gt(0.0) & previous_close.notna())
        peer_ret, breadth = _excluded_peer_returns(stock_ret, groups)
        beta = _prior_beta(stock_ret, peer_ret).clip(-2.0, 2.0).fillna(1.0)
        response_gap = beta * peer_ret - stock_ret
        peer_baseline = peer_ret.abs().shift(1).rolling(28, min_periods=10).median()
        shock = peer_ret.abs().div(peer_baseline.replace(0.0, np.nan)).sub(1.0).clip(0.0, 3.0)
        broadness = shock * breadth.clip(0.0, 1.0)
        attention = _attention_deficit(close, volume, data['marketCap'].reindex_like(close), groups)
        volatility = stock_ret.rolling(21, min_periods=15).std()
        immediate_reaction = stock_ret.abs().div(volatility.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        muted_weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + immediate_reaction.clip(lower=0.0))
        aligned = confirmation.mul(residual).gt(0.0) & confirmation.mul(response_gap).gt(0.0)
        raw = response_gap * strength * residual.abs() * attention * broadness * muted_weight
        active = event & aligned & attention.gt(0.0) & broadness.gt(0.0) & raw.notna()
        return rank(raw.where(active)).reindex_like(close).fillna(0.0)
