from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _leave_one_out_impulse(
    ret: pd.DataFrame, industry_codes: np.ndarray
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Causal leave-one-out peer returns and broad contemporaneous impulses."""
    values = ret.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
    n_rows, n_cols = values.shape
    peer_values = np.full((n_rows, n_cols), np.nan, dtype=float)
    broad_values = np.zeros((n_rows, n_cols), dtype=bool)

    for code in np.unique(industry_codes[industry_codes >= 0]):
        members = np.flatnonzero(industry_codes == code)
        if members.size < 8:
            continue

        group = values[:, members]
        valid = np.isfinite(group)
        count = valid.sum(axis=1)
        total = np.where(valid, group, 0.0).sum(axis=1)
        mean = np.divide(
            total,
            count,
            out=np.full(n_rows, np.nan, dtype=float),
            where=count > 0,
        )
        direction = np.sign(mean)
        concordant = ((np.sign(group) == direction[:, None]) & valid).sum(axis=1)
        breadth = np.divide(
            concordant,
            count,
            out=np.zeros(n_rows, dtype=float),
            where=count > 0,
        )

        peer_count = count[:, None] - valid.astype(int)
        peer = np.divide(
            total[:, None] - np.where(valid, group, 0.0),
            peer_count,
            out=np.full_like(group, np.nan, dtype=float),
            where=valid & (peer_count >= 7),
        )
        peer_values[:, members] = peer

        broad = (
            (count >= 8)
            & (direction != 0.0)
            & (breadth >= 0.75)
            & (np.abs(mean) >= 0.006)
        )
        broad_values[:, members] = valid & broad[:, None] & np.isfinite(peer)

    return (
        pd.DataFrame(peer_values, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns),
        pd.DataFrame(broad_values, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns),
    )


@register_factor
class CashValidatedImpulseDecayBacklog(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "cash_validated_impulse_decay_backlog"
    name = "Cash-Validated Impulse Decay Backlog"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Cash-confirmed reporting news is traded in the report direction when a "
        "persistent accelerating peer impulse leaves a beta-adjusted three-bar "
        "response backlog in a low-turnover name whose participation is decaying."
    )
    window_length = 80
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "marketCap",
        "industry",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "operatingCashFlowGrowth",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].astype(float)
        volume = data["volume"].astype(float).reindex_like(close)
        market_cap = data["marketCap"].astype(float).reindex_like(close)

        valid_close = (close > 0.0) & (close.shift(1) > 0.0)
        ret = (close / close.shift(1) - 1.0).where(valid_close)

        eps_actual = data["epsActual"].astype(float).reindex_like(close)
        revenue_actual = data["revenueActual"].astype(float).reindex_like(close)
        event = (
            (eps_actual.notna() & eps_actual.ne(eps_actual.shift(1)))
            | (revenue_actual.notna() & revenue_actual.ne(revenue_actual.shift(1)))
        )

        eps_surprise = data["epsSurprise"].astype(float).reindex_like(close)
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"].astype(float).reindex_like(close)
        revenue_surprise = data["revenueSurprise"].astype(float).reindex_like(close)
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"].astype(float).reindex_like(close)
        cash_growth = data["operatingCashFlowGrowth"].astype(float).reindex_like(close)

        eps_scaled = eps_surprise / eps_estimate.abs().clip(lower=0.05)
        revenue_scaled = revenue_surprise / revenue_estimate.abs().clip(lower=1000000.0)
        cash_scaled = cash_growth.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(-5.0, 5.0)

        positive = (eps_scaled > 0.0) & (revenue_scaled > 0.0) & (cash_scaled > 0.0)
        negative = (eps_scaled < 0.0) & (revenue_scaled < 0.0) & (cash_scaled < 0.0)
        report_direction = positive.astype(float) - negative.astype(float)
        event_direction = report_direction.where(event, 0.0)
        recent_direction = np.sign(event_direction.rolling(3, min_periods=1).sum())
        recent_event = event.rolling(3, min_periods=1).max().astype(bool)

        eps_strength = eps_scaled.abs().clip(upper=5.0)
        revenue_strength = revenue_scaled.abs().clip(upper=5.0)
        cash_strength = cash_scaled.abs().clip(upper=5.0)
        conviction = np.minimum(np.minimum(eps_strength, revenue_strength), cash_strength)
        recent_conviction = conviction.where(event).rolling(3, min_periods=1).max()

        labels = data["industry"].reindex_like(close).iloc[0].to_numpy(dtype=object)
        industry_codes, _ = pd.factorize(labels, sort=False)
        peer_return, broad_peer = _leave_one_out_impulse(ret, industry_codes)

        peer_direction = np.sign(peer_return)
        persistent = (
            (peer_direction != 0.0)
            & (peer_direction == peer_direction.shift(1))
            & (peer_direction == peer_direction.shift(2))
        )
        peer_baseline = peer_return.abs().rolling(15, min_periods=10).mean()
        accelerating = (
            (peer_return.abs() >= 1.15 * peer_baseline)
            & (peer_return.abs() >= 0.006)
        )
        propagation = broad_peer & persistent & accelerating

        lagged_ret = ret.shift(1)
        lagged_peer = peer_return.shift(1)
        paired = (lagged_ret.notna() & lagged_peer.notna()).astype(float)
        paired_count = paired.rolling(60, min_periods=40).sum()
        covariance = lagged_ret.rolling(60, min_periods=40).cov(lagged_peer)
        variance = lagged_peer.rolling(60, min_periods=40).var()
        beta = (covariance / variance.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(paired_count >= 40)
        beta = beta.clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0)

        cumulative_peer = peer_return.rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum()
        cumulative_ret = ret.rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum()
        backlog = beta * cumulative_peer - cumulative_ret
        normalized_backlog = backlog / cumulative_peer.abs().clip(lower=0.008)
        signed_backlog = recent_direction * normalized_backlog.clip(-2.0, 2.0)

        turnover = (close * volume / market_cap).where(
            (close > 0.0) & (volume > 0.0) & (market_cap > 0.0)
        )
        slow_turnover = turnover.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
        recent_turnover = turnover.rolling(3, min_periods=2).mean()
        participation_decay = recent_turnover <= slow_turnover
        liquidity_rank = slow_turnover.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        sparse = liquidity_rank <= 0.35

        aligned = np.sign(peer_return) == recent_direction
        residual = ret - beta * peer_return
        eligible = (
            recent_event
            & (recent_direction != 0.0)
            & (recent_conviction > 0.0)
            & propagation
            & aligned
            & beta.notna()
            & sparse
            & participation_decay
            & (residual.abs() <= 0.04)
        )

        signal = recent_direction * recent_conviction * signed_backlog
        return signal.where(eligible, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Cash-Validated Impulse Decay Backlog
programs.trading_idea: A cash-confirmed earnings surprise makes a firm's directional information credible, while a broad, persistent and accelerating industry impulse indicates that the same information is still propagating through peers. The child targets firms whose own multi-day beta-adjusted response remains behind the cumulative peer move specifically when their trading participation is decaying below normal after the report, a state in which sparse-liquidity price discovery is least able to clear the remaining backlog. Parent A lacks a firm-level credibility anchor and parent B primarily tests contemporaneous quietness; the interaction identifies validated news whose peer transmission persists after issuer-specific attention has faded.
programs.description: The signal measures a three-bar beta-adjusted peer-response backlog following a recent cash-confirmed earnings and revenue surprise, conditional on broad accelerating industry propagation and declining low-turnover participation. It is signed in the validated report direction, so laggards are bought or sold toward the peer-implied response while overreactors receive the opposite sign.

programs.code:
"""The signal tests a restricted, observable version of temporary price-pressure reversal rather than attributing estimate changes to taxes or claiming unobservable hedge use. After an industry-wide selloff, stocks that had been relatively resilient beforehand but then experience a concentrated idiosyncratic decline can rebound when the final day's high participation has low realized price impact and closes away from the low. The distinguishing interaction is the ordered sequence of pre-shock relative resilience, prior industry shock, and subsequent idiosyncratic pressure with contemporaneous absorption diagnostics; it does not combine estimate, tax, or balance-sheet gates."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _industry_labels(industry: pd.DataFrame) -> list[object]:
    """Return the static industry labels represented in the panel."""
    values = pd.unique(industry.to_numpy().ravel())
    return [value for value in values if pd.notna(value)]


def _industry_returns(
    stock_returns: pd.DataFrame,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
    industry: pd.DataFrame,
    labels: list[object],
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute equal-weight industry returns using the signal-date eligible set.

    A group observation is unavailable unless it has at least five eligible
    names.  The stock return supplied to this helper may span historical dates,
    but membership and eligibility are evaluated at the current signal date.
    """
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=stock_returns.index, columns=labels)
    for label in labels:
        members = industry.eq(label) & eligible
        member_count = members.sum(axis=1)
        group_return = stock_returns.where(members).mean(axis=1)
        result[label] = group_return.where(member_count.ge(5))
    return result


def _map_industry_values(
    group_values: pd.DataFrame,
    industry: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Broadcast one industry-level value back to every ticker in that industry."""
    mapped = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=industry.index, columns=industry.columns)
    for label in group_values.columns:
        values = np.broadcast_to(
            group_values[label].to_numpy()[:, None], industry.shape
        )
        replacement = pd.DataFrame(values, index=industry.index, columns=industry.columns)
        mapped = mapped.where(~industry.eq(label), replacement)
    return mapped


@register_factor
class TaxShelterBasketAbsorptionRepair(BaseFactor):
    """Sequential industry-shock absorption repair after concentrated selling."""

    factor_id = "tax_shelter_basket_absorption_repair"
    name = "Sequential Industry-Shock Absorption Repair"
    category = "mean_reversion"
    description = (
        "Long stocks that were relatively resilient before a bottom-decile "
        "industry selloff, then suffered a negative idiosyncratic decline with "
        "high participation, low range per abnormal volume, and a strong close."
    )
    window_length = 24
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        industry = data["industry"]

        # Eligibility requires all specified inputs to have been observable on
        # every bar from t-23 through t.  The trailing count is causal.
        observed = (
            close.notna()
            & high.notna()
            & low.notna()
            & volume.notna()
            & industry.notna()
        )
        eligible = observed.astype(float).rolling(24, min_periods=24).sum().eq(24)

        labels = _industry_labels(industry)
        if not labels:
            return pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

        safe_close = close.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        # Returns are measured directly over the ordered dates in the design;
        # no shifted industry aggregate is used because eligibility is defined
        # at the current signal date t.
        pre_stock_return = close / safe_close.shift(11) - 1.0
        pre_stock_return = pre_stock_return.shift(7) * 0.0 + (close.shift(7) / safe_close.shift(11) - 1.0)
        # The explicit construction above is equivalent to close[t-7]/close[t-11]-1
        # and retains normal DataFrame alignment under sparse panels.
        pre_stock_return = close.shift(7) / safe_close.shift(11) - 1.0

        shock_stock_return = close.shift(3) / safe_close.shift(7) - 1.0
        post_stock_return = close / safe_close.shift(3) - 1.0

        pre_industry = _industry_returns(
            pre_stock_return, eligible, industry, labels
        )
        shock_industry = _industry_returns(
            shock_stock_return, eligible, industry, labels
        )
        post_industry = _industry_returns(
            post_stock_return, eligible, industry, labels
        )

        mapped_pre_industry = _map_industry_values(pre_industry, industry)
        mapped_post_industry = _map_industry_values(post_industry, industry)

        resilience = pre_stock_return - mapped_pre_industry
        idiosyncratic_drop = post_stock_return - mapped_post_industry

        resilience_rank = resilience.where(eligible).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        drop_rank = idiosyncratic_drop.where(eligible).rank(axis=1, pct=True)

        # Industry percentile ranks are taken once per industry, rather than
        # repeatedly weighting an industry's shock by its constituent count.
        shock_rank = shock_industry.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        mapped_shock_rank = _map_industry_values(shock_rank, industry)

        baseline_volume = volume.shift(4).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        abnormal_volume = volume / baseline_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        abnormal_volume_rank = abnormal_volume.where(eligible).rank(axis=1, pct=True)

        daily_range = high - low
        range_per_abnormal_volume = (
            daily_range / safe_close.shift(1)
        ) / abnormal_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        range_volume_rank = (
            range_per_abnormal_volume.where(eligible).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        )

        close_location = (close - low) / daily_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        close_location = close_location.where(daily_range.ne(0.0), 0.50)

        qualifies = (
            eligible
            & mapped_shock_rank.le(0.10)
            & resilience_rank.ge(0.70)
            & drop_rank.le(0.20)
            & idiosyncratic_drop.lt(0.0)
            & abnormal_volume.ge(1.50)
            & range_volume_rank.le(0.20)
            & close_location.ge(0.60)
        )

        score = (
            resilience_rank
            + (1.0 - drop_rank)
            + abnormal_volume_rank
            + (1.0 - range_volume_rank)
            + close_location
        ) / 5.0

        return score.where(qualifies, 0.0).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Sequential Industry-Shock Absorption Repair
programs.trading_idea: The signal tests a restricted, observable version of temporary price-pressure reversal rather than attributing estimate changes to taxes or claiming unobservable hedge use. After an industry-wide selloff, stocks that had been relatively resilient beforehand but then experience a concentrated idiosyncratic decline can rebound when the final day's high participation has low realized price impact and closes away from the low. The distinguishing interaction is the ordered sequence of pre-shock relative resilience, prior industry shock, and subsequent idiosyncratic pressure with contemporaneous absorption diagnostics; it does not combine estimate, tax, or balance-sheet gates.
programs.description: At signal close t, define the eligible stock universe as tickers with nonmissing close, high, low, volume, and industry labels for bars t-23 through t, and with at least five eligible stocks in their industry. For each industry, calculate equal-weighted close-to-close industry returns using eligible members. Define the industry-shock date as t-3 and its trailing shock return as close[t-3]/close[t-7]-1. An industry is shocked when this return is in the bottom 10% of all eligible industry returns at t-3. Define pre-shock resilience for each stock as its return from t-11 to t-7 minus its industry's equal-weighted return over the same window; normalize it by its cross-sectional percentile rank among all eligible stocks at t, and require rank at or above 0.70. Define the subsequent idiosyncratic-drop return as the stock return from t-3 to t minus its industry return from t-3 to t; normalize it by its cross-sectional percentile rank among eligible stocks and require a rank at or below 0.20 and a negative raw residual return. Define abnormal volume as volume[t] divided by mean volume from t-23 through t-4, requiring a value of at least 1.50. Define range-per-abnormal-volume as ((high[t]-low[t])/close[t-1]) divided by abnormal volume; assign its cross-sectional percentile rank among eligible stocks and require a rank at or below 0.20. Define close location as (close[t]-low[t])/(high[t]-low[t]), set to 0.50 when high[t] equals low[t], and require close location of at least 0.60. The long score is zero unless all conditions hold: shocked industry, resilient pre-shock relative return, subsequent negative idiosyncratic drop, abnormal volume, low range-per-abnormal-volume, and favorable close location. For qualifying names, the score is the average of pre-shock-resilience percentile, one minus idiosyncratic-drop percentile, abnormal-volume percentile, one minus range-per-abnormal-volume percentile, and close location. All ranks are computed only from values available at signal close t. Positions are entered no earlier than the next tradable bar; the six-bar forward return after entry is the outcome, not an input.

programs.code:
"""A concentrated industry repricing can transmit economically relevant peer information, but firms differ in the credibility of reported revenue because unusually rapid receivables growth can indicate weaker cash conversion. The signal does not interpret daily volume or co-movement as identified order-flow contagion; instead, it treats them as observable filters for an industry-specific information event and trades delayed relative incorporation of trade-credit quality. Following positive industry repricing, low-receivables-gap firms that lag peers are bought while high-gap firms that lead peers are sold; following negative repricing, defensive low-gap firms that hold up are bought while high-gap firms that fall disproportionately are sold."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _finite(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return a finite-value mask while preserving panel labels."""
    return pd.DataFrame(
        np.isfinite(frame.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)),
        index=frame.index,
        columns=frame.columns,
    )


def _recent_point_in_time_update(
    frame: pd.DataFrame, freshness_window: int
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Identify values updated at least once in the trailing availability window.

    A forward-filled fundamental update occurs on its first non-missing value or
    whenever its currently available value differs from the preceding value.
    All operations are trailing and therefore causal.
    """
    valid = _finite(frame)
    previous = frame.shift(1)
    previous_valid = _finite(previous)
    changed = frame.ne(previous)
    update = valid & ((~previous_valid) | changed)
    update_count = update.astype(float).rolling(
        freshness_window, min_periods=1
    ).sum()
    return update_count.gt(0.0)


def _unit_gross(weights: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Normalize each non-empty cross-section to unit gross exposure."""
    gross = weights.abs().sum(axis=1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return weights.div(gross, axis=0).fillna(0.0)


@register_factor
class TradeCreditConditionedSectorBurstRepair(BaseFactor):
    """Industry burst read-through conditioned on fresh trade-credit quality."""

    factor_id = "trade_credit_conditioned_sector_burst_repair"
    name = "Trade-Credit Conditioned Industry Read-Through"
    category = "statistical_arbitrage"
    description = (
        "Builds dollar-neutral industry sleeves after concentrated, high-volume "
        "industry repricings, buying low receivables-growth-gap laggards and "
        "selling high-gap leaders, with signs reversed appropriately after "
        "negative industry events."
    )
    window_length = 127
    inputs = ["close", "volume", "industry", "receivablesGrowth", "revenueGrowth"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        receivables_growth = data["receivablesGrowth"]
        revenue_growth = data["revenueGrowth"]
        industry = data["industry"]

        close_valid = _finite(close)
        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        previous_close_valid = _finite(previous_close) & previous_close.ne(0.0)
        ret = (close / previous_close - 1.0).where(
            close_valid & previous_close_valid
        )
        ret = ret.where(_finite(ret))

        valid_volume = volume.where(_finite(volume) & volume.gt(0.0))
        prior_volume = valid_volume.shift(1)
        prior_median = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        abnormal_volume = (valid_volume / prior_median).where(prior_median.gt(0.0))
        abnormal_volume = abnormal_volume.where(_finite(abnormal_volume))

        receivables_valid = _finite(receivables_growth)
        revenue_valid = _finite(revenue_growth)
        fresh_receivables = _recent_point_in_time_update(receivables_growth, 126)
        fresh_revenue = _recent_point_in_time_update(revenue_growth, 126)
        fundamental_valid = (
            receivables_valid
            & revenue_valid
            & fresh_receivables
            & fresh_revenue
        )
        credit_gap = (receivables_growth - revenue_growth).where(fundamental_valid)
        credit_gap = credit_gap.where(_finite(credit_gap))
        fundamental_valid = fundamental_valid & credit_gap.notna()

        # Industry labels are static by contract; the first row avoids using a
        # future time-varying observation if a feed represents them as a panel.
        labels = industry.iloc[0].reindex(close.columns)

        market_return = ret.median(axis=1, skipna=True)
        market_return_valid_count = ret.notna().sum(axis=1)
        market_sign = np.sign(market_return)
        same_market_sign = ret.eq(market_sign, axis=0) & ret.notna()
        market_same_sign_fraction = same_market_sign.sum(axis=1).div(
            market_return_valid_count.replace(0, np.nan)
        )
        market_abnormal_volume = abnormal_volume.median(axis=1, skipna=True)
        market_shock = market_return.abs().ge(0.015) | (
            market_same_sign_fraction.ge(0.70)
            & market_abnormal_volume.ge(1.40)
        )
        market_shock = market_shock.fillna(False)

        new_book = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

        for group in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
            members = labels.index[labels.eq(group)]
            if len(members) == 0:
                continue

            group_ret = ret.loc[:, members]
            group_av = abnormal_volume.loc[:, members]
            group_fundamental_valid = fundamental_valid.loc[:, members]
            group_gap = credit_gap.loc[:, members]

            fundamental_count = group_fundamental_valid.sum(axis=1)
            return_av_count = (group_ret.notna() & group_av.notna()).sum(axis=1)
            industry_return = group_ret.median(axis=1, skipna=True)
            industry_av = group_av.median(axis=1, skipna=True)

            valid_return_count = group_ret.notna().sum(axis=1)
            same_industry_sign = group_ret.eq(np.sign(industry_return), axis=0)
            same_industry_sign = same_industry_sign & group_ret.notna()
            sign_fraction = same_industry_sign.sum(axis=1).div(
                valid_return_count.replace(0, np.nan)
            )

            event = (
                fundamental_count.ge(12)
                & return_av_count.ge(12)
                & industry_return.abs().ge(0.010)
                & industry_av.ge(1.50)
                & sign_fraction.ge(0.75)
                & (~market_shock)
            ).fillna(False)

            gap_rank = group_gap.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
            relative_impact = group_ret.sub(industry_return, axis=0)
            impact_rank = relative_impact.rank(axis=1, pct=True)

            positive_event = event & industry_return.gt(0.0)
            negative_event = event & industry_return.lt(0.0)

            low_gap = gap_rank.le(0.33) & group_fundamental_valid
            high_gap = gap_rank.ge(0.67) & group_fundamental_valid
            impact_lag = impact_rank.le(0.35) & group_ret.notna()
            impact_lead = impact_rank.ge(0.65) & group_ret.notna()

            long_candidates = (
                (positive_event.to_frame().reindex(columns=members).astype(bool) & low_gap & impact_lag)
                | (negative_event.to_frame().reindex(columns=members).astype(bool) & low_gap & impact_lead)
            )
            short_candidates = (
                (positive_event.to_frame().reindex(columns=members).astype(bool) & high_gap & impact_lead)
                | (negative_event.to_frame().reindex(columns=members).astype(bool) & high_gap & impact_lag)
            )

            long_count = long_candidates.sum(axis=1)
            short_count = short_candidates.sum(axis=1)
            tradable = event & long_count.ge(2) & short_count.ge(2)

            long_weight = long_candidates.astype(float).div(
                long_count.replace(0, np.nan), axis=0
            ) * 0.5
            short_weight = -short_candidates.astype(float).div(
                short_count.replace(0, np.nan), axis=0
            ) * 0.5
            sleeve = (long_weight + short_weight).where(tradable, 0.0).fillna(0.0)
            new_book.loc[:, members] = new_book.loc[:, members] + sleeve

        # Every traded industry sleeve has unit gross by construction.  The new
        # daily aggregate is first normalized across active industries, then a
        # sleeve becomes live at the following open and remains for six bars.
        new_book = _unit_gross(new_book)
        live_sum = new_book.shift(1).rolling(6, min_periods=1).sum()
        return _unit_gross(live_sum).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Trade-Credit Conditioned Industry Read-Through
programs.trading_idea: A concentrated industry repricing can transmit economically relevant peer information, but firms differ in the credibility of reported revenue because unusually rapid receivables growth can indicate weaker cash conversion. The signal does not interpret daily volume or co-movement as identified order-flow contagion; instead, it treats them as observable filters for an industry-specific information event and trades delayed relative incorporation of trade-credit quality. Following positive industry repricing, low-receivables-gap firms that lag peers are bought while high-gap firms that lead peers are sold; following negative repricing, defensive low-gap firms that hold up are bought while high-gap firms that fall disproportionately are sold.
programs.description: At the completed close of day t, define stock return r_i,t = close_i,t / close_i,t-1 - 1. Define abnormal volume AV_i,t = volume_i,t / median(volume_i,t-20:t-1), requiring at least 15 non-missing prior observations; otherwise AV is missing. Fundamental trade-credit gap is G_i,t = receivablesGrowth_i,t - revenueGrowth_i,t, using the supplied point-in-time quarterly growth fields without shifting. Both inputs must be non-missing, finite, and have had a detectable point-in-time update within the prior 126 trading sessions, where the update date is the most recent date on which the forward-filled field first became non-missing or changed from its prior available value; names failing this freshness test receive no signal. Within each static industry, among names passing the fundamental-validity test, compute the percentile rank g_i,t of G_i,t, with higher rank denoting worse receivables growth relative to sales growth. An industry is eligible only if it contains at least 12 fundamentally valid names and at least 12 names with valid returns and abnormal volume on t. For each eligible industry j, calculate R_j,t as the equal-weighted median of member returns, A_j,t as the median member abnormal volume, and S_j,t as the fraction of valid-return members whose return has the sign of R_j,t. Industry j is a burst/event industry only when |R_j,t| >= 1.0%, A_j,t >= 1.50, and S_j,t >= 0.75. Exclude all signals on a broad-market shock day, defined as either |median_i(r_i,t)| >= 1.5%, or both the market-wide same-sign fraction relative to median_i(r_i,t) is at least 0.70 and median_i(AV_i,t) is at least 1.40. For each stock in a qualifying industry, define relative impact x_i,t = r_i,t - R_j,t and rank x_i,t within its industry among valid-return members. On a positive industry event (R_j,t > 0), the long set contains stocks with g_i,t <= 0.33 and impact-rank(x_i,t) <= 0.35; the short set contains stocks with g_i,t >= 0.67 and impact-rank(x_i,t) >= 0.65. On a negative industry event (R_j,t < 0), the long set contains stocks with g_i,t <= 0.33 and impact-rank(x_i,t) >= 0.65; the short set contains stocks with g_i,t >= 0.67 and impact-rank(x_i,t) <= 0.35. A qualifying industry is traded only if it has at least two long and two short candidates. Within each traded industry, assign equal positive weights summing to +0.5 across its long candidates and equal negative weights summing to -0.5 across its short candidates, making every industry sleeve dollar-neutral. Scale each active industry sleeve to equal gross exposure, then scale the aggregate book to unit gross exposure; non-qualifying names have zero weight. Form a new sleeve after each completed daily bar. Execute no earlier than the next session open, t+1 open, and close each sleeve at t+7 open, producing a fixed six-bar holding interval; daily sleeves overlap, and the live portfolio is the equal-gross average of unexpired sleeves. Missing data, insufficient industry membership, stale fundamentals, or a market-shock exclusion result in no new position rather than imputation.

"""Unaccepted flow excitation conditioned on a lagged range-acceptance state.

Mechanism: accelerating signed volume surprises proxy for latent directional demand.
A high-volume bar whose following close reaches the same directional range endpoint
is treated as accepted/exhausted pressure; unaccepted excitation with little prior
price displacement is instead expected to continue over the next six bars.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _finite_positive(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return df.gt(0.0) & np.isfinite(df)


def _excitation_state(impulse: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal fast-minus-slow exponential pressure state."""
    clean = impulse.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    fast = clean.ewm(alpha=0.45, adjust=False).mean()
    slow = clean.ewm(alpha=0.10, adjust=False).mean()
    return fast - slow


@register_factor
class UnacceptedExcitationPhaseContinuation(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "unaccepted_excitation_phase_continuation"
    name = "Unaccepted Excitation Continuation"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Signed volume-surprise excitation is retained when its recent price "
        "displacement is small, but discounted when a lagged high-volume bar "
        "is subsequently accepted at the directional range endpoint."
    )
    window_length = 35
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        high = data["high"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        low = data["low"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        open_ = data["open"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        valid_return = (
            _finite_positive(close)
            & _finite_positive(prior_close)
            & _finite_positive(volume)
        )
        raw_ret = np.log(close / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        valid_return = valid_return & np.isfinite(raw_ret) & raw_ret.abs().le(np.log(1.5))
        ret = raw_ret.clip(-0.20, 0.20).where(valid_return, 0.0)

        prior_volume = volume.shift(1).where(volume.shift(1).gt(0.0))
        volume_median = prior_volume.rolling(15, min_periods=10).median()
        volume_ready = volume_median.gt(0.0)
        volume_surprise = np.log(volume / volume_median.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        volume_surprise = volume_surprise.clip(0.0, 3.0).where(
            valid_return & volume_ready, 0.0
        ).fillna(0.0)

        signed_impulse = np.sign(ret) * volume_surprise
        excitation = _excitation_state(signed_impulse)

        displacement = ret + ret.shift(1).fillna(0.0) + ret.shift(2).fillna(0.0)
        amplitude = ret.abs().shift(1).rolling(15, min_periods=10).median().clip(lower=0.002)
        realized_fraction = (
            np.sign(excitation) * displacement /
            (3.0 * amplitude.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        ).clip(0.0, 1.0)
        displacement_gap = (1.0 - realized_fraction).fillna(0.0)

        bar_range = high - low
        close_location = (2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        opening_gap = (open_ / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0).abs()
        phase_valid = (
            bar_range.gt(0.0)
            & close_location.notna()
            & opening_gap.le(0.05)
            & volume_ready.shift(1).fillna(False)
        )

        log_volume = np.log1p(volume.where(volume.gt(0.0)))
        prior_log_volume = log_volume.shift(1)
        log_mean = prior_log_volume.rolling(15, min_periods=10).mean()
        log_std = prior_log_volume.rolling(15, min_periods=10).std()
        excess_volume = ((log_volume - log_mean) / log_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-3.0, 3.0)

        # Parent-B state: prior excess activity followed by today's range endpoint.
        # Align it with the current excitation direction; positive alignment means
        # pressure has already been visibly accepted and is therefore discounted.
        directional_acceptance = (
            np.sign(excitation)
            * excess_volume.shift(1).clip(lower=0.0)
            * close_location
        )
        phase_discount = 1.0 - directional_acceptance.clip(0.0, 1.0)
        phase_discount = phase_discount.where(phase_valid, 1.0).fillna(1.0)

        dollar_volume = (close * volume).where(_finite_positive(close) & _finite_positive(volume))
        liquidity = dollar_volume.shift(1).rolling(15, min_periods=10).mean()
        eligible = (
            valid_return
            & volume_ready
            & amplitude.notna()
            & liquidity.ge(1_000_000.0)
            & np.isfinite(excitation)
        )

        raw_score = (excitation * displacement_gap * phase_discount).where(eligible)
        lower = raw_score.quantile(0.025, axis=1)
        upper = raw_score.quantile(0.975, axis=1)
        clipped = raw_score.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)
        return clipped.rank(axis=1, pct=True).where(eligible)
programs.name: Unaccepted Excitation Continuation
programs.trading_idea: The child treats Parent A's accelerating signed volume-surprise intensity as latent order-flow pressure, but conditions it on Parent B's lagged volume-to-close-location phase. A prior high-volume bar followed by a close near the directional range endpoint indicates that the pressure has already been accepted into price and, consistent with Parent B's realized negative six-bar sign, is more likely an exhausted inventory-release endpoint than fresh continuation. Conversely, accelerating pressure with modest cumulative displacement and weak or opposite directional close-location confirmation identifies an unaccepted flow backlog whose subsequent price adjustment can occur over the fixed six-bar horizon.
programs.description: Ranks signed fast-minus-slow volume-surprise excitation after discounting already-realized three-bar displacement and discounting lagged high-volume bars whose next-bar close location confirms the current pressure direction. The phase discount is only active for liquid, valid OHLCV observations and otherwise leaves the latent excitation signal intact.

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_mean(values: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    valid = values.notna().astype(float)
    numerator = values.fillna(0.0).T.groupby(labels, sort=False).transform("sum").T
    denominator = valid.T.groupby(labels, sort=False).transform("sum").T
    return numerator / denominator.replace(0.0, np.nan)


def _sector_rank(values: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return values.T.groupby(labels, sort=False).rank(pct=True).T


def _prior_std(values: pd.DataFrame, window: int, minimum: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return values.shift(1).rolling(window, min_periods=minimum).std()


@register_factor
class SectorFragilityHawkesReliefTransitionFade(BaseFactor):
    """Fade decaying relief-flow clusters during fragile sector deleveraging."""

    factor_id = "sector_fragility_hawkes_relief_transition_fade"
    name = "Fragile Sector Relief-Transition Fade"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks fragile stocks whose prior self-exciting, high-volume relief flow "
        "has become impact-inefficient and is now reversing during an active "
        "sector deleveraging episode; high values predict lower six-bar returns."
    )
    window_length = 30
    inputs = [
        "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector",
        "cashRatio", "debtToAssets"
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        open_price = data["open"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        high = data["high"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        low = data["low"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        labels = data["sector"].iloc[0].reindex(close.columns).fillna("Unknown")
        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        ret = np.log((close / previous_close).where(close.gt(0.0) & previous_close.gt(0.0)))

        sigma = _prior_std(ret, 15, 5).clip(lower=0.004).fillna(0.02)
        volume_base = volume.shift(1).rolling(15, min_periods=5).mean()
        rvol = (volume / volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0, upper=6.0)
        rvol = rvol.fillna(1.0)

        bar_range = high - low
        close_location = (2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        close_location = close_location.where(bar_range.ne(0.0), 0.0).clip(-1.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)
        intraday = np.log((close / open_price).where(close.gt(0.0) & open_price.gt(0.0))).fillna(0.0)

        standardized_return = (ret / sigma).clip(-5.0, 5.0).fillna(0.0)
        directional_pressure = np.tanh(standardized_return) * rvol
        positive_mark = directional_pressure.clip(lower=0.0) * (0.5 + 0.5 * close_location)
        positive_mark = positive_mark.clip(lower=0.0, upper=6.0)

        fast_intensity = positive_mark.ewm(halflife=3, adjust=False, min_periods=1).mean()
        slow_intensity = positive_mark.ewm(halflife=12, adjust=False, min_periods=1).mean()
        prior_fast = fast_intensity.shift(1).fillna(0.0)
        prior_slow = slow_intensity.shift(1).fillna(0.0)
        excitation = ((prior_fast - prior_slow) / (prior_slow + 0.10)).clip(lower=0.0, upper=4.0)
        persistent_relief = prior_fast.clip(lower=0.0, upper=4.0)

        impact_efficiency = ret.abs() / rvol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        weighted_efficiency = impact_efficiency.where(positive_mark.gt(0.05))
        weighted_value = weighted_efficiency.fillna(0.0) * positive_mark
        fast_eff = weighted_value.ewm(halflife=3, adjust=False, min_periods=1).mean() / positive_mark.ewm(halflife=3, adjust=False, min_periods=1).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        slow_eff = weighted_value.ewm(halflife=12, adjust=False, min_periods=1).mean() / positive_mark.ewm(halflife=12, adjust=False, min_periods=1).mean().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        efficiency_decay = ((slow_eff.shift(1) - fast_eff.shift(1)) / slow_eff.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan))
        efficiency_decay = efficiency_decay.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.5).fillna(0.0)

        downside_confirmation = (-standardized_return).clip(lower=0.0, upper=4.0)
        intraday_rejection = (-intraday / sigma).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)
        confirmation = (0.7 * downside_confirmation + 0.3 * intraday_rejection).clip(upper=4.0)

        sector_return = _sector_mean(ret, labels).fillna(0.0)
        sector_drawdown = (-sector_return.rolling(3, min_periods=1).sum()).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.20)
        sector_activity = _sector_mean(np.log1p(rvol), labels).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0).fillna(0.0)
        sector_stress = sector_drawdown * (1.0 + sector_activity)

        cash_ratio = data["cashRatio"].where(data["cashRatio"].ge(0.0))
        debt_to_assets = data["debtToAssets"].where(data["debtToAssets"].ge(0.0))
        fragility = (
            1.0 - _sector_rank(cash_ratio, labels) + _sector_rank(debt_to_assets, labels)
        ) / 2.0
        fragility = fragility.fillna(0.5).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

        raw = (
            persistent_relief
            * excitation
            * efficiency_decay
            * confirmation
            * sector_stress.fillna(0.0)
            * fragility
        )
        raw = raw.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
        return raw.rank(axis=1, pct=True).fillna(0.5).astype(float)

programs.trading_idea: The signal treats a sector drawdown with abnormal activity as a common deleveraging state, then looks for fragile constituents whose prior high-volume relief buying became self-exciting while its price impact per unit relative volume decayed. A current downside confirmation bar converts that persistent positive-pressure state into a transition signal: inventory absorption has likely exhausted the marginal buyer and sector-level selling can reassert itself. Parent A alone could not reliably distinguish an idiosyncratic burst from a meaningful forced-flow episode, while Parent B's sector-pressure state becomes more actionable when conditioned on an explicit, inefficient and decaying relief-flow sequence.
programs.description: Computes exponentially decayed positive-flow intensities, their acceleration, and a fast-versus-slow deterioration in return-per-relative-volume efficiency. It ranks the resulting downside-transition hazard only when sector deleveraging, sector activity, balance-sheet fragility, and a negative confirmation return coincide.

"""Sector inventory repair switched by confirmed earnings-information diffusion.

A broad but directionless sector volume shock normally reflects temporary basket-flow
inventory pressure.  A fresh, volume-confirmed earnings surprise changes that
interpretation for aligned names: the relative displacement is more likely to be
an under-assimilated information impulse than a mechanical overshoot.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_flow_state(
    ret: pd.DataFrame,
    volume_z: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Broadcast sector return, volume-shock share, and return dispersion.

    All quantities use the completed current bar only.  The function is a
    deterministic cross-sectional grouping operation and has no forward fill
    from later dates.
    """
    sec_ret = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)
    shock_share = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)
    dispersion = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=ret.index, columns=ret.columns)

    for i in range(len(ret.index)):
        labels = sector.iloc[i]
        valid = labels.notna() & ret.iloc[i].notna() & volume_z.iloc[i].notna()
        if not valid.any():
            continue
        for label in pd.unique(labels.loc[valid].dropna()):
            members = labels.index[((labels == label) & valid).to_numpy()]
            values = ret.iloc[i].loc[members].dropna()
            if len(values) < 5:
                continue
            mean_ret = values.mean()
            std_ret = values.std(ddof=1)
            frac = (volume_z.iloc[i].loc[members] >= 1.0).mean()
            if np.isfinite(mean_ret) and np.isfinite(std_ret) and np.isfinite(frac):
                sec_ret.loc[ret.index[i], members] = mean_ret
                dispersion.loc[ret.index[i], members] = std_ret
                shock_share.loc[ret.index[i], members] = frac

    return sec_ret, shock_share, dispersion


def _sector_mean_state(state: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Broadcast same-day sector mean information state, excluding no future data."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=state.index, columns=state.columns)
    for i in range(len(state.index)):
        labels = sector.iloc[i]
        valid = labels.notna() & state.iloc[i].notna()
        if not valid.any():
            continue
        for label in pd.unique(labels.loc[valid].dropna()):
            members = labels.index[((labels == label) & valid).to_numpy()]
            values = state.iloc[i].loc[members]
            if len(values) >= 2:
                result.loc[state.index[i], members] = values.mean()
    return result


def _sector_demean(score: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Sector-demean active scores while preserving a numeric full panel."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=score.index, columns=score.columns)
    for i in range(len(score.index)):
        labels = sector.iloc[i]
        valid = labels.notna() & score.iloc[i].notna()
        if not valid.any():
            continue
        for label in pd.unique(labels.loc[valid].dropna()):
            members = labels.index[((labels == label) & valid).to_numpy()]
            values = score.iloc[i].loc[members]
            if len(values) >= 2:
                output.loc[score.index[i], members] = values - values.mean()
    return output


@register_factor
class SectorSynchronyEarningsStateReversalSwitch(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "sector_synchrony_earnings_state_reversal_switch"
    name = "Sector Synchrony Earnings-State Switch"
    category = "statistical_arbitrage"
    description = (
        "Fades sector-relative moves during broad non-directional volume shocks, "
        "but switches to continuation when the move agrees with a decayed, "
        "volume-confirmed fresh EPS-surprise information state."
    )
    window_length = 61
    inputs = ["close", "volume", "sector", "epsActual", "epsSurprise"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].where(data["close"] > 0.0)
        volume = data["volume"].where(data["volume"] >= 0.0)
        sector = data["sector"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        eps_actual = data["epsActual"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        eps_surprise = data["epsSurprise"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

        ret = np.log(close / close.shift(1)).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        log_volume = np.log1p(volume)
        vol_mean = log_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=12).mean()
        vol_std = log_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=12).std(ddof=1)
        volume_z = (log_volume - vol_mean) / vol_std.where(vol_std > 0.0)
        volume_z = volume_z.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        sector_ret, shock_share, dispersion = _sector_flow_state(ret, volume_z, sector)
        dispersion_base = dispersion.shift(1).rolling(50, min_periods=20).median()
        dispersion_ratio = dispersion / dispersion_base.where(dispersion_base > 0.0)

        # Continuous rather than binary gating preserves coverage and makes the
        # inventory state robust to small changes in the synchrony thresholds.
        breadth = ((shock_share - 0.25) / 0.55).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        dispersion_strength = ((dispersion_ratio - 0.90) / 0.90).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        muted_direction = (1.0 - (sector_ret.abs() / dispersion.where(dispersion > 0.0))).clip(
            lower=0.0, upper=1.0
        )
        flow_state = (breadth * dispersion_strength * muted_direction).fillna(0.0)
        relative_move = (ret - sector_ret).fillna(0.0)

        # Reports are point-in-time.  Using a one-bar lag ensures that the
        # disclosure is public before the confirming trading-bar return is used.
        prior_actual = eps_actual.shift(1)
        fresh = eps_actual.notna() & (prior_actual.isna() | eps_actual.ne(prior_actual))
        surprise_rank = eps_surprise.rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        signed_surprise = (2.0 * surprise_rank - 1.0).where(fresh, 0.0).fillna(0.0)

        event_surprise = signed_surprise.shift(1).fillna(0.0)
        event_volume_ratio = volume / volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=12).median()
        confirmed = (
            (event_surprise * ret > 0.0)
            & (event_volume_ratio >= 0.80)
            & ret.notna()
        )
        impulse = event_surprise.where(confirmed, 0.0).fillna(0.0)
        own_state = impulse.ewm(halflife=8.0, adjust=False, min_periods=1).mean()
        peer_state = _sector_mean_state(own_state, sector)

        own_scale = impulse.abs().rolling(60, min_periods=8).mean().fillna(0.05)
        peer_scale = peer_state.abs().rolling(60, min_periods=8).mean().fillna(0.05)
        information_state = np.tanh(
            0.80 * own_state / own_scale.clip(lower=0.05)
            + 0.45 * peer_state / peer_scale.clip(lower=0.05)
        )

        # In the absence of disclosed information, multiplier=-1 implements
        # Parent A's inventory-repair reversal.  An aligned and sufficiently
        # strong confirmed information state turns that displacement into drift.
        alignment = np.sign(relative_move) * information_state
        continuation_weight = alignment.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        regime_multiplier = -1.0 + 2.0 * continuation_weight
        raw_score = flow_state * relative_move * regime_multiplier

        return _sector_demean(raw_score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan), sector).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Sector Synchrony Earnings-State Switch
programs.trading_idea: Broad, non-directional sector volume shocks with high constituent dispersion normally identify temporary inventory imbalances, so extreme sector-relative moves should reverse. However, a recently confirmed earnings surprise creates a directional information state: when a stock's relative move agrees with that state, the same synchronised attention/volume episode supports gradual information diffusion rather than mechanical repair. The interaction therefore switches the sign of the inventory-repair trade only where fresh disclosed fundamentals plausibly explain the price displacement, avoiding Parent A's tendency to fade informative moves while converting Parent B's sparse event signal into a sector-flow-conditioned six-bar signal.
programs.description: Measures continuous sector volume synchrony, muted sector direction, and abnormal cross-sectional return dispersion, then applies sector-relative reversal unless the move aligns with a decayed, volume-confirmed fresh EPS-surprise state. The output is sector-demeaned and defensively zero-filled when prices, volumes, or report fields are unavailable.

programs.code:
"""This is a conditional short-horizon price-discovery signal rather than a claim that dealer inventory absorption is identified from daily bars. Repeated high-participation, low-range bars with directional close locations indicate that directional trading interest has persisted without proportional daily price movement; a later high-range bar closing in that same direction is treated as confirmation that the earlier price restraint has ended. The empirical prediction is continuation after confirmed directional range release, conditional on the prior compression-and-participation pattern."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_zscore(
    values: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Cross-sectionally z-score releases, using sector groups with >=10 names."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns)

    for row_number, timestamp in enumerate(values.index):
        row = values.iloc[row_number].to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=True)
        labels = sector.iloc[row_number].to_numpy(copy=False)
        eligible = np.isfinite(row)
        eligible_count = int(eligible.sum())
        if eligible_count == 0:
            continue

        full_values = row[eligible]
        full_mean = float(np.mean(full_values))
        full_std = float(np.std(full_values, ddof=0))
        if np.isfinite(full_std) and full_std > 0.0:
            z_row = (row - full_mean) / full_std
        else:
            z_row = np.zeros_like(row, dtype=float)
        z_row[~eligible] = np.nan

        valid_labels = pd.notna(labels)
        for label in pd.unique(labels[eligible & valid_labels]):
            group = eligible & (labels == label)
            group_count = int(group.sum())
            if group_count < 10:
                continue

            group_values = row[group]
            group_mean = float(np.mean(group_values))
            group_std = float(np.std(group_values, ddof=0))
            if np.isfinite(group_std) and group_std > 0.0:
                z_row[group] = (group_values - group_mean) / group_std
            else:
                z_row[group] = 0.0

        output.iloc[row_number] = z_row

    return output


def _decile_dollar_neutral_portfolio(scores: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Select equal-weighted top and bottom score deciles when at least 20 release names exist."""
    portfolio = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=scores.index, columns=scores.columns)

    for row_number in range(len(scores.index)):
        row = scores.iloc[row_number].to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
        eligible_indices = np.flatnonzero(np.isfinite(row))
        count = len(eligible_indices)
        if count < 20:
            continue

        side_size = int(np.floor(0.10 * count))
        if side_size < 1:
            continue

        ordering = np.argsort(row[eligible_indices], kind="mergesort")
        short_indices = eligible_indices[ordering[:side_size]]
        long_indices = eligible_indices[ordering[-side_size:]]

        weights = np.zeros_like(row, dtype=float)
        weights[long_indices] = 1.0 / side_size
        weights[short_indices] = -1.0 / side_size
        portfolio.iloc[row_number] = weights

    return portfolio


@register_factor
class DirectionalAbsorptionReservoirRelease(BaseFactor):
    """Confirmed directional range releases following high-participation compression."""

    factor_id = "directional_absorption_reservoir_release"
    name = "Directional Range-Release Continuation"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Identifies directional reservoirs of high relative volume and low "
        "relative range, then holds a dollar-neutral decile portfolio after a "
        "same-direction high-range release confirms price discovery."
    )
    window_length = 26
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        sector = data["sector"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

        bar_valid = (
            open_.gt(0.0)
            & high.gt(0.0)
            & low.gt(0.0)
            & close.gt(0.0)
            & volume.gt(0.0)
            & high.ge(low)
        )
        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        range_fraction = ((high - low) / previous_close).where(
            bar_valid & previous_close.gt(0.0)
        )
        close_location = (
            2.0 * (close - low) / (high - low) - 1.0
        ).where(high.gt(low), 0.0)
        close_location = close_location.where(bar_valid)

        baseline_volume = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        baseline_range = range_fraction.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        relative_volume = volume / baseline_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        relative_range = range_fraction / baseline_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        current_baseline_valid = (
            baseline_volume.notna()
            & baseline_range.notna()
            & baseline_volume.gt(0.0)
            & baseline_range.gt(0.0)
        )
        candidate_valid = (
            bar_valid
            & current_baseline_valid
            & relative_volume.notna()
            & relative_range.notna()
            & close_location.notna()
        )

        reservoir = (
            candidate_valid
            & relative_volume.ge(1.50)
            & relative_range.le(0.75)
            & close_location.abs().ge(0.50)
        )
        reservoir_value = reservoir.astype(float) * close_location
        reservoir_count = reservoir.astype(float).shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        directional_sum = reservoir_value.shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        all_candidates_valid = (
            candidate_valid.astype(float)
            .shift(1)
            .rolling(5, min_periods=5)
            .sum()
            .eq(5.0)
        )

        direction = np.sign(directional_sum)
        directional_reservoir = (
            all_candidates_valid
            & reservoir_count.ge(3.0)
            & direction.ne(0.0)
            & (directional_sum.abs() / reservoir_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)).ge(0.60)
        )

        dollar_volume = (close * volume).where(bar_valid)
        median_dollar_volume = dollar_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        base_eligible = (
            bar_valid
            & current_baseline_valid
            & median_dollar_volume.notna()
            & median_dollar_volume.gt(0.0)
            & all_candidates_valid
        )
        dollar_volume_rank = median_dollar_volume.where(base_eligible).rank(
            axis=1, pct=True
        )
        liquid_universe = base_eligible & dollar_volume_rank.ge(0.30)

        release = (
            liquid_universe
            & directional_reservoir
            & relative_range.ge(1.50)
            & close_location.abs().ge(0.50)
            & np.sign(close_location).eq(direction)
        )
        reservoir_strength = directional_sum.abs() / reservoir_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        raw = (
            direction
            * (reservoir_count / 5.0)
            * reservoir_strength
            * relative_range.clip(upper=3.0)
        ).where(release)

        lower = raw.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
        upper = raw.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
        winsorized = raw.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0).where(release)
        scores = _sector_zscore(winsorized, sector)
        return _decile_dollar_neutral_portfolio(scores)
programs.name: Directional Range-Release Continuation
programs.trading_idea: This is a conditional short-horizon price-discovery signal rather than a claim that dealer inventory absorption is identified from daily bars. Repeated high-participation, low-range bars with directional close locations indicate that directional trading interest has persisted without proportional daily price movement; a later high-range bar closing in that same direction is treated as confirmation that the earlier price restraint has ended. The empirical prediction is continuation after confirmed directional range release, conditional on the prior compression-and-participation pattern.
programs.description: All quantities are computed separately for stock i at the close of date t using only observations dated t or earlier. Let rnge_q=(high_q-low_q)/close_{q-1}, requiring close_{q-1}>0, and let clv_q=2*(close_q-low_q)/(high_q-low_q)-1 when high_q>low_q; set clv_q=0 for zero-range bars. Define relative volume rv_q=volume_q/median(volume_{q-20},...,volume_{q-1}) and relative range rr_q=rnge_q/median(rnge_{q-20},...,rnge_{q-1}). A prior reservoir bar q is one satisfying rv_q>=1.50, rr_q<=0.75, and abs(clv_q)>=0.50. At t, inspect q in {t-5,...,t-1}. Let N_t be the number of reservoir bars, S_t=sum(reservoir_indicator_q*clv_q), and d_t=sign(S_t). A stock has a valid directional reservoir only if N_t>=3, abs(S_t)/N_t>=0.60, and d_t is nonzero. The current date is a release bar only if rr_t>=1.50, abs(clv_t)>=0.50, and sign(clv_t)=d_t. The raw signed signal is raw_t=d_t*(N_t/5)*(abs(S_t)/N_t)*min(rr_t,3.0) for valid release bars and is missing otherwise; it is not assigned a zero for non-release stocks. This construction uses no future release labeling: the release condition is evaluated on the current bar t itself. Eligibility requires valid positive OHLCV observations, all required 20-bar baseline observations for t and the five reservoir candidates, nonzero baseline median volume and range, and 20-day median dollar volume median(close*volume over t-20 through t-1) in the top 70% of the contemporaneous eligible universe. Missing or invalid observations make the stock ineligible. Each day, winsorize raw_t at the 1st and 99th percentiles among eligible release stocks, then z-score it within sector; sectors with fewer than 10 eligible release stocks use the full eligible-universe z-score instead. Go long the highest-score decile and short the lowest-score decile of eligible release stocks, equal-weighted within side and dollar-neutral; if fewer than 20 eligible release stocks exist, hold no new signal portfolio. The signal is formed after the close of t, and performance is measured from the next bar onward, such as open_{t+1} through close_{t+6}, so no same-bar return is included.
