"""Peer-ignition continuation conditional on persistent endpoint acceptance.

Mechanism: peer flow identifies a contagious order-flow episode, while a stock's
own persistent association between abnormal participation and directional close
placement distinguishes accepted execution from a transient impact burst.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _broadcast_industry_sum(frame: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Broadcast same-date industry sums to all constituent names."""
    grouped = frame.T.groupby(labels, sort=False).sum(min_count=1).T
    result = grouped.reindex(columns=labels.to_numpy())
    result.columns = frame.columns
    return result


@register_factor
class PeerIgnitionEndpointPersistenceCarry(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "peer_ignition_endpoint_persistence_carry"
    name = "Peer-Ignition Endpoint Persistence Carry"
    category = "momentum"
    description = (
        "Directional peer-flow continuation, activated only when the target's "
        "rolling abnormal-volume versus close-endpoint dependence agrees with "
        "the currently peer-ignited direction."
    )
    window_length = 60
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume", "industry"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        industry = data["industry"]

        labels = industry.iloc[0].reindex(close.columns)
        label_mask = pd.DataFrame(
            np.broadcast_to(labels.notna().to_numpy(), close.shape),
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        )

        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        valid = (
            close.gt(0.0)
            & previous_close.gt(0.0)
            & volume.gt(0.0)
            & np.isfinite(close)
            & np.isfinite(volume)
        )
        ret = np.log(close / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        ret = ret.clip(lower=-0.20, upper=0.20).where(valid)

        log_volume = np.log1p(volume.where(volume.ge(0.0)))
        prior_mean = log_volume.shift(1).rolling(40, min_periods=30).mean()
        prior_std = log_volume.shift(1).rolling(40, min_periods=30).std()
        volume_surprise = (log_volume - prior_mean).div(
            prior_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        volume_surprise = volume_surprise.clip(lower=-4.0, upper=4.0)

        price_range = high - low
        endpoint = (2.0 * close - high - low).div(price_range.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        endpoint = endpoint.where(price_range.gt(0.0)).clip(lower=-1.0, upper=1.0)
        endpoint_dependence = volume_surprise.rolling(20, min_periods=15).corr(endpoint)

        volume_base = volume.shift(1).where(volume.shift(1).gt(0.0)).rolling(
            20, min_periods=15
        ).median()
        relative_volume = volume.div(volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        relative_volume = relative_volume.clip(lower=0.0, upper=8.0)

        volatility = ret.abs().shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        volatility = volatility.clip(lower=0.002)
        market_ret = ret.where(label_mask).median(axis=1)
        idio_ret = ret.sub(market_ret, axis=0)
        peer_mark_source = idio_ret.div(volatility.replace(0.0, np.nan)) * np.log1p(
            relative_volume
        )
        peer_mark_source = peer_mark_source.where(valid & label_mask)

        industry_sum = _broadcast_industry_sum(peer_mark_source, labels)
        industry_count = _broadcast_industry_sum(
            peer_mark_source.notna().astype(float), labels
        )
        peer_count = industry_count - peer_mark_source.notna().astype(float)
        peer_mark = (industry_sum - peer_mark_source.fillna(0.0)).div(
            peer_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        peer_intensity = peer_mark.fillna(0.0).ewm(alpha=0.30, adjust=False).mean()

        local_direction = np.sign(ret.rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum())
        ignition_agreement = (local_direction * peer_intensity).clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0)
        endpoint_agreement = (local_direction * endpoint_dependence).clip(
            lower=0.0, upper=1.0
        )

        eligible = (
            valid
            & label_mask
            & peer_count.ge(2.0)
            & local_direction.ne(0.0)
            & ignition_agreement.gt(0.0)
            & endpoint_agreement.gt(0.0)
            & endpoint_dependence.notna()
        )
        raw_score = (
            local_direction * ignition_agreement * endpoint_agreement
        ).where(eligible)
        return rank(raw_score).where(eligible, 0.0).fillna(0.0).reindex_like(close)
programs.name: Peer-Ignition Endpoint Persistence Carry
programs.trading_idea: Industry peer excitation identifies when a move is likely being propagated through related names rather than arising from isolated noise. The child only follows that propagation when the target's current direction agrees with its own persistent abnormal-volume/end-of-range relationship: repeated high-volume closes near the directional endpoint indicate that peer-induced activity is being accepted rather than exhausting. Parent A alone cannot establish that the local execution pattern was externally ignited, while Parent B's peer state alone cannot distinguish durable endpoint acceptance from a transient contagious impulse.
programs.description: Computes leave-one-out industry signed abnormal-volume excitation and conditions its directional continuation score on a rolling within-stock correlation between volume surprises and directional close placement. It is long peer-ignited names whose current direction is confirmed by persistent volume-endpoint acceptance and short the symmetric negative cases.

"""Simultaneous but opposing EPS and revenue estimate revisions create a specific disagreement about future margins or operating leverage: higher EPS with lower revenue implies margin expansion, while lower EPS with higher revenue implies margin deterioration. A sector-relative price response that is both directionally consistent with this implied margin resolution and unusually large relative to sector peers is treated as evidence that investors have resolved the disagreement rather than merely reacted to either revision leg. The signal is deliberately restricted to this EPS-versus-revenue disagreement interaction, rather than using generic confirmation of a consensus revision."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _innovation_zscore(
    innovation: pd.DataFrame, valid_revision: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Standardize an estimate revision against prior nonzero revisions only."""
    nonzero_history = innovation.where(valid_revision & innovation.ne(0.0)).shift(1)
    median = nonzero_history.rolling(252, min_periods=8).median()
    dispersion = nonzero_history.rolling(252, min_periods=8).std()
    zscore = (innovation - median) / dispersion.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return zscore.clip(-5.0, 5.0)


def _sector_relative_zscore(
    response: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causally form leave-one-out sector-relative response z-scores per day."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=response.index, columns=response.columns)
    sector_labels = sector.ffill()

    for row_number in range(len(response.index)):
        values = response.iloc[row_number]
        labels = sector_labels.iloc[row_number]
        valid = values.notna() & labels.notna()
        if not valid.any():
            continue

        valid_values = values.loc[valid]
        valid_labels = labels.loc[valid]
        counts = valid_values.groupby(valid_labels).transform("count")
        sums = valid_values.groupby(valid_labels).transform("sum")
        peer_mean = (sums - valid_values) / (counts - 1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        relative = valid_values - peer_mean

        relative_mean = relative.groupby(valid_labels).transform("mean")
        relative_std = relative.groupby(valid_labels).transform("std")
        zscore = (relative - relative_mean) / relative_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        zscore = zscore.where(counts.ge(10))

        result.iloc[row_number, :] = zscore.reindex(response.columns).to_numpy()

    return result


@register_factor
class ConsensusChannelDiscordancePriceLead(BaseFactor):
    """Margin-resolution price confirmation following opposing estimate revisions."""

    factor_id = "consensus_channel_discordance_price_lead"
    name = "Margin-Resolution Price Lead"
    category = "sentiment"
    description = (
        "Identifies opposing standardized EPS and revenue estimate revisions, then "
        "keeps only sector-relative price responses that strongly confirm the implied "
        "margin-resolution direction after the next full response day."
    )
    window_length = 255
    inputs = ["close", "epsEstimate", "revenueEstimate", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"].reindex_like(close)
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"].reindex_like(close)
        sector = data["sector"].reindex_like(close)

        prior_eps = eps_estimate.shift(1)
        prior_revenue = revenue_estimate.shift(1)

        eps_valid = eps_estimate.notna() & prior_eps.notna()
        revenue_valid = revenue_estimate.notna() & prior_revenue.notna()

        eps_scale = prior_eps.abs().clip(lower=0.01)
        revenue_scale = prior_revenue.abs().clip(lower=1000000.0)
        eps_innovation = (eps_estimate - prior_eps) / eps_scale
        revenue_innovation = (revenue_estimate - prior_revenue) / revenue_scale

        eps_z = _innovation_zscore(eps_innovation, eps_valid)
        revenue_z = _innovation_zscore(revenue_innovation, revenue_valid)

        simultaneous = (
            eps_valid
            & revenue_valid
            & eps_innovation.ne(0.0)
            & revenue_innovation.ne(0.0)
        )
        eligible = (
            simultaneous
            & eps_z.notna()
            & revenue_z.notna()
            & eps_z.mul(revenue_z).lt(0.0)
            & eps_z.abs().ge(1.0)
            & revenue_z.abs().ge(1.0)
        )
        margin_direction = (eps_z - revenue_z) / np.sqrt(2.0)

        # At row u=t+1 this is the fully observed close(t+1)/close(t-1) response.
        response_return = close / close.shift(2) - 1.0
        price_z = _sector_relative_zscore(response_return, sector)

        event_eligible = eligible.shift(1).fillna(False)
        event_direction = margin_direction.shift(1)
        dominant = (
            event_eligible
            & price_z.notna()
            & event_direction.notna()
            & np.sign(price_z).eq(np.sign(event_direction))
            & price_z.abs().ge(np.maximum(1.0, 0.5 * event_direction.abs()))
        )

        return price_z.where(dominant, 0.0).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Margin-Resolution Price Lead
programs.trading_idea: Simultaneous but opposing EPS and revenue estimate revisions create a specific disagreement about future margins or operating leverage: higher EPS with lower revenue implies margin expansion, while lower EPS with higher revenue implies margin deterioration. A sector-relative price response that is both directionally consistent with this implied margin resolution and unusually large relative to sector peers is treated as evidence that investors have resolved the disagreement rather than merely reacted to either revision leg. The signal is deliberately restricted to this EPS-versus-revenue disagreement interaction, rather than using generic confirmation of a consensus revision.
programs.description: At the close of day t, define daily estimate innovations as e_i,t=(epsEstimate_i,t-epsEstimate_i,t-1)/max(abs(epsEstimate_i,t-1),0.01) and v_i,t=(revenueEstimate_i,t-revenueEstimate_i,t-1)/max(abs(revenueEstimate_i,t-1),1000000). A simultaneous revision requires both innovations to be nonzero on the same day t and valid current and prior estimates. Standardize each innovation within the same ticker using its prior 252 daily bars of nonzero innovations only: zE=(e-median(e_history))/sd(e_history) and zR=(v-median(v_history))/sd(v_history), requiring at least 8 prior nonzero observations for each series and clipping each z-score to [-5,5]. Define an eligible disagreement as zE*zR<0 and abs(zE)>=1 and abs(zR)>=1; its implied margin-resolution direction is q=(zE-zR)/sqrt(2), so positive q denotes EPS improving relative to revenue and negative q denotes EPS weakening relative to revenue. After the next full response day has closed, compute r_i,t+1=close_i,t+1/close_i,t-1 and subtract the equal-weighted close-to-close return of the other valid names in i's sector on t+1. Standardize these sector-relative response returns cross-sectionally within sector on t+1, requiring at least 10 valid sector names, to obtain zP. Price is deemed to dominate the disagreement only when sign(zP)=sign(q) and abs(zP)>=max(1,0.5*abs(q)). The signal available after the close of t+1 is S_i,t+1=zP for eligible dominant-resolution observations and 0 otherwise; positive values forecast positive six-bar returns and negative values forecast negative six-bar returns. It must be traded no earlier than the open of t+2, after the complete response return is observable, with sector-neutral cross-sectional portfolio construction applied to the resulting scores.

"""Resilient repair after a shallow-depth inventory-pressure episode.

Mechanism: abnormal-volume intraday selling in a persistently shallow stock can
be an inventory-transfer shock.  The reversal is taken only after the completed
pressure episode is followed by observable impact and range replenishment, and
only where balance-sheet capacity makes adverse financing news less likely.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_rank(values: pd.DataFrame, sectors: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Ascending causal cross-sectional percentile within eligible sectors."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns, dtype=float)
    for i in range(len(values.index)):
        row = values.iloc[i]
        labels = sectors.iloc[i]
        valid = row.notna() & labels.notna()
        if not valid.any():
            continue
        frame = pd.DataFrame({"value": row.loc[valid], "sector": labels.loc[valid]})
        counts = frame.groupby("sector", sort=False)["value"].transform("count")
        eligible = frame.loc[counts >= 5]
        if not eligible.empty:
            ranked = eligible["value"].groupby(eligible["sector"], sort=False).rank(pct=True)
            output.iloc[i, output.columns.get_indexer(ranked.index)] = ranked.to_numpy()
    return output


def _prior_zscore(values: pd.DataFrame, window: int, minimum: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Standardize using observations strictly before the current bar."""
    prior = values.shift(1)
    count = prior.rolling(window, min_periods=minimum).count()
    mean = prior.rolling(window, min_periods=minimum).mean()
    std = prior.rolling(window, min_periods=minimum).std()
    valid = (count >= minimum) & (std > 0.0)
    return ((values - mean) / std.where(valid)).where(valid).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


def _resilience(cash_ratio: pd.DataFrame, debt_to_capital: pd.DataFrame,
                interest_coverage: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Cross-sectional survival capacity requiring at least two valid measures."""
    cash = rank(cash_ratio.where(cash_ratio > 0.0))
    debt = rank(-debt_to_capital.where(debt_to_capital >= 0.0))
    coverage = rank(interest_coverage.where(interest_coverage > 0.0))
    stacked = pd.concat([cash, debt, coverage], keys=["cash", "debt", "coverage"])
    score = stacked.groupby(level=1).mean()
    count = stacked.groupby(level=1).count()
    return score.where(count >= 2)


@register_factor
class ResilientDepthReplenishmentPressureRepair(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "resilient_depth_replenishment_pressure_repair"
    name = "Resilient Depth-Replenishment Repair"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks resilient shallow-depth names whose abnormal-volume intraday sell "
        "pressure occurred three bars ago and whose impact and range now show "
        "measurable liquidity replenishment."
    )
    window_length = 66
    inputs = [
        "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector",
        "cashRatio", "debtToCapital", "interestCoverage",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        open_price = data["open"].astype(float)
        high = data["high"].astype(float)
        low = data["low"].astype(float)
        close = data["close"].astype(float)
        volume = data["volume"].astype(float)

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        valid = (
            open_price.gt(0.0) & close.gt(0.0) & prior_close.gt(0.0)
            & high.notna() & low.notna() & volume.gt(0.0)
        )
        intraday = np.log(close / open_price).where(valid)
        daily_return = np.log(close / prior_close).where(valid)
        log_volume = np.log1p(volume.where(volume.ge(0.0)))
        volume_z = _prior_zscore(log_volume, 60, 40)
        abnormal_volume = (volume_z - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)

        dollar_volume = (close * volume).where(valid)
        impact = (daily_return.abs() / dollar_volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        bar_range = ((high - low) / prior_close).where(valid)

        baseline_impact = impact.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median().shift(6)
        baseline_range = bar_range.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().shift(6)
        shock_impact = impact.rolling(3, min_periods=3).median().shift(3)
        shock_range = bar_range.rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean().shift(3)
        current_impact = impact.rolling(3, min_periods=3).median()
        current_range = bar_range.rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean()

        signed_flow = (intraday * abnormal_volume).rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum().shift(3)
        completed_sell_pressure = (-signed_flow).clip(lower=0.0)
        impact_excess = (shock_impact / baseline_impact - 1.0).where(baseline_impact > 0.0)
        range_excess = (shock_range / baseline_range - 1.0).where(baseline_range > 0.0)
        impact_decay = (1.0 - current_impact / shock_impact).where(shock_impact > 0.0)
        range_decay = (1.0 - current_range / shock_range).where(shock_range > 0.0)

        depth_state = _sector_rank(baseline_impact, data["sector"])
        resilience = _resilience(
            data["cashRatio"], data["debtToCapital"], data["interestCoverage"]
        )
        replenishment = (
            impact_excess.clip(lower=0.0)
            * range_excess.clip(lower=0.0)
            * impact_decay.clip(lower=0.0)
            * range_decay.clip(lower=0.0)
        )
        raw = (
            depth_state * resilience * completed_sell_pressure * replenishment
        ).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        return rank(raw.where(raw > 0.0)).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Resilient Depth-Replenishment Repair
programs.trading_idea: The child identifies an abnormal-volume, signed intraday sell-pressure episode in a stock with persistently shallow sector-relative depth, then waits for the subsequent three bars to demonstrate that both price impact and realized range are decaying. This combines Parent B's inventory-transfer initiation signal with Parent A's completed-liquidity-vacuum and balance-sheet-survival filter: forced selling is only reversed after the market is visibly replenishing depth, and only for firms able to absorb the episode without financing distress. Neither parent alone distinguishes a fresh pressure shock that may still propagate from a pressure episode whose transient inventory imbalance has actually been retired.
programs.description: Longs resilient stocks with high persistent sector-relative price impact after an abnormal-volume intraday sell impulse has ended and both impact and range have cooled materially. The signal cross-sectionally ranks the product of shallow-depth state, financial resilience, completed signed pressure, and observed liquidity replenishment.

"""Credible fundamental anchors can turn clustered downside flow into an exhaustion signal.

Mechanism: a fresh positive, cash-quality-confirmed disclosure limits the likelihood
that follow-on downside-volume clusters represent permanent bad news.  Persistent
selling in this state is more plausibly a finite disagreement or liquidity inventory
shock, whose price impact decays as the sell program is absorbed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _fresh_update(field: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Point-in-time update indicator using only the current and prior bars."""
    prior = field.shift(1)
    return field.notna() & (prior.isna() | field.ne(prior))


def _downside_branch_gap(
    close: pd.DataFrame, volume: pd.DataFrame
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Causal marked downside-event acceleration and its validity mask."""
    prior_close = close.shift(1)
    ret = close / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
    ret = ret.where(close.gt(0.0) & prior_close.gt(0.0))

    # Shift the estimators so today's return cannot set its own event threshold.
    sigma = ret.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).std()
    mean_volume = volume.where(volume.gt(0.0)).shift(1).rolling(
        20, min_periods=15
    ).mean()
    relative_volume = volume / mean_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    valid = (
        ret.notna()
        & sigma.gt(0.0)
        & mean_volume.gt(0.0)
        & relative_volume.notna()
    )
    event = (ret.lt(-sigma) & relative_volume.ge(1.0)).where(valid)
    event_float = event.astype(float).where(valid)

    fast = event_float.ewm(halflife=2.0, adjust=False, min_periods=3).mean()
    slow = event_float.ewm(halflife=10.0, adjust=False, min_periods=12).mean()
    acceleration = (fast - slow).clip(lower=0.0)

    standardized_loss = (-ret / sigma.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0)
    participation_mark = np.log(relative_volume).clip(lower=0.0, upper=np.log(4.0))
    mark = (standardized_loss * participation_mark).where(event, 0.0)
    event_count = event_float.rolling(4, min_periods=3).sum()
    recent_mark = mark.rolling(4, min_periods=3).sum() / event_count.replace(
        0.0, np.nan
    )

    usable = valid & fast.notna() & slow.notna() & recent_mark.notna()
    return acceleration, recent_mark, usable


@register_factor
class CredibleAnchorDownsideBranchRepair(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "credible_anchor_downside_branch_repair"
    name = "Credible Anchor Downside Branch Repair"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks accelerating, marked downside-event intensity only during the six-bar "
        "aftermath of a fresh positive EPS/revenue surprise with positive income quality; "
        "high values indicate likely sell-flow exhaustion and subsequent repair."
    )
    window_length = 30
    inputs = ["close", "volume", "epsSurprise", "revenueSurprise", "incomeQuality"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        eps_surprise = data["epsSurprise"]
        revenue_surprise = data["revenueSurprise"]
        income_quality = data["incomeQuality"]

        eps_rank = rank(eps_surprise)
        revenue_rank = rank(revenue_surprise)
        quality_rank = rank(income_quality)
        disclosure_strength = (eps_rank + revenue_rank + quality_rank) / 3.0

        credible_event = (
            _fresh_update(eps_surprise)
            & _fresh_update(revenue_surprise)
            & _fresh_update(income_quality)
            & eps_surprise.gt(0.0)
            & revenue_surprise.gt(0.0)
            & income_quality.gt(0.0)
            & eps_rank.ge(0.65)
            & revenue_rank.ge(0.65)
            & quality_rank.ge(0.50)
        )

        # Use a one-bar delay and a six-session state window: the signal responds
        # to post-disclosure trading, not to an unobservable contemporaneous reaction.
        anchor_impulse = disclosure_strength.where(credible_event).shift(1)
        anchor_state = anchor_impulse.rolling(6, min_periods=1).max()

        acceleration, marked_severity, usable = _downside_branch_gap(
            close, data["volume"]
        )
        raw = anchor_state * acceleration * marked_severity
        eligible = anchor_state.notna() & anchor_state.gt(0.0) & usable & raw.notna()
        raw = raw.where(eligible).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        return rank(raw).where(eligible, 0.0).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Credible Anchor Downside Branch Repair
programs.trading_idea: A credible positive earnings-and-revenue disclosure supplies a fundamental valuation anchor, so subsequent clustered downside volume is more likely to be temporary disagreement, hedging, or liquidity-driven selling than a permanent deterioration in cash-flow expectations. Parent A identifies the self-exciting sell-flow state, while Parent B identifies the disclosure state in which that flow is economically difficult to reconcile with fundamentals; their interaction therefore identifies a finite inventory-liquidation episode whose marginal price impact should decay. The realized positive signs of both parents are interpreted as evidence that persistent downside pressure is often an exhaustion/reversal signal, especially when a recent high-quality disclosure constrains the scope for a true negative repricing.
programs.description: The signal activates only for several sessions after a fresh, cross-sectionally strong positive EPS and revenue surprise confirmed by positive income quality. Within that anchor window it ranks names with an elevated short-versus-slow exponentially weighted intensity of volatility-scaled, above-normal-volume downside events, weighted by their recent marked severity.

"""Rather than inferring an opening-auction error from a same-day reversal, this factor measures unresolved, multi-day downside selling pressure. Downward returns that recur across several days, occur on elevated participation, and finish near each day's low are consistent with asymmetric excitation of sell orders and bad-news amplification: liquidity demand and volatility reinforce one another before fundamental or contrarian capital fully absorbs supply. The prediction is negative six-bar returns for the highest-pressure names, not continuation of an already repaired opening gap."""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor

def _downside_intensity_and_persistence(close: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Compute causal five-day normalized downside intensity and persistence."""
    ret = close.pct_change()
    downside = -ret.clip(upper=0.0)
    downside_sum = downside.rolling(7, min_periods=5).sum()
    realized_scale = np.sqrt(ret.pow(2).rolling(7, min_periods=5).sum() + 1e-12)
    intensity = downside_sum / realized_scale
    persistence = ret.lt(0.0).where(ret.notna()).rolling(7, min_periods=5).sum() / 5.0
    return (intensity, persistence)

def _relative_participation(volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compute trailing five-day participation relative to its trailing 20-day baseline."""
    recent = volume.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
    baseline = volume.rolling(22, min_periods=20).mean()
    return recent / (baseline + 1e-12)

def _close_near_low_pressure(high: pd.DataFrame, low: pd.DataFrame, close: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Measure close location near the daily low, preserving invalid bars as NaN."""
    bar_range = high - low
    valid = bar_range.gt(0.0) & high.notna() & low.notna() & close.notna()
    pressure = 1.0 - (close - low) / bar_range.where(valid)
    return pressure.where(valid)

@register_factor
class PersistentDownsidePressureAmplification(BaseFactor):
    """Short-ranks persistent, high-participation downside pressure finishing near lows."""
    factor_id = 'persistent_downside_pressure_amplification_j_j'
    name = 'Persistent Downside-Pressure Amplification'
    category = 'momentum'
    description = 'Product of cross-sectional ranks of five-day normalized downside intensity, downside persistence, relative volume participation, and close-near-low pressure. High values identify unresolved sell-side pressure and are short-ranked for the following six bars.'
    window_length = 20
    inputs = ['close', 'high', 'low', 'volume']
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data['close']
        high = data['high']
        low = data['low']
        volume = data['volume']
        downside_intensity, downside_persistence = _downside_intensity_and_persistence(close)
        participation = _relative_participation(volume)
        near_low_pressure = _close_near_low_pressure(high, low, close)
        score = rank(downside_intensity) * rank(downside_persistence) * rank(participation) * rank(near_low_pressure)
        return score.reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).astype(float)

programs.trading_idea: Rather than inferring an opening-auction error from a same-day reversal, this factor measures unresolved, multi-day downside selling pressure. Downward returns that recur across several days, occur on elevated participation, and finish near each day's low are consistent with asymmetric excitation of sell orders and bad-news amplification: liquidity demand and volatility reinforce one another before fundamental or contrarian capital fully absorbs supply. The prediction is negative six-bar returns for the highest-pressure names, not continuation of an already repaired opening gap.
programs.description: This is an explicit end-of-day signal computed only after the close of day t and traded no earlier than the open of t+1. Let r_i,s = close_i,s / close_i,s-1 - 1. Over days t-4 through t, define downside-intensity D_i,t = -sum(min(r_i,s, 0)) / sqrt(sum(r_i,s^2) + 1e-12), downside-persistence P_i,t = sum(1[r_i,s < 0]) / 5, and relative participation V_i,t = mean(volume_i,t-4:t) / (mean(volume_i,t-19:t) + 1e-12). For each day with high_i,t > low_i,t, define close-near-low pressure L_i,t = 1 - (close_i,t - low_i,t) / (high_i,t - low_i,t); set L to NaN for zero-range bars. The raw score is the product of same-date cross-sectional percentile ranks: S_i,t = rank_pct(D_i,t) * rank_pct(P_i,t) * rank_pct(V_i,t) * rank_pct(L_i,t), with unavailable inputs left as NaN. High S is short-ranked. This construction has no open-price, close-to-open gap, open-to-close return, or same-day gap-rejection term. In contrast, the described `auction_impact_efficiency_completion_unwind` exposure is necessarily based on a signed opening gap G_i,t = open_i,t / close_i,t-1 - 1 and its opposite-signed intraday rejection I_i,t = close_i,t / open_i,t - 1, typically scaled by day-t participation. Our score is invariant to open_i,t conditional on high, low, close, volume, and prior closes, and can be high when every daily return is negative; it therefore is not a directional filter of G times opposite-signed I. Because the booked factor's exact implemented formula is not supplied here, formal non-redundancy should be tested by daily cross-sectional regression of S on its published score and by evaluating the six-bar return of the residualized S; the factor should be rejected if that residual has no incremental predictive content.

"""Adverse-disclosure re-ignition versus inventory-completion polarity.

Mechanism: a negative disclosure arriving after a cooled downside-volume shock
has opposite implications conditional on financing capacity.  Cash- and OCF-
resilient issuers can absorb the final disclosure-driven transfer, while
financing-fragile issuers face renewed adverse-selection and sell-cascade risk.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _numeric(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Coerce a panel to numeric values while retaining panel alignment."""
    return frame.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")


def _new_event(*fields: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Flag a point-in-time report update using only current and prior bars."""
    event = pd.DataFrame(False, index=fields[0].index, columns=fields[0].columns)
    for field in fields:
        event = event | (field.notna() & field.ne(field.shift(1)))
    return event


@register_factor
class AdverseSurpriseReignitionInventoryPolarity(BaseFactor):
    """Signed adverse-surprise signal conditioned on prior flow completion."""

    factor_id = "adverse_surprise_reignition_inventory_polarity"
    name = "Adverse Surprise Reignition Polarity"
    category = "momentum"
    description = (
        "Ranks confirmed joint negative report surprises after a prior downside "
        "shock and cooling phase, assigning positive polarity to strong cash/OCF "
        "debt coverage and negative polarity to financing fragility."
    )
    window_length = 26
    inputs = [
        "open",
        "low",
        "close",
        "volume",
        "marketCap",
        "cash",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "totalDebt",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = _numeric(data["close"])
        open_price = _numeric(data["open"])
        low = _numeric(data["low"])
        volume = _numeric(data["volume"])
        market_cap = _numeric(data["marketCap"])
        cash = _numeric(data["cash"])
        ocf = _numeric(data["operatingCashFlow"])
        debt = _numeric(data["totalDebt"])
        eps_est = _numeric(data["epsEstimate"])
        revenue_est = _numeric(data["revenueEstimate"])
        eps_actual = _numeric(data["epsActual"])
        revenue_actual = _numeric(data["revenueActual"])
        eps_surprise = _numeric(data["epsSurprise"])
        revenue_surprise = _numeric(data["revenueSurprise"])

        valid_close = close.where(close > 0.0)
        valid_open = open_price.where(open_price > 0.0)
        ret = valid_close.div(valid_close.shift(1)).sub(1.0)
        down_range = valid_open.sub(low).div(valid_open).clip(lower=0.0)

        event = _new_event(eps_actual, revenue_actual, eps_surprise, revenue_surprise)
        eps_norm = eps_surprise.div(eps_est.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        revenue_norm = revenue_surprise.div(
            revenue_est.abs().replace(0.0, np.nan)
        ).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        severity = (
            0.70 * (-eps_norm).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
            + 0.30 * (-revenue_norm).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        )

        volume_base = volume.shift(6).rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
        range_base = down_range.shift(6).rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
        shock_volume = volume.shift(3).rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean()
        shock_range = down_range.shift(3).rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean()
        volume_shock = shock_volume.div(volume_base.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        range_shock = shock_range.div(range_base.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        prior_shock_return = (
            (1.0 + ret.shift(5)) * (1.0 + ret.shift(4)) * (1.0 + ret.shift(3)) - 1.0
        )

        cooling_volume = volume.shift(1).rolling(2, min_periods=2).mean().div(
            shock_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        cooling_range = down_range.shift(1).rolling(2, min_periods=2).mean().div(
            shock_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        current_return = ret.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        cash_coverage = cash.div(debt.where(debt > 0.0))
        ocf_coverage = ocf.div(debt.where(debt > 0.0))
        eligible = (
            valid_close.gt(1.0)
            & market_cap.gt(0.0)
            & eps_est.abs().ge(0.05)
            & revenue_est.gt(0.0)
            & event
            & eps_norm.le(-0.05)
            & revenue_norm.le(-0.01)
            & current_return.le(-0.005)
            & volume_shock.ge(1.25)
            & range_shock.ge(1.20)
            & prior_shock_return.le(-0.025)
            & cooling_volume.le(0.80)
            & cooling_range.le(0.80)
            & cash_coverage.notna()
            & ocf_coverage.notna()
        )

        completion = (
            rank((-prior_shock_return).where(eligible))
            + rank(volume_shock.where(eligible))
            + rank((-cooling_volume).where(eligible))
            + rank((-cooling_range).where(eligible))
        ) / 4.0
        resilience = (
            rank(cash_coverage.where(eligible))
            + rank(ocf_coverage.where(eligible))
        ) / 2.0
        polarity = 2.0 * resilience - 1.0
        surprise_rank = rank(severity.where(eligible))

        score = surprise_rank * completion * polarity
        return score.where(eligible, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Adverse Surprise Reignition Polarity
programs.trading_idea: A jointly negative earnings and revenue surprise is a fresh adverse-information impulse, but its six-day consequence depends on whether a preceding downside-volume episode had already exhausted inventory. In cash- and operating-cash-flow-resilient issuers, a pre-event shock that cooled before the release indicates replenished risk-bearing capacity, so the disclosure-day selloff is more likely to complete the transfer and rebound; in financing-fragile issuers, the same disclosure re-ignites constrained selling and adverse-selection withdrawal, producing continuation. The interaction distinguishes a fundamental catalyst that terminates an old liquidation from one that restarts a reflexive sell cascade, which neither surprise severity nor cooling state identifies alone.
programs.description: On newly available, jointly negative EPS and revenue surprise releases confirmed by a down close, the signal measures a prior high-volume downside shock followed by pre-release cooling. It multiplies this completion state and surprise severity by a cross-sectional cash-and-OCF debt-coverage polarity, long resilient completed-liquidation names and short fragile re-ignition names.

"""This is a reduced-form continuation signal, not an identified measure of metaorder flow. Repeated high-volume sessions that close persistently near one end of their daily ranges, while producing less close-to-open movement per unit of directional-pressure proxy than is normal for that stock, may reflect temporarily absorbed directional demand or supply that has not fully translated into prices. The hypothesis is that this combination predicts continuation in the proxy's direction over the next six trading days, subject to a strict liquidity and gap filter."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


@register_factor
class CadencedImpactDeficitMetaorderCarry(BaseFactor):
    """Cadenced low-impact directional pressure portfolio."""

    factor_id = "cadenced_impact_deficit_metaorder_carry"
    name = "Cadenced Low-Impact Pressure"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "A six-bar continuation portfolio for persistent, cadenced, abnormal "
        "close-location pressure that is being absorbed with unusually low "
        "close-to-open impact, subject to liquidity and overnight-gap filters."
    )
    window_length = 26
    inputs = ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        open_ = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        # The trailing baseline deliberately excludes the current bar.  Only
        # positive-volume observations participate in the median and count.
        positive_volume = volume.where(volume > 0.0)
        baseline_count = positive_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=1).count()
        baseline = positive_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=1).median()
        baseline = baseline.where(baseline_count >= 15.0)

        valid_close = close > 0.0
        valid_volume = volume > 0.0
        relative_participation = (volume / baseline).clip(lower=0.0, upper=5.0)
        relative_participation = relative_participation.where(valid_close & valid_volume)

        raw_range = high - low
        range_floor = 0.0001 * close
        safe_range = raw_range.where(raw_range > range_floor, range_floor)
        clv = ((2.0 * close - high - low) / safe_range).clip(lower=-1.0, upper=1.0)
        pressure = (clv * relative_participation).where(valid_close & valid_volume)

        # The five completed-session pressure sequence must be fully observed.
        pressure_valid = pressure.notna().rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum() == 5.0
        participation_valid = relative_participation.notna().rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum() == 5.0
        pressure_sum = pressure.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        absolute_pressure_sum = pressure.abs().rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        mean_pressure = pressure.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()

        abnormal_sessions = (relative_participation >= 1.25).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum() >= 4.0
        concordance = pressure_sum.abs() / absolute_pressure_sum.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        concordant = (concordance >= 0.60) & (absolute_pressure_sum > 0.0)

        participation_mean = relative_participation.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()
        participation_std = relative_participation.rolling(5, min_periods=5).std(ddof=0)
        regular_cadence = (
            (participation_mean > 0.0)
            & ((participation_std / participation_mean.replace(0.0, np.nan)) <= 0.50)
        )

        # Impact is close-to-open movement per unit of signed pressure.  The
        # pressure denominator is floored as specified to avoid amplifying
        # nearly neutral close-location observations.
        impact = ((close - open_).abs() / close.replace(0.0, np.nan)) / pressure.abs().clip(lower=0.10)
        current_impact = impact.rolling(5, min_periods=5).mean()

        # At t, shift(6) followed by a 20-bar trailing median spans t-25...t-6.
        normal_impact_source = impact.shift(6)
        normal_impact_count = normal_impact_source.rolling(20, min_periods=1).count()
        normal_impact = normal_impact_source.rolling(20, min_periods=1).median()
        normal_impact = normal_impact.where(normal_impact_count >= 12.0)
        impact_ratio = current_impact / normal_impact.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        low_impact = (normal_impact > 0.0) & (impact_ratio <= 0.75)
        deficit = (1.0 - impact_ratio).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)

        activation = (
            pressure_valid
            & participation_valid
            & abnormal_sessions
            & concordant
            & regular_cadence
            & low_impact
        )
        raw_score = (mean_pressure * deficit).where(activation)

        # Dollar-volume liquidity is measured including the completed current
        # bar.  Cross-sectional quantiles naturally ignore unavailable names.
        dollar_volume = (close * volume).where(valid_close & valid_volume)
        dollar_count = dollar_volume.rolling(21, min_periods=1).count()
        median_dollar_volume = dollar_volume.rolling(21, min_periods=1).median()
        liquid_history = dollar_count >= 15.0
        liquidity_universe = median_dollar_volume.where(liquid_history)
        liquidity_cutoff = liquidity_universe.quantile(0.30, axis=1)
        liquid = liquid_history & median_dollar_volume.ge(liquidity_cutoff, axis=0)

        # A valid prior close is required for every one of the five overnight
        # gaps, so missing opening-shock observations are conservative excludes.
        overnight_gap = (open_ / close.shift(1) - 1.0).abs()
        gap_count = overnight_gap.notna().rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        gap_ok = (gap_count == 5.0) & (overnight_gap.rolling(5, min_periods=5).max() <= 0.08)

        eligible = activation & liquid & gap_ok
        eligible_score = raw_score.where(eligible)
        eligible_count = eligible_score.notna().sum(axis=1)
        enough_names = eligible_count >= 40

        lower = eligible_score.quantile(0.025, axis=1)
        upper = eligible_score.quantile(0.975, axis=1)
        winsorized = eligible_score.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0).where(eligible)
        score_rank = winsorized.rank(axis=1, method="average", pct=True)

        long_side = ((score_rank >= 0.90) & (winsorized > 0.0)).where(enough_names, False, axis=0).fillna(False)
        short_side = ((score_rank <= 0.10) & (winsorized < 0.0)).where(enough_names, False, axis=0).fillna(False)

        long_count = long_side.sum(axis=1)
        short_count = short_side.sum(axis=1)
        trade_ok = enough_names & (long_count >= 5) & (short_count >= 5)

        long_weight = 0.50 * long_side.astype(float).div(long_count.replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0)
        short_weight = -0.50 * short_side.astype(float).div(short_count.replace(0.0, np.nan), axis=0)
        weights = (long_weight + short_weight).where(trade_ok, 0.0, axis=0)

        return weights.fillna(0.0).astype(float)
programs.name: Cadenced Low-Impact Pressure
programs.trading_idea: This is a reduced-form continuation signal, not an identified measure of metaorder flow. Repeated high-volume sessions that close persistently near one end of their daily ranges, while producing less close-to-open movement per unit of directional-pressure proxy than is normal for that stock, may reflect temporarily absorbed directional demand or supply that has not fully translated into prices. The hypothesis is that this combination predicts continuation in the proxy's direction over the next six trading days, subject to a strict liquidity and gap filter.
programs.description: Use only completed OHLCV data through date t. For each stock i, require positive close and volume observations. Define the prior-volume baseline B(i,t) as the median of volume from t-20 through t-1, requiring at least 15 positive observations; otherwise the stock is ineligible. Define the range floor R(i,d)=max(high(i,d)-low(i,d), 0.0001*close(i,d)). Define close-location CLV(i,d)=clip((2*close(i,d)-high(i,d)-low(i,d))/R(i,d), -1, 1); thus a zero or near-zero range does not create an unstable ratio. Define capped relative participation Q(i,d)=clip(volume(i,d)/B(i,d), 0, 5), where B(i,d) is computed only from the preceding 20 bars. Define signed daily pressure X(i,d)=CLV(i,d)*Q(i,d). The five-session signal window is d=t-4,...,t and requires all five X and Q observations to be valid. Abnormal-volume activation requires at least four of the five Q values to be at least 1.25. Directional concordance requires abs(sum_d X(i,d))/sum_d abs(X(i,d)) >= 0.60 and sum_d abs(X(i,d)) > 0; the signal direction is sign(sum_d X(i,d)). Cadence regularity requires the coefficient of variation of the five Q values, std(Q)/mean(Q), to be no greater than 0.50, using population standard deviation and requiring mean(Q)>0. Define daily impact per unit of directional pressure J(i,d)=(abs(close(i,d)-open(i,d))/close(i,d))/max(abs(X(i,d)),0.10). Define current impact Icur(i,t) as the mean of J over t-4,...,t. Define normal impact Inorm(i,t) as the median of J over t-25,...,t-6, requiring at least 12 valid observations and Inorm>0. Activate the low-impact condition only when Icur/Inorm <= 0.75. Define impact-deficit D(i,t)=clip(1-Icur/Inorm,0,1). The raw signed score is S(i,t)=(mean of X over t-4,...,t)*D(i,t) when all activation conditions hold, and missing otherwise. Exclude a stock when its 20-day median dollar volume, computed as median(close*volume) over t-20,...,t, is below the cross-sectional 30th percentile among stocks with at least 15 valid dollar-volume observations. Also exclude a stock if any absolute overnight gap abs(open(i,d)/close(i,d-1)-1) over d=t-4,...,t exceeds 8%; this is an OHLCV-only event and opening-shock filter. No sector or industry exclusion is used, so the formula remains OHLCV-only. Among eligible stocks at t, winsorize S at the contemporaneous 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles, requiring at least 40 eligible stocks; otherwise do not trade. Rank the winsorized scores cross-sectionally, with ties assigned average ranks. Go long the eligible positive-score stocks in the highest decile and short the eligible negative-score stocks in the lowest decile, equal weighted within each side and scaled to 50% gross long and 50% gross short. If either side contains fewer than five names, take no new positions. All calculations use bars through the completed t bar only; form the signal after t closes, execute no earlier than the open of t+1, and evaluate each vintage from the t+1 open through the t+7 open, a six-bar holding interval. Daily signal vintages may be combined with equal capital if overlapping holdings are implemented.

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_mean(values: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return values.T.groupby(labels, sort=False).transform("mean").T


def _sector_rank(values: pd.DataFrame, labels: pd.Series) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return values.T.groupby(labels, sort=False).rank(pct=True).T


def _prior_zscore(values: pd.DataFrame, window: int, minimum: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    history = values.shift(1)
    count = history.rolling(window, min_periods=minimum).count()
    mean = history.rolling(window, min_periods=minimum).mean()
    std = history.rolling(window, min_periods=minimum).std()
    valid = count.ge(minimum) & std.gt(0.0)
    result = (values - mean) / std.where(valid)
    return result.where(valid).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)


@register_factor
class ContagionStateCounterflowFragilityRelay(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "contagion_state_counterflow_fragility_relay"
    name = "Contagion-State Counterflow Fragility Relay"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Trades absorbed closing-pressure counterflow only during broad, "
        "high-activity sector shocks, with fragile relief rallies receiving "
        "additional downside-contagion weight."
    )
    window_length = 60
    inputs = [
        "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "sector",
        "cashRatio", "debtToAssets"
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        open_price = data["open"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        high = data["high"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        low = data["low"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        sector_frame = data["sector"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        labels = sector_frame.ffill().bfill().iloc[0].reindex(close.columns)

        safe_close = close.where(close.gt(0.0))
        ret = safe_close.pct_change()
        sector_ret = _sector_mean(ret, labels)
        sector_move = sector_ret.rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum()
        direction = np.sign(sector_move).replace(0.0, np.nan)

        log_volume = np.log1p(volume.where(volume.ge(0.0)))
        volume_z = _prior_zscore(log_volume, 20, 12).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
        sector_volume_z = _sector_mean(volume_z, labels).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)

        prior_sector_std = sector_ret.shift(1).rolling(40, min_periods=25).std()
        shock_z = sector_move.abs() / (prior_sector_std * np.sqrt(3.0)).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        shock_strength = (shock_z - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)
        contagion_state = shock_strength * (1.0 + sector_volume_z.fillna(0.0))

        concordant = (np.sign(ret) == np.sign(sector_ret)).where(ret.notna() & sector_ret.notna())
        sector_breadth = _sector_mean(concordant.astype(float), labels)
        broad_state = sector_breadth.ge(0.60)

        prior_ret = ret.shift(1)
        prior_mode = sector_ret.shift(1)
        beta_num = prior_ret.rolling(50, min_periods=30).cov(prior_mode)
        beta_den = prior_mode.rolling(50, min_periods=30).var()
        beta = beta_num / beta_den.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        beta_eligible = beta.ge(0.30)

        bar_range = high - low
        valid_range = bar_range.gt(0.0)
        safe_range = bar_range.where(valid_range)
        closing_location = (2.0 * (close - low) / safe_range - 1.0).where(valid_range)
        body_fraction = ((close - open_price).abs() / safe_range).clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        absorption = (1.0 - body_fraction).where(valid_range)

        signed_absorbed_flow = (
            closing_location * absorption * volume_z.clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)
        )
        persistent_flow = signed_absorbed_flow.rolling(4, min_periods=3).mean()
        counterflow = (-direction * persistent_flow).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)

        cash_ratio = data["cashRatio"].where(data["cashRatio"].ge(0.0))
        debt_to_assets = data["debtToAssets"].where(data["debtToAssets"].ge(0.0))
        cash_rank = _sector_rank(cash_ratio, labels)
        debt_rank = _sector_rank(debt_to_assets, labels)
        fragility = ((1.0 - cash_rank) + debt_rank) / 2.0
        fragility = fragility.fillna(0.5).clip(0.0, 1.0)

        intraday = np.log(close.where(close.gt(0.0)) / open_price.where(open_price.gt(0.0)))
        intraday_z = _prior_zscore(intraday, 20, 12).clip(-3.0, 3.0)
        downside_relief = 1.0 + intraday_z.clip(lower=0.0).fillna(0.0)
        downside_gain = (1.0 + fragility) * downside_relief
        gain = downside_gain.where(direction.lt(0.0), 1.0)

        signal = direction * counterflow * contagion_state.fillna(0.0) * gain
        valid = (
            broad_state
            & beta_eligible
            & valid_range
            & close.gt(0.0)
            & volume.gt(0.0)
            & persistent_flow.notna()
            & direction.notna()
        )
        return signal.where(valid, 0.0).fillna(0.0).astype(float)
programs.name: Contagion-State Counterflow Fragility Relay
programs.trading_idea: A broad, high-activity sector move identifies a common repricing or contagion state, while absorbed member-level counterflow identifies constituents whose execution path has temporarily diverged from that common mode. In upside sector shocks, absorbed selling pressure is expected to unwind upward toward the sector repricing; in downside contagion, financially fragile names with high-volume relief pressure are more likely to be temporarily supported before delayed de-risking resumes. The interaction distinguishes informative sector repricing from local execution noise and makes the downside leg selectively stronger where balance-sheet fragility raises forced-selling susceptibility.
programs.description: The signal detects coherent three-day sector shocks with abnormal sector activity, then takes the sector-directional side of persistent high-volume closing-pressure counterflow in beta-relevant constituents. Downside counterflow is amplified only for low-cash, high-debt names and requires a positive intraday relief confirmation.

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _leave_one_out_sector_mean(
    values: pd.DataFrame,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
    labels: pd.Series,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Causal cross-sectional leave-one-out sector mean and peer count."""
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns)
    counts = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=values.index, columns=values.columns)
    clean = values.where(eligible, 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    flags = eligible.astype(float)
    labels = labels.reindex(values.columns)

    for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        members = labels.index[labels.eq(label)].intersection(values.columns)
        if len(members) < 2:
            continue
        total = clean.loc[:, members].sum(axis=1)
        number = flags.loc[:, members].sum(axis=1)
        peer_total = total.to_numpy()[:, None] - clean.loc[:, members].to_numpy()
        peer_number = number.to_numpy()[:, None] - flags.loc[:, members].to_numpy()
        output.loc[:, members] = peer_total / np.where(peer_number > 0.0, peer_number, np.nan)
        counts.loc[:, members] = peer_number

    return output, counts


@register_factor
class StaggeredPeerClockCompressionRelay(BaseFactor):
    """Delayed own execution pressure following a fading peer execution pulse."""

    factor_id = "staggered_peer_clock_compression_relay"
    name = "Staggered Peer Clock Compression Relay"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks persistent abnormal-volume, compressed-range close-location pressure "
        "only when an aligned leave-one-out sector execution impulse led over the "
        "prior sessions and is now decaying."
    )
    window_length = 55
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume", "sector"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].where(data["close"].gt(0.0))
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"].where(data["volume"].gt(0.0))

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        bar_range = high - low
        valid_range = high.ge(low) & prior_close.gt(0.0) & bar_range.gt(0.0)
        true_range = ((high - low) / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(valid_range)
        close_location = ((2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        close_location = close_location.where(valid_range, 0.0).clip(lower=-1.0, upper=1.0)

        log_volume = np.log(volume)
        prior_log_volume = log_volume.shift(1)
        volume_count = prior_log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).count()
        volume_median = prior_log_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        abnormal_volume = (log_volume - volume_median).clip(lower=-3.0, upper=3.0)
        volume_valid = volume.gt(0.0) & volume_count.ge(15.0) & volume_median.notna()

        prior_range = true_range.shift(1)
        range_count = prior_range.rolling(20, min_periods=15).count()
        range_median = prior_range.rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        compression = (range_median / true_range.clip(lower=0.002) - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.5)
        compression_valid = valid_range & range_count.ge(15.0) & range_median.notna()

        session_valid = volume_valid & compression_valid
        participation_weight = (1.0 + abnormal_volume.clip(lower=0.0)).where(session_valid)
        weighted_flow = participation_weight * close_location
        weighted_compressed_flow = weighted_flow * compression
        valid_count = session_valid.astype(float).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
        weight_sum = participation_weight.fillna(0.0).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()

        directional_mean = weighted_flow.fillna(0.0).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum() / weight_sum.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        compressed_pressure = (
            weighted_compressed_flow.fillna(0.0).rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum()
            / weight_sum.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        own_schedule = compressed_pressure * directional_mean.abs()
        own_valid = session_valid & valid_count.ge(3.0) & own_schedule.notna()

        dollar_volume = close * volume
        liquid_dollar = dollar_volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=15).median()
        liquidity_cutoff = liquid_dollar.quantile(0.35, axis=1)
        liquid = liquid_dollar.ge(liquidity_cutoff, axis=0) & liquid_dollar.gt(0.0)
        peer_eligible = own_valid & liquid

        sector_labels = data["sector"].ffill().iloc[-1].reindex(close.columns)
        peer_flow, peer_count = _leave_one_out_sector_mean(
            own_schedule,
            peer_eligible,
            sector_labels,
        )

        peer_recent = peer_flow.shift(1).rolling(3, min_periods=3).mean()
        peer_history_std = peer_recent.shift(1).rolling(35, min_periods=25).std()
        peer_z = peer_recent / peer_history_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        aligned = np.sign(own_schedule).eq(np.sign(peer_recent)) & np.sign(peer_recent).ne(0.0)
        fading_peer = peer_flow.abs().le(0.90 * peer_recent.abs())
        active = (
            own_valid
            & aligned
            & fading_peer
            & peer_count.ge(4.0)
            & peer_z.abs().ge(0.75)
        )

        clock_strength = peer_z.abs().clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)
        raw_score = (own_schedule * clock_strength).where(active, 0.0)
        return rank(raw_score.fillna(0.0)).fillna(0.0).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
