from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _report_change(field: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """True when a point-in-time field becomes newly available or changes."""
    previous = field.shift(1)
    return field.notna() & (previous.isna() | field.ne(previous))


def _sector_residual_return(
    stock_return: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal leave-one-out sector residual return using contemporaneous peers."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=stock_return.index, columns=stock_return.columns)
    for i in range(len(stock_return.index)):
        ret_row = stock_return.iloc[i]
        sector_row = sector.iloc[i]
        usable = eligible.iloc[i] & ret_row.notna() & sector_row.notna()
        masked = ret_row.where(usable)
        sector_sum = masked.groupby(sector_row).transform("sum")
        sector_count = usable.astype(float).groupby(sector_row).transform("sum")
        peer_count = sector_count - usable.astype(float)
        peer_mean = (sector_sum - ret_row) / peer_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        result.iloc[i] = (ret_row - peer_mean).where(usable & peer_count.ge(5.0))
    return result


@register_factor
class TaxCleanResilientSectorSurpriseDriftX(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "tax_clean_resilient_sector_surprise_drift_x"
    name = "Tax-Clean Resilient Sector Surprise Drift"
    category = "momentum"
    description = (
        "Six-day cohorts of liquid positive-surprise events with positive "
        "sector-residual confirmation, conditioned on tax-clean operating "
        "support and cross-sectionally resilient balance sheets."
    )
    window_length = 26
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "volume",
        "sector",
        "marketCap",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenueEstimate",
        "incomeBeforeTax",
        "incomeTaxExpense",
        "operatingIncome",
        "revenue",
        "debtToAssets",
        "currentRatio",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        volume = data["volume"]

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        prior_sector = data["sector"].shift(1)
        prior_cap = data["marketCap"].shift(1)
        dollar_volume = close * volume
        prior_adv = dollar_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean().shift(1)
        liquid = (
            prior_sector.notna()
            & prior_cap.ge(500_000_000.0)
            & prior_close.ge(5.0)
            & prior_adv.ge(5_000_000.0)
        )

        report_change = (
            _report_change(data["epsActual"])
            | _report_change(data["revenueActual"])
            | _report_change(data["epsSurprise"])
            | _report_change(data["revenueSurprise"])
        )
        event = report_change.shift(1).fillna(False)
        universe = liquid & event

        eps_surprise = data["epsSurprise"].shift(1)
        revenue_surprise = data["revenueSurprise"].shift(1)
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"].shift(1)
        revenue_estimate = data["revenueEstimate"].shift(1)
        norm_eps = eps_surprise / eps_estimate.abs().clip(lower=0.01)
        norm_revenue = revenue_surprise / revenue_estimate.abs().clip(lower=1_000_000.0)

        eps_rank = rank(norm_eps.where(universe))
        revenue_rank = rank(norm_revenue.where(universe))
        surprise_count = eps_rank.notna().astype(float) + revenue_rank.notna().astype(float)
        surprise_strength = (eps_rank.fillna(0.0) + revenue_rank.fillna(0.0)).div(
            surprise_count.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        positive_news = norm_eps.gt(0.0) | norm_revenue.gt(0.0)

        one_day_return = prior_close / close.shift(2).replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        idio_return = _sector_residual_return(one_day_return, prior_sector, liquid)
        idio_rank = rank(idio_return.where(universe & idio_return.gt(0.0)))

        pretax = data["incomeBeforeTax"].shift(1)
        tax = data["incomeTaxExpense"].shift(1)
        revenue = data["revenue"].shift(1)
        operating_income = data["operatingIncome"].shift(1)
        tax_rate = tax / pretax.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        tax_decline = tax_rate.shift(1) - tax_rate
        revenue_growth = revenue / revenue.shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        operating_margin = operating_income / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        margin_change = operating_margin - operating_margin.shift(1)

        tax_lightness = (
            rank(tax_decline)
            - 0.5 * (rank(revenue_growth).fillna(0.5) + rank(margin_change).fillna(0.5))
        )
        tax_cleanliness = (1.0 - rank(tax_lightness)).fillna(0.5)

        debt_resilience = rank(-data["debtToAssets"].shift(1))
        liquidity_resilience = rank(data["currentRatio"].shift(1))
        resilience = (debt_resilience.fillna(0.5) + liquidity_resilience.fillna(0.5)) / 2.0
        credibility_state = (tax_cleanliness + resilience) / 2.0

        confirmed = universe & positive_news & idio_return.gt(0.0) & surprise_strength.notna() & idio_rank.notna()
        raw_score = (surprise_strength * idio_rank * credibility_state).where(confirmed)
        event_rank = rank(raw_score)
        selected = confirmed & event_rank.ge(0.75)

        selected_count = selected.sum(axis=1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        entry_cohort = selected.astype(float).div(selected_count, axis=0).fillna(0.0)
        position = entry_cohort.rolling(6, min_periods=1).sum() / 6.0
        return position.reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).fillna(0.0)

The interaction adds edge because Parent A alone can buy cosmetically supported earnings beats, while Parent B alone identifies fragile tax-led upgrades without distinguishing the subset where a credible surprise has already begun a sector-relative repricing.

"""Cash-credible disclosure anchored repair after mature thin sell pressure.

A positive, cash-supported delivery anchors fundamental value.  If a subsequent
idiosyncratic sell arrival has already aged and a further sell displacement
crosses unusually thin relative depth while the prior downside excitation is
cooling, the move is treated as a terminal inventory concession and is bought.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor

def _fresh(field: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Availability-date update indicator using only current and prior values."""
    prior = field.shift(1)
    return field.notna() & (prior.isna() | field.ne(prior))

def _reset_ewma(mark: pd.DataFrame, alpha: float) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal EWMA whose state is reset across missing-bar gaps."""
    values = mark.to_numpy(dtype=float, copy=False)
    out = np.full(values.shape, np.nan, dtype=float)
    state = np.zeros(values.shape[1], dtype=float)
    active = np.zeros(values.shape[1], dtype=bool)
    for t in range(values.shape[0]):
        x = values[t]
        valid = np.isfinite(x)
        continuing = valid & active
        starting = valid & ~active
        state[continuing] = (1.0 - alpha) * state[continuing] + alpha * x[continuing]
        state[starting] = alpha * x[starting]
        out[t, valid] = state[valid]
        active = valid
    return pd.DataFrame(out, index=mark.index, columns=mark.columns)

def _sector_residual(value: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Same-date sector-median residual, requiring at least five valid peers."""
    result = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=value.index, columns=value.columns, dtype=float)
    for t in range(len(value.index)):
        row = value.iloc[t]
        groups = sector.iloc[t]
        usable = row.where(row.notna() & groups.notna())
        median = usable.groupby(groups).transform('median')
        count = usable.notna().groupby(groups).transform('sum')
        result.iloc[t] = (usable - median).where(count.ge(5))
    return result

def _downside_cooling_phase(close: pd.DataFrame, high: pd.DataFrame, low: pd.DataFrame, volume: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Positive after a high-impact downside episode begins to decay."""
    prior_close = close.shift(1)
    ret = close / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
    ret = ret.where(close.gt(0.0) & prior_close.gt(0.0))
    sigma = ret.shift(1).rolling(31, min_periods=20).std()
    vol_base = volume.where(volume.gt(0.0)).shift(1).rolling(29, min_periods=20).mean()
    bar_range = high - low
    close_low = ((high - close) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 1.0)
    excess_volume = np.log(volume / vol_base.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0)
    downside = (-ret / sigma.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(lower=0.0)
    stress = (downside * close_low * excess_volume).where(sigma.gt(0.0) & vol_base.gt(0.0) & bar_range.gt(0.0)).clip(upper=12.0)
    fast = stress.ewm(span=2, adjust=False, min_periods=2).mean()
    slow = stress.ewm(span=6, adjust=False, min_periods=4).mean()
    return ((slow - fast) / (slow + fast + 1e-08)).clip(-1.0, 1.0)

@register_factor
class CashDeliveryMatureSelloffDepthRepair(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = 'cash_delivery_mature_selloff_depth_repair_j_2'
    name = 'Cash Delivery Mature Selloff Repair'
    category = 'microstructure'
    description = 'Ranks terminal thin-depth selloffs only when a fresh cash-credible positive delivery anchors value, the prior idiosyncratic sell arrival has matured, and downside excitation is cooling.'
    window_length = 90
    inputs = ['close', 'high', 'low', 'volume', 'sector', 'epsActual', 'revenueActual', 'epsEstimate', 'revenueEstimate', 'epsSurprise', 'revenueSurprise', 'freeCashFlow', 'incomeQuality']
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data['close'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        high = data['high'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        low = data['low'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data['volume'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_actual = data['epsActual'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        rev_actual = data['revenueActual'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_est = data['epsEstimate'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        rev_est = data['revenueEstimate'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_surprise = data['epsSurprise'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        rev_surprise = data['revenueSurprise'].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps_scaled = eps_surprise / (eps_est.abs() + eps_actual.abs() + 0.01)
        rev_scaled = rev_surprise / (rev_est.abs() + rev_actual.abs() + 1000000.0)
        delivery = (eps_scaled.clip(-1.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0) + rev_scaled.clip(-1.0, 1.0).fillna(0.0)) / 2.0
        fresh_report = (_fresh(eps_surprise) | _fresh(rev_surprise)) & (_fresh(eps_actual) | _fresh(rev_actual))
        credible_event = fresh_report & delivery.gt(0.0) & data['freeCashFlow'].gt(0.0) & data['incomeQuality'].ge(0.8)
        event_state = delivery.clip(lower=0.0).where(credible_event).shift(1).rolling(5, min_periods=1).max()
        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        bar_range = high - low
        valid_bar = close.gt(0.0) & prior_close.gt(0.0) & high.gt(low) & volume.gt(0.0)
        direction = np.sign(close / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0)
        location = ((2.0 * close - high - low) / bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        positive_volume = volume.where(volume.gt(0.0))
        vol_median = positive_volume.shift(1).rolling(19, min_periods=15).median()
        volume_multiple = volume / vol_median.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        rare_cutoff = volume_multiple.shift(1).rolling(66, min_periods=45).quantile(0.95)
        rare = valid_bar & volume_multiple.ge(rare_cutoff)
        arrival_mark = direction * location.abs() * np.log(volume_multiple.clip(1.0, 6.0))
        arrival_input = pd.DataFrame(np.where(valid_bar, 0.0, np.nan), index=close.index, columns=close.columns).where(~rare, arrival_mark)
        prior_arrival = _reset_ewma(arrival_input, 0.18).shift(1)
        idio_arrival = _sector_residual(prior_arrival, data['sector'])
        mature_sell = (-idio_arrival).clip(lower=0.0, upper=3.0)
        normalized_range = bar_range / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        range_base = normalized_range.shift(1).rolling(22, min_periods=15).median()
        relative_depth = volume / vol_median.replace(0.0, np.nan) / (normalized_range / range_base.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        log_depth = np.log(relative_depth.where(relative_depth.gt(0.0)))
        depletion = (-log_depth).clip(lower=0.0)
        instability = log_depth.rolling(9, min_periods=8).std()
        decisive_sell = (direction * location).clip(lower=0.0)
        cooling = _downside_cooling_phase(close, high, low, volume).clip(lower=0.0)
        raw = (-direction).clip(lower=0.0) * depletion * instability * decisive_sell * mature_sell * cooling * event_state
        eligible = valid_bar & event_state.notna() & idio_arrival.notna() & instability.notna() & relative_depth.gt(0.0) & data['sector'].notna()
        signal = raw.where(eligible).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        return signal.reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)

programs.trading_idea: A fresh cash-supported positive earnings delivery makes an initial idiosyncratic sell arrival more likely to reflect temporary portfolio liquidation, disagreement, or inventory transfer than deteriorating fundamentals. The child waits until that negative arrival has matured and a further downside displacement occurs through unusually thin relative depth while the earlier downside-excitation kernel is cooling; this identifies a terminal concession after selling pressure has already been revealed and is being absorbed. Parent A alone cannot distinguish cooling informed distribution from a depleted order book, while Parent B alone cannot tell whether a mature sell sequence conflicts with a credible fundamental anchor.
programs.description: Longs stocks with a recent fresh, cash-credible positive disclosure, a decayed sector-idiosyncratic negative volume arrival, and a current low-relative-depth downside move occurring while trailing downside stress is cooling. The output cross-sectionally ranks the expected six-bar repair intensity.

"""A severe, idiosyncratic daily sell shock followed by a tightly bounded next-day low extension, lower trading activity, narrower range, and a measurable close recovery is a reduced-form indication that immediate sell pressure may have been absorbed rather than renewed. The interpretation is that temporary liquidity imbalance or urgent selling can create overshoot, but daily OHLCV cannot identify forced selling or latent limit demand directly; the predicted rebound is therefore an empirical implication to test rather than proof of that mechanism. The explicit bounded-extension condition is intended to distinguish a genuine absorption pattern from an ordinary one-day pause in a continuing decline."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _confirmed_downside_reversal_score(
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Build the causal t+1 confirmation score from a t sell-shock event."""
    previous_close = close.shift(1)
    valid_price = (
        (close > 0.0)
        & (previous_close > 0.0)
        & (high > 0.0)
        & (low > 0.0)
        & (high >= low)
    )

    daily_return = (close / previous_close) - 1.0
    daily_return = daily_return.where(valid_price)
    cross_sectional_median = daily_return.median(axis=1, skipna=True)
    idiosyncratic_return = daily_return.sub(cross_sectional_median, axis=0)

    # Both reference measures deliberately exclude the shock day itself.
    prior_sigma = daily_return.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std().shift(1)
    prior_volume = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean().shift(1)
    relative_volume = volume / prior_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    shock_range = high - low
    normalized_range = (shock_range / previous_close) / prior_sigma.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    close_location = (close - low) / shock_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    shock_valid = (
        valid_price
        & (volume > 0.0)
        & (prior_volume > 0.0)
        & (prior_sigma > 0.0)
        & (shock_range > 0.0)
    )
    shock = (
        shock_valid
        & (daily_return <= -0.05)
        & (idiosyncratic_return <= -0.04)
        & (relative_volume >= 2.0)
        & (normalized_range >= 1.5)
        & (close_location <= 0.25)
    )

    # At date s=t+1, use only the already-observed prior shock quantities.
    prior_shock = shock.shift(1).fillna(False).astype(bool)
    prior_low = low.shift(1)
    prior_high = high.shift(1)
    prior_range = shock_range.shift(1)
    prior_close_for_shock = close.shift(1)
    prior_volume_for_shock = volume.shift(1)
    prior_idiosyncratic = idiosyncratic_return.shift(1)
    prior_relative_volume = relative_volume.shift(1)
    prior_normalized_range = normalized_range.shift(1)

    current_range = high - low
    confirmation_valid = (
        valid_price
        & (volume > 0.0)
        & (current_range >= 0.0)
        & (prior_range > 0.0)
        & (prior_volume_for_shock > 0.0)
    )
    confirmed = (
        prior_shock
        & confirmation_valid
        & (low >= prior_low - 0.10 * prior_range)
        & (current_range <= 0.60 * prior_range)
        & (volume <= 0.70 * prior_volume_for_shock)
        & (close >= prior_close_for_shock + 0.25 * prior_range)
    )

    recovery = (close - prior_close_for_shock) / (0.25 * prior_range).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    raw_score = (
        (-prior_idiosyncratic / 0.04)
        * (prior_relative_volume / 2.0)
        * (prior_normalized_range / 1.5)
        * recovery
    )
    return raw_score.where(confirmed)


@register_factor
class FailedFollowthroughDownsideLiquidityRebound(BaseFactor):
    """Ranks confirmed bounded-extension sell-shock reversals."""

    factor_id = "failed_followthrough_downside_liquidity_rebound"
    name = "Bounded-Extension Downside Reversal"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks severe idiosyncratic sell shocks whose next session shows a "
        "bounded low extension, reduced activity and range, and a material "
        "close recovery, consistent with absorbed rather than renewed selling."
    )
    window_length = 21
    inputs = ["close", "high", "low", "volume"]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        raw_score = _confirmed_downside_reversal_score(
            close,
            data["high"],
            data["low"],
            data["volume"],
        )
        return rank(raw_score).fillna(0.0)

The interpretation is that temporary liquidity imbalance or urgent selling can create overshoot, but daily OHLCV cannot identify forced selling or latent limit demand directly; the predicted rebound is therefore an empirical implication to test rather than proof of that mechanism. programs.description: Let r(i,t)=close(i,t)/close(i,t-1)-1, m(t)=the cross-sectional median of valid r(i,t), x(i,t)=r(i,t)-m(t), RV(i,t)=volume(i,t)/mean(volume(i,t-20:t-1)), sigma(i,t)=std(r(i,t-20:t-1)), and NR(i,t)=((high(i,t)-low(i,t))/close(i,t-1))/sigma(i,t). A shock occurs on day t only when all of the following hold: r(i,t)<=-0.05; x(i,t)<=-0.04; RV(i,t)>=2.0; NR(i,t)>=1.5; and (close(i,t)-low(i,t))/(high(i,t)-low(i,t))<=0.25. Require valid positive prices, volume, nonzero shock-day range, and a full 20-prior-bar history. Confirmation is evaluated only after day t+1 closes and requires all of: low(i,t+1)>=low(i,t)-0.10*(high(i,t)-low(i,t)); (high(i,t+1)-low(i,t+1))<=0.60*(high(i,t)-low(i,t)); volume(i,t+1)<=0.70*volume(i,t); and close(i,t+1)>=close(i,t)+0.25*(high(i,t)-low(i,t)). For confirmed names, form raw_score=(-x(i,t)/0.04)*(RV(i,t)/2.0)*(NR(i,t)/1.5)*((close(i,t+1)-close(i,t))/(0.25*(high(i,t)-low(i,t)))), and use its cross-sectional percentile rank among confirmed names as the long score; nonconfirmed names receive no signal. The signal is timestamped at the close of t+1, entered at the next executable bar open, open(i,t+2), and evaluated over the six subsequent daily bars as close(i,t+7)/open(i,t+2)-1. Unlike balance-sheet-gated cooling-reversal factors, this specification uses no fundamental-quality gate; unlike refractory-endpoint factors, it does not require a prior drawdown endpoint or multi-day refractory condition. Its distinct conditioning feature is the exact maximum 10% shock-range low extension combined with a required 25% shock-range close recovery.

programs.code:
"""Solvency-conditioned polarity of cooling downside liquidity shocks.

Mechanism: range cooling after a persistent downside burst is a repair signal only
when a firm has sufficient cash and operating-cash-flow debt coverage.  In
financially fragile firms, an ongoing high-range, high-volume downside burst is
instead interpreted as reflexive constrained-selling pressure.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _numeric(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return frame.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")


def _cs_zscore(values: pd.DataFrame, valid: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Daily robust cross-sectional z-score, retaining only valid observations."""
    usable = values.where(valid & np.isfinite(values))
    lo = usable.quantile(0.05, axis=1)
    hi = usable.quantile(0.95, axis=1)
    clipped = usable.clip(lower=lo, upper=hi, axis=0)
    mean = clipped.mean(axis=1)
    std = clipped.std(axis=1, ddof=0).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    return clipped.sub(mean, axis=0).div(std, axis=0)


def _sector_relative(
    values: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame, eligible: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal same-bar sector-relative value; requires a minimally broad peer set."""
    out = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns, dtype=float)
    for i in range(len(values.index)):
        row = values.iloc[i]
        labels = sector.iloc[i].astype(object).where(sector.iloc[i].notna(), "__missing__")
        good = eligible.iloc[i] & row.notna() & np.isfinite(row)
        masked = row.where(good)
        group_mean = masked.groupby(labels).transform("mean")
        group_count = masked.groupby(labels).transform("count")
        out.iloc[i] = (row - group_mean).where(good & group_count.ge(5))
    return out


def _recent_update(field: pd.DataFrame, width: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Availability-date change flag, using only the present and prior observations."""
    previous = field.shift(1)
    changed = field.notna() & (previous.isna() | field.ne(previous))
    return changed.astype(float).rolling(width, min_periods=1).max().fillna(0.0).gt(0.0)


@register_factor
class SolvencyPolarizedCoolingReflexivity(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "solvency_polarized_cooling_reflexivity"
    name = "Solvency-Polarized Cooling Reflexivity"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Long solvent names whose persistent sector-relative downside range burst "
        "has cooled, and short fragile names retaining abnormal downside range and "
        "volume excitation after a comparable shock."
    )
    window_length = 25
    inputs = [
        "close",
        "high",
        "low",
        "volume",
        "cash",
        "operatingCashFlow",
        "totalDebt",
        "sector",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = _numeric(data["close"])
        high = _numeric(data["high"])
        low = _numeric(data["low"])
        volume = _numeric(data["volume"])
        cash = _numeric(data["cash"])
        ocf = _numeric(data["operatingCashFlow"])
        debt = _numeric(data["totalDebt"])
        sector = data["sector"]

        price_ok = close.gt(0.0) & high.gt(0.0) & low.gt(0.0)
        history_ok = price_ok.astype(float).shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum().eq(20.0)
        fundamental_ok = cash.notna() & ocf.notna() & debt.gt(0.0)
        eligible = price_ok & history_ok & fundamental_ok & volume.notna()

        cash_cover = cash / debt.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        ocf_cover = ocf / debt.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        fragility = -0.5 * _cs_zscore(cash_cover, fundamental_ok)
        fragility = fragility - 0.5 * _cs_zscore(ocf_cover, fundamental_ok)
        resilience = (-fragility).clip(lower=0.0)
        fragility = fragility.clip(lower=0.0)

        log_ret = np.log(close / close.shift(1))
        sector_ret = _sector_relative(log_ret, sector, eligible)
        prior_sector_ret = sector_ret.shift(1)
        sigma = prior_sector_ret.rolling(20, min_periods=15).std(ddof=0).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        downside_pressure = (-sector_ret.rolling(3, min_periods=3).sum() / (np.sqrt(3.0) * sigma) - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0)

        raw_range = ((high - low) / close.replace(0.0, np.nan)).where(price_ok)
        log_range = np.log(raw_range.where(raw_range.gt(0.000001), 0.000001))
        prior_range = log_range.shift(1)
        range_mean = prior_range.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
        range_std = prior_range.rolling(20, min_periods=15).std(ddof=0).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        range_z = (log_range - range_mean) / range_std

        lagged_z = [range_z.shift(k) for k in range(1, 5)]
        prior_count = sum(x.notna().astype(float) for x in lagged_z)
        prior_mean = sum(x.fillna(0.0) for x in lagged_z) / 4.0
        prior_var = sum((x.fillna(0.0) - prior_mean).pow(2) for x in lagged_z) / 4.0
        heterogeneous_burst = np.sqrt(prior_var).where(prior_count.eq(4.0))
        burst_count = sum(x.gt(1.0).astype(float) for x in lagged_z)
        burst_strength = (burst_count - 2.0).clip(lower=0.0)
        cooling = (prior_mean - range_z - 0.5).clip(lower=0.0)
        still_hot = range_z.clip(lower=0.0)

        prior_returns = [log_ret.shift(k) for k in range(1, 5)]
        down_count = sum(x.lt(0.0).astype(float) for x in prior_returns)
        directional_down = (down_count - 2.0).clip(lower=0.0)

        log_volume = np.log1p(volume.where(volume.ge(0.0)))
        prior_volume = log_volume.shift(1)
        volume_mean = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
        volume_std = prior_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).std(ddof=0).replace(0.0, np.nan)
        abnormal_volume = ((log_volume - volume_mean) / volume_std - 0.5).clip(lower=0.0)

        five_day_relative = _sector_relative(
            np.log(close / close.shift(5)), sector, eligible
        )
        relative_weakness = _cs_zscore(-five_day_relative, eligible).clip(lower=0.0)
        heterogeneity = _cs_zscore(heterogeneous_burst, eligible).clip(lower=0.0)

        surprise_window = (
            _recent_update(_numeric(data["epsSurprise"]), 5)
            | _recent_update(_numeric(data["revenueSurprise"]), 5)
        )
        clean = (~surprise_window).astype(float)

        repair = (
            resilience
            * burst_strength
            * directional_down
            * cooling
            * relative_weakness
            * (1.0 + heterogeneity)
            * clean
        )
        continuation = (
            fragility
            * downside_pressure
            * abnormal_volume
            * still_hot
            * directional_down
            * clean
        )
        polarity = (repair - continuation).where(eligible & range_z.notna(), 0.0)
        return polarity.rank(axis=1, pct=True).fillna(0.5)
programs.name: Solvency-Polarized Cooling Reflexivity
programs.trading_idea: A downward range-and-volume burst can be either an exhausted liquidity liquidation or the beginning of a financing-reflexive sell cascade. The child explicitly makes cooling shocks bullish only when cash and operating-cash-flow coverage imply that the seller is unlikely to be forced, while assigning a negative score when the same downside excitation remains hot in financially fragile firms. Neither parent alone distinguishes a mechanically oversold but solvent name from a superficially cooling distress episode whose constrained risk-bearing can restart selling.
programs.description: The signal contrasts a resilient post-burst range-cooling repair state with a fragile, abnormal-volume downside-excitation continuation state, both measured relative to sector peers and excluding fresh fundamental-surprise windows. It cross-sectionally ranks the resulting signed polarity score.

programs.code:
"""This is a conditional post-release price-discovery signal, not a claim that quiet trading uniquely identifies unfinished informed execution. A materially credible earnings release can initially encounter an opening auction move in the opposite direction; when the close fully rejects that displacement and the next two completed sessions retain the recovery with lower relative trading impact, the event appears to have resolved toward the fundamental-news direction rather than remained an unstable opening-auction reversal. The prediction is that these confirmed disagreement-resolution events have signed, sector-adjusted continuation over the six daily bars after the confirmation-based entry."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_benchmark(
    values: pd.DataFrame,
    valid: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal daily sector median, with a market-median fallback below five names."""
    labels = sector.iloc[0].fillna("__UNKNOWN__").astype(str)
    masked = values.where(valid)
    market = masked.median(axis=1)
    output = pd.DataFrame(
        np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns, dtype=float
    )

    for label in labels.unique():
        cols = labels.index[labels == label]
        group_values = masked.loc[:, cols]
        group_median = group_values.median(axis=1)
        group_count = group_values.notna().sum(axis=1)
        benchmark = group_median.where(group_count >= 5, market)
        output.loc[:, cols] = np.asarray(benchmark)[:, None]

    return output


def _sector_neutral_score(
    score: pd.DataFrame,
    qualified: pd.DataFrame,
    sector: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Neutralize qualifying scores by sector, using qualified-universe mean as fallback."""
    labels = sector.iloc[0].fillna("__UNKNOWN__").astype(str)
    active_score = score.where(qualified)
    universe_mean = active_score.mean(axis=1).fillna(0.0)
    output = pd.DataFrame(
        0.0, index=score.index, columns=score.columns, dtype=float
    )

    for label in labels.unique():
        cols = labels.index[labels == label]
        group_score = active_score.loc[:, cols]
        group_mean = group_score.mean(axis=1)
        group_count = group_score.notna().sum(axis=1)
        reference = group_mean.where(group_count >= 5, universe_mean).fillna(0.0)
        neutral = group_score.sub(reference, axis=0).where(
            qualified.loc[:, cols], 0.0
        )
        output.loc[:, cols] = neutral.fillna(0.0)

    return output


@register_factor
class CredibleAuctionRejectionScheduleCarry(BaseFactor):
    """Confirmed credible earnings surprises whose adverse auction gaps are rejected."""

    factor_id = "credible_auction_rejection_schedule_carry"
    name = "Credible Auction Rejection Confirmation"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Scores credible earnings surprises that suffer a sector-adjusted adverse "
        "opening gap, reject it by the close, and retain the recovery through two "
        "lower-volume, lower-range confirmation sessions."
    )
    window_length = 23
    inputs = [
        "epsActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "epsEstimate",
        "revenue",
        "operatingIncome",
        "incomeTaxExpense",
        "open",
        "high",
        "low",
        "close",
        "volume",
        "sector",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        open_price = data["open"]
        high = data["high"]
        low = data["low"]
        volume = data["volume"]
        sector = data["sector"]

        eps_actual = data["epsActual"]
        eps_surprise = data["epsSurprise"]
        eps_estimate = data["epsEstimate"]
        revenue = data["revenue"]
        operating_income = data["operatingIncome"]
        tax_expense = data["incomeTaxExpense"]

        prior_actual = eps_actual.ffill().shift(1)
        event = (
            eps_actual.notna()
            & prior_actual.notna()
            & eps_actual.ne(prior_actual)
        )

        prior_revenue = revenue.ffill().shift(1)
        prior_operating_income = operating_income.ffill().shift(1)
        prior_tax_expense = tax_expense.ffill().shift(1)

        estimate_abs = eps_estimate.abs()
        surprise_direction = np.sign(eps_surprise)
        surprise_ratio = eps_surprise / estimate_abs.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        margin = operating_income / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        prior_margin = prior_operating_income / prior_revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        tax_rate = tax_expense / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        prior_tax_rate = prior_tax_expense / prior_revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        margin_change = margin - prior_margin
        tax_change = tax_rate - prior_tax_rate

        current_financial_valid = (
            event
            & eps_surprise.notna()
            & (estimate_abs > 0.0)
            & revenue.notna()
            & (revenue > 0.0)
            & operating_income.notna()
            & tax_expense.notna()
            & prior_revenue.notna()
            & (prior_revenue > 0.0)
            & prior_operating_income.notna()
            & prior_tax_expense.notna()
            & margin_change.notna()
            & tax_change.notna()
            & (surprise_direction != 0.0)
        )

        surprise_threshold = surprise_ratio.abs().where(current_financial_valid).quantile(
            0.70, axis=1
        )
        large_surprise = surprise_ratio.abs().ge(surprise_threshold, axis=0)
        credible = (
            current_financial_valid
            & large_surprise
            & (surprise_direction * margin_change > 0.0)
            & (tax_change.abs() <= margin_change.abs())
        )

        prior_close = close.shift(1)
        close_return = close / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
        overnight_gap = open_price / prior_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0

        close_valid = close.notna() & prior_close.notna() & (close > 0.0) & (prior_close > 0.0)
        gap_valid = (
            close_valid
            & open_price.notna()
            & (open_price > 0.0)
        )
        sector_close_return = _sector_benchmark(close_return, close_valid, sector)
        sector_gap = _sector_benchmark(overnight_gap, gap_valid, sector)

        adjusted_gap = overnight_gap - sector_gap
        pre_event_mad_gap = adjusted_gap.abs().shift(1).rolling(
            20, min_periods=20
        ).median()
        standardized_gap = (
            surprise_direction * adjusted_gap / pre_event_mad_gap.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        )
        close_rejection = surprise_direction * (close_return - sector_close_return) > 0.0

        bar_range = (high - low) / close.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        pre_event_volume = volume.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        pre_event_range = bar_range.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()

        event_price_valid = (
            open_price.notna()
            & high.notna()
            & low.notna()
            & close.notna()
            & volume.notna()
            & (open_price > 0.0)
            & (high > 0.0)
            & (low > 0.0)
            & (close > 0.0)
            & (volume > 0.0)
        )
        event_gate = (
            credible
            & event_price_valid
            & (pre_event_mad_gap > 0.0)
            & (standardized_gap <= -1.0)
            & close_rejection
        )

        event_gate_at_formation = event_gate.shift(2).fillna(False)
        direction_at_formation = surprise_direction.shift(2)
        surprise_at_formation = surprise_ratio.abs().shift(2)
        volume_median_at_formation = pre_event_volume.shift(2)
        range_median_at_formation = pre_event_range.shift(2)
        event_close_at_formation = close.shift(2)

        volume_first = volume.shift(1)
        range_first = bar_range.shift(1)
        volume_compression = -0.5 * (
            np.log(volume_first / volume_median_at_formation.replace(0.0, np.nan))
            + np.log(volume / volume_first.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        )
        range_compression = -0.5 * (
            np.log(range_first / range_median_at_formation.replace(0.0, np.nan))
            + np.log(bar_range / range_first.replace(0.0, np.nan))
        )

        benchmark_one = sector_close_return.shift(1)
        benchmark_two = (1.0 + benchmark_one) * (1.0 + sector_close_return) - 1.0
        retention_one = direction_at_formation * (
            close.shift(1) / event_close_at_formation.replace(0.0, np.nan)
            - 1.0
            - benchmark_one
        )
        retention_two = direction_at_formation * (
            close / event_close_at_formation.replace(0.0, np.nan)
            - 1.0
            - benchmark_two
        )
        retention = pd.DataFrame(
            np.minimum(retention_one.to_numpy(), retention_two.to_numpy()),
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        )

        confirmation_valid = (
            volume_first.notna()
            & volume.notna()
            & (volume_first > 0.0)
            & (volume > 0.0)
            & range_first.notna()
            & bar_range.notna()
            & (range_first > 0.0)
            & (bar_range > 0.0)
            & (volume_median_at_formation > 0.0)
            & (range_median_at_formation > 0.0)
            & event_close_at_formation.notna()
            & (event_close_at_formation > 0.0)
            & retention.notna()
        )
        qualified = (
            event_gate_at_formation
            & confirmation_valid
            & (retention > 0.0)
            & (volume_compression > 0.0)
            & (range_compression > 0.0)
        )

        rank_surprise = surprise_at_formation.where(qualified).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        rank_retention = retention.where(qualified).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        rank_volume = volume_compression.where(qualified).rank(axis=1, pct=True)
        rank_range = range_compression.where(qualified).rank(axis=1, pct=True)

        raw_score = (
            direction_at_formation
            * rank_surprise
            * rank_retention
            * rank_volume
            * rank_range
        ).where(qualified, 0.0)

        return _sector_neutral_score(raw_score, qualified, sector).fillna(0.0)
programs.name: Credible Auction Rejection Confirmation
programs.trading_idea: This is a conditional post-release price-discovery signal, not a claim that quiet trading uniquely identifies unfinished informed execution. A materially credible earnings release can initially encounter an opening auction move in the opposite direction; when the close fully rejects that displacement and the next two completed sessions retain the recovery with lower relative trading impact, the event appears to have resolved toward the fundamental-news direction rather than remained an unstable opening-auction reversal. The prediction is that these confirmed disagreement-resolution events have signed, sector-adjusted continuation over the six daily bars after the confirmation-based entry.
programs.description: Event timing and entry are explicitly separated. For stock i, let e be the first trading date on which epsActual_i is non-null and differs from its prior non-null point-in-time value; e is therefore the feed-stamped earnings-release session. If an announcement occurs overnight, the feed-stamped next trading session is e; if announced on a non-trading day, e is the first subsequent trading session carrying the point-in-time update. No attempt is made to infer an intraday announcement time unavailable in the data. A candidate is discarded if epsSurprise, epsEstimate, revenue, operatingIncome, incomeTaxExpense, open, high, low, close, volume, or the required prior-history observations are missing or non-positive where needed for logarithms and ratios. The prior report snapshot, denoted x^-_i, is the immediately preceding distinct point-in-time value before e, rather than a fixed calendar lag. Define surprise u_i = epsSurprise_i,e / abs(epsEstimate_i,e), requiring abs(epsEstimate_i,e) > 0, and direction s_i = sign(epsSurprise_i,e). Require s_i to be non-zero and abs(u_i) to be at or above the cross-sectional 70th percentile among eligible release events on e. Define operating margin m_i = operatingIncome_i / revenue_i and tax-rate proxy tau_i = incomeTaxExpense_i / revenue_i using the current and prior-report snapshots. The operating/tax credibility gate is C_i = 1 only when s_i*(m_i,e - m^-_i) > 0 and abs(tau_i,e - tau^-_i) <= abs(m_i,e - m^-_i); otherwise C_i = 0. Thus the surprise direction must agree with a newly public operating-margin improvement or deterioration, and the contemporaneous tax-rate change cannot be larger than the operating-margin change. For every date d, define the market benchmark as the cross-sectional median close-to-close return of all valid stocks, and define the sector benchmark as the median return of valid stocks in i's sector when that sector has at least five valid names; otherwise use the market median. The sector benchmark is the market-and-sector adjustment used below, since a sector median embeds the common market move while removing sector-wide repricing. Define raw overnight gap g_i,e = open_i,e / close_i,e-1 - 1 and benchmark overnight gap Bgap_i,e as the corresponding sector-median raw overnight gap, with market fallback. Define G_i = g_i,e - Bgap_i,e. Let MADG_i be the median of abs(g_i,d - Bgap_i,d) over d = e-20,...,e-1; require MADG_i > 0. The signed abnormal opening-gap measure is Zgap_i = s_i*G_i/MADG_i. The event must open against the credible surprise by at least one pre-event median absolute sector-adjusted gap: Zgap_i <= -1. The close-based rejection criterion is s_i*(close_i,e / close_i,e-1 - 1 - Bcc_i,e) > 0, where Bcc is the sector-adjusted close-to-close benchmark return. This requires the event session to finish on the fundamental-news side of the prior close, not merely above its own opening price. Confirmation uses only the two fully completed sessions e+1 and e+2. Define daily range x_i,d = (high_i,d - low_i,d) / close_i,d. Let Vmed_i and Xmed_i be the medians of volume and x, respectively, over the 20 pre-event sessions e-20,...,e-1; require both medians to be positive. Define volume-impact compression QV_i = -0.5*[ln(volume_i,e+1/Vmed_i) + ln(volume_i,e+2/volume_i,e+1)], and range-impact compression QX_i = -0.5*[ln(x_i,e+1/Xmed_i) + ln(x_i,e+2/Xmed_i)]. Thus QV_i > 0 requires both lower-than-normal first-confirmation volume in aggregate and further volume contraction into the second session; QX_i > 0 analogously requires compressed ranges relative to pre-event conditions and further compression. Define sector-adjusted retention over the completed confirmation window as QR_i = min(s_i*((close_i,e+1/close_i,e)-1-B1_i), s_i*((close_i,e+2/close_i,e)-1-B2_i)), where B1_i and B2_i are the matching cumulative sector benchmark close returns from e to e+1 and e to e+2. Require QR_i > 0, QV_i > 0, and QX_i > 0. At the close of e+2, compute cross-sectional percentile ranks among names satisfying every preceding gate: P_U for abs(u), P_R for QR, P_V for QV, and P_X for QX. The tradable score available at that timestamp is Score_i,e+2 = s_i*C_i*P_U*P_R*P_V*P_X; all non-qualifying names receive zero. The score is sector-neutralized at formation by subtracting the same-date mean score within sector, using the full-universe mean as fallback for sectors with fewer than five scored names. Trade entry is the open of e+3, after both confirmation bars have closed. The six-bar realized return is measured strictly from this entry timestamp as close_i,e+8 / open_i,e+3 - 1; a sector-adjusted evaluation return subtracts the sector benchmark compounded over the same open-to-close interval. Consequently, no information from e+3 or later enters the score. If multiple release events for a stock occur within the active interval, the earlier event remains active through e+8 and any later event before that exit is ignored; if signals from different eligible events would otherwise overlap, the most recent entered signal replaces the prior position for that stock. This explicit construction is the exposure record for duplication testing: it is a gated interaction of standardized surprise magnitude, operating-versus-tax credibility, one-MAD sector-adjusted adverse opening gap, full close rejection through the prior close, and two completed low-impact sector-adjusted retention sessions.

"""A large one-day move that closes near the bar extreme, occurs on unusually high own-name trading activity, and has unusually large range relative to that activity is interpreted as a liquidity-stress episode rather than evidence of a specifically identified corporate flow. Such episodes can leave liquidity providers and short-horizon traders carrying unwanted directional inventory; absent a broader market, sector, or earnings-information shock, subsequent inventory reduction should partially reverse the pressure over the next six trading days. The hypothesis therefore predicts positive future returns after downward liquidity-stress bars and negative future returns after upward liquidity-stress bars."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _aligned_sector_frame(
    value: pd.DataFrame | pd.Series, template: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return sector labels in the price panel's shape without Series column reindexing."""
    if isinstance(value, pd.DataFrame):
        return value.reindex(index=template.index, columns=template.columns)

    if isinstance(value, pd.Series):
        by_ticker = value.reindex(template.columns)
        matrix = np.tile(by_ticker.to_numpy(), (len(template.index), 1))
        return pd.DataFrame(matrix, index=template.index, columns=template.columns)

    return pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=template.index, columns=template.columns)


def _winsorize_cross_section(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Causal same-date 1st/99th percentile cross-sectional winsorization."""
    lower = df.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
    upper = df.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
    return df.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)


def _report_change(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Flag newly available or revised point-in-time report observations."""
    previous = frame.shift(1)
    return frame.notna() & (previous.isna() | frame.ne(previous))


def _sector_columns(sector: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[object, list[object]]:
    """Build static sector membership while tolerating sparse label panels."""
    groups: dict[object, list[object]] = {}
    for column in sector.columns:
        observed = sector[column].dropna()
        if not observed.empty:
            label = observed.iloc[0]
            groups.setdefault(label, []).append(column)
    return groups


@register_factor
class LiquidityStressInventoryReversal(BaseFactor):
    """Reverses extreme, high-impact directional bars absent broad or earnings events."""

    factor_id = "liquidity_stress_inventory_reversal"
    name = "Liquidity-Stress Inventory Reversal"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Sector-neutral reversal score for one-day directional liquidity-stress "
        "bars: abnormal own-name activity, unusually high range relative to "
        "that activity, and an extreme close location, excluding broad volume "
        "and recent earnings-report events."
    )
    window_length = 252
    inputs = [
        "open",
        "high",
        "low",
        "close",
        "volume",
        "sector",
        "epsActual",
        "revenueActual",
        "epsSurprise",
        "revenueSurprise",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"]
        open_ = data["open"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        high = data["high"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        low = data["low"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        volume = data["volume"].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        sector = _aligned_sector_frame(data["sector"], close)

        positive_prices = (
            open_.gt(0.0)
            & high.gt(0.0)
            & low.gt(0.0)
            & close.gt(0.0)
        )
        dollar_volume = (close * volume).where(volume.gt(0.0))
        positive_dollar_volume = dollar_volume.where(dollar_volume.gt(0.0))
        sufficient_history = (
            positive_dollar_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).count().ge(20)
        )
        eligible = positive_prices & sufficient_history & sector.notna()

        log_dollar_volume = np.log(positive_dollar_volume)
        median_log_dollar_volume = log_dollar_volume.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        abnormal_activity = log_dollar_volume - median_log_dollar_volume
        activity_ratio = np.exp(abnormal_activity)

        daily_range = ((high - low).clip(lower=0.0) / close).where(positive_prices)
        relative_impact = np.log(
            (daily_range + 1.0e-6) / (activity_ratio + 1.0e-6)
        )

        v_rank = _winsorize_cross_section(abnormal_activity.where(eligible)).rank(
            axis=1, pct=True
        )
        b_rank = _winsorize_cross_section(relative_impact.where(eligible)).rank(
            axis=1, pct=True
        )

        range_width = high - low
        close_location = ((close - low) / range_width.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 0.5)
        close_location = close_location.where(range_width.ne(0.0), 0.0)
        extremeness = (2.0 * close_location.abs()).clip(upper=1.0)
        intraday_return = close / open_.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0

        unadjusted = (
            -np.sign(intraday_return) * v_rank * b_rank * extremeness
        ).where(eligible)

        market_activity = activity_ratio.where(eligible).median(axis=1)
        market_threshold = market_activity.rolling(252, min_periods=126).quantile(0.95)
        market_shock = market_threshold.notna() & market_activity.gt(market_threshold)

        groups = _sector_columns(sector)
        sector_shock = pd.DataFrame(False, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        sector_demeaned = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

        for _, columns in groups.items():
            group_activity = activity_ratio.loc[:, columns].where(eligible.loc[:, columns])
            group_median = group_activity.median(axis=1)
            group_threshold = group_median.rolling(252, min_periods=126).quantile(0.95)
            group_shock = group_threshold.notna() & group_median.gt(group_threshold)
            shock_values = np.repeat(group_shock.to_numpy()[:, None], len(columns), axis=1)
            sector_shock.loc[:, columns] = shock_values

        report_event = pd.DataFrame(False, index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
        for field in ("epsActual", "revenueActual", "epsSurprise", "revenueSurprise"):
            report = data[field].reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
            changed = _report_change(report)
            report_event = report_event | changed | changed.shift(1).fillna(False) | changed.shift(2).fillna(False)

        remaining = eligible & ~sector_shock & ~market_shock.to_numpy()[:, None] & ~report_event
        retained_unadjusted = unadjusted.where(remaining)

        for _, columns in groups.items():
            group_score = retained_unadjusted.loc[:, columns]
            group_mean = group_score.mean(axis=1)
            demeaned = group_score.sub(group_mean, axis=0)
            sector_demeaned.loc[:, columns] = demeaned

        final_raw = _winsorize_cross_section(sector_demeaned.where(remaining))
        return final_raw.rank(axis=1, pct=True).sub(0.5).where(remaining)

programs.trading_idea: A large one-day move that closes near the bar extreme, occurs on unusually high own-name trading activity, and has unusually large range relative to that activity is interpreted as a liquidity-stress episode rather than evidence of a specifically identified corporate flow. Such episodes can leave liquidity providers and short-horizon traders carrying unwanted directional inventory; absent a broader market, sector, or earnings-information shock, subsequent inventory reduction should partially reverse the pressure over the next six trading days. The hypothesis therefore predicts positive future returns after downward liquidity-stress bars and negative future returns after upward liquidity-stress bars.
programs.description: At decision time t, use only OHLCV bars dated t or earlier. The eligible universe contains tickers with positive open, high, low, close, and volume at t; at least 20 prior daily observations of positive dollar volume; and a non-null sector label. Define dollar volume DV_i,t = close_i,t * volume_i,t, daily range R_i,t = (high_i,t - low_i,t) / close_i,t, intraday return r_i,t = close_i,t / open_i,t - 1, and close-location CLV_i,t = ((close_i,t - low_i,t) / (high_i,t - low_i,t) - 0.5), setting CLV to 0 when high equals low. Define abnormal activity v_i,t = log(DV_i,t) - median(log(DV_i,t-19:t)); no future observations are used. Define the relative-impact measure b_i,t = log((R_i,t + 1e-6) / (exp(v_i,t) + 1e-6)). At each t, winsorize v and b independently across the eligible universe at the 1st and 99th cross-sectional percentiles, then convert each to cross-sectional percentile ranks A_i,t and B_i,t in [0,1]. Define extremeness C_i,t = min(1, 2 * abs(CLV_i,t)). The unadjusted reversal score is U_i,t = -sign(r_i,t) * A_i,t * B_i,t * C_i,t, with sign(0) = 0. Thus, a high-volume, high-relative-impact downward bar receives a positive score and an analogous upward bar receives a negative score. To avoid trading broad information or volume events, compute M_t as the cross-sectional median of exp(v_i,t), and compute M's 95th percentile using only M_t-251 through M_t, requiring at least 126 observations. Exclude all names on dates where M_t exceeds that trailing threshold. Separately, within each sector compute the sector median of exp(v_i,t), compare it with that sector's trailing 252-bar 95th percentile with at least 126 observations, and exclude names in sectors exceeding that threshold. Exclude a ticker at t when epsActual, revenueActual, epsSurprise, or revenueSurprise newly changes from its t-1 point-in-time value on t, or changed on either of t-1 or t-2; a new non-null report after a null value counts as a change. These exclusions are the available-data proxies for earnings releases and market-, sector-, or index-like volume shocks. For remaining names, demean U within sector, winsorize the sector-demeaned values across the remaining universe at the 1st and 99th percentiles, and transform them to a final cross-sectional percentile rank minus 0.5. Missing or excluded observations are NaN, not zero. The factor is evaluated after the close of t, and its realized return is measured strictly from t+1 through t+6. Unlike corporate-supply and low-impact continuation signals, this construction contains no net issuance, SBC, repurchase, or share-count input and deliberately requires high, not muted, impact relative to abnormal activity; its distinct interaction is one-sided close location × abnormal activity × relative price impact, conditioned on the absence of observable broad or earnings events.

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.ops import rank
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _sector_residual(values: pd.DataFrame, sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Cross-sectional sector demeaning using only contemporaneous labels."""
    output = values.copy()
    for label in pd.unique(sector.to_numpy().ravel()):
        if pd.isna(label):
            continue
        members = sector.eq(label).fillna(False)
        group_mean = values.where(members).mean(axis=1)
        output = output.mask(members, values.sub(group_mean, axis=0))
    return output


def _accepted_retest(
    open_: pd.DataFrame,
    high: pd.DataFrame,
    low: pd.DataFrame,
    close: pd.DataFrame,
    volume: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Signed acceptance after a low-participation adverse retest, causally measured."""
    previous_close = close.shift(1)
    ret = close / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0
    volatility = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std()
    mean_volume = volume.rolling(20, min_periods=15).mean()
    relative_volume = volume / mean_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    bar_range = (high - low).clip(lower=0.001 * previous_close.abs())
    bar_range = bar_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    close_location = (close - low) / bar_range

    prior_ret = ret.shift(1)
    prior_volatility = volatility.shift(1)
    prior_relative_volume = relative_volume.shift(1)
    prior_location = close_location.shift(1)
    prior_volume = volume.shift(1)
    direction = np.sign(prior_ret)

    opening_extension = direction * (open_ / previous_close.replace(0.0, np.nan) - 1.0)
    upward_probe = (open_ - low) / bar_range
    downward_probe = (high - open_) / bar_range
    adverse_probe = upward_probe.where(direction.gt(0.0), downward_probe)
    retained_direction = direction * (close - previous_close) / bar_range
    volume_ratio = volume / prior_volume.replace(0.0, np.nan)

    directional_close = (
        (direction.gt(0.0) & prior_location.ge(0.70))
        | (direction.lt(0.0) & prior_location.le(0.30))
    )
    valid = (
        close.gt(0.0)
        & previous_close.gt(0.0)
        & open_.gt(0.0)
        & high.gt(0.0)
        & low.gt(0.0)
        & volume.gt(0.0)
        & prior_volume.gt(0.0)
        & prior_volatility.gt(0.0)
        & mean_volume.gt(0.0)
    )
    qualifies = (
        valid
        & direction.ne(0.0)
        & prior_ret.abs().ge(0.75 * prior_volatility)
        & prior_relative_volume.ge(1.25)
        & directional_close
        & opening_extension.ge(0.002)
        & adverse_probe.ge(0.30)
        & retained_direction.ge(0.0)
        & volume_ratio.le(0.75)
        & relative_volume.le(1.00)
    )
    strength = (
        (prior_ret.abs() / prior_volatility).clip(upper=3.0)
        * prior_relative_volume.clip(upper=3.0)
        * adverse_probe.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
        * retained_direction.clip(lower=0.0, upper=1.5)
    )
    return (direction * strength).where(qualifies, 0.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)


def _decayed_state(impulse: pd.DataFrame, decay: float) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Deterministic causal exponential event-memory state."""
    values = impulse.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0).to_numpy(dtype=float)
    output = np.zeros_like(values)
    state = np.zeros(values.shape[1], dtype=float)
    for t in range(values.shape[0]):
        state = np.clip(decay * state + values[t], -4.0, 4.0)
        output[t] = state
    return pd.DataFrame(output, index=impulse.index, columns=impulse.columns)


@register_factor
class RevisionVerifiedThinRetestDrift(BaseFactor):
    factor_id = "revision_verified_thin_retest_drift"
    name = "Revision-Verified Thin Retest Drift"
    category = "momentum"
    description = (
        "Carries muted sector-relative estimate revisions only after a revision-aligned, "
        "low-volume adverse retest accepts the prior impulse, with delivery-quality gating."
    )
    window_length = 181
    inputs = [
        "open", "high", "low", "close", "volume", "epsEstimate", "revenueEstimate",
        "sector", "receivables", "inventory", "operatingCashFlow", "revenue",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        eps = data["epsEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue_est = data["revenueEstimate"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        revenue = data["revenue"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        receivables = data["receivables"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        inventory = data["inventory"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        ocf = data["operatingCashFlow"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        prior_eps = eps.shift(1)
        prior_revenue_est = revenue_est.shift(1)
        eps_event = eps.notna() & prior_eps.notna() & eps.ne(prior_eps)
        revenue_event = revenue_est.notna() & prior_revenue_est.notna() & revenue_est.ne(prior_revenue_est)
        eps_revision = ((eps - prior_eps) / (prior_eps.abs() + 0.01)).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        sales_revision = ((revenue_est - prior_revenue_est) / (prior_revenue_est.abs() + 1_000_000.0)).clip(-1.0, 1.0)
        weights = eps_event.astype(float) * 2.0 / 3.0 + revenue_event.astype(float) / 3.0
        revision = (
            eps_revision.where(eps_event, 0.0) * 2.0 / 3.0
            + sales_revision.where(revenue_event, 0.0) / 3.0
        ) / weights.replace(0.0, np.nan)

        prior_revenue = revenue.shift(1)
        prior_receivables = receivables.shift(1)
        prior_inventory = inventory.shift(1)
        prior_ocf = ocf.shift(1)
        report_update = revenue.notna() & prior_revenue.notna() & revenue.ne(prior_revenue)
        receivable_pressure = (receivables - prior_receivables) / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        inventory_pressure = (inventory - prior_inventory) / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        margin_change = ocf / revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan) - prior_ocf / prior_revenue.replace(0.0, np.nan)
        pressure = ((receivable_pressure + inventory_pressure - margin_change) / 3.0).clip(-0.5, 0.5)
        persistent_pressure = np.tanh(4.0 * pressure).where(report_update).ffill(limit=180).fillna(0.0)

        daily_return = close.pct_change().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        sector_return = _sector_residual(daily_return, data["sector"])
        revision_lag = revision.shift(1)
        volatility = daily_return.rolling(20, min_periods=5).std().fillna(0.03).clip(lower=0.005)
        aligned_response = np.sign(revision_lag) * sector_return
        recognition_gap = (1.0 - aligned_response / (2.0 * volatility)).clip(0.0, 2.0)

        cleanliness = (1.0 - persistent_pressure.shift(1).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.85)).clip(0.15, 1.0)
        cleanliness = cleanliness.where(revision_lag.gt(0.0), 1.0)
        acceptance = _accepted_retest(data["open"], data["high"], data["low"], close, data["volume"])
        aligned_acceptance = acceptance * np.sign(revision_lag)
        valid = revision_lag.notna() & sector_return.notna() & close.gt(0.0) & aligned_acceptance.gt(0.0)
        impulse = (
            revision_lag
            * recognition_gap
            * cleanliness
            * aligned_acceptance.clip(upper=6.0)
        ).where(valid, 0.0)

        carried = _decayed_state(impulse, 0.76)
        signal = 2.0 * rank(carried.where(close.gt(0.0))) - 1.0
        return signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0).reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)

programs.trading_idea: An analyst revision that receives little sector-relative price recognition is more likely to represent delayed information diffusion when the next session retests the revision-day move on lower participation but retains acceptance in the original direction. The thin adverse probe distinguishes an underreacted fundamental catalyst from a revision that is being actively rejected by informed liquidity demand. Clean working-capital and cash-conversion delivery further makes a positive revision credible, so the interaction identifies revisions whose slow recognition is reinforced rather than invalidated by the market's inventory-transfer state.
programs.description: The signal carries analyst EPS/revenue revisions only when their next-day sector-relative response is muted and a low-volume adverse retest accepts the revision-aligned prior impulse. Positive revisions are discounted when the latest reporting update shows receivable, inventory, or operating-cash-flow pressure.

programs.code:
"""During broad market stress, investors needing immediate cash may preferentially transact in financially resilient, highly tradable names because those positions can absorb larger notional execution with less immediate implementation risk than illiquid or financially fragile holdings. The hypothesis is not that all liquid-quality stocks fall in stress, but that an unusually large same-day directional execution imbalance in this specific group, when not accompanied by a material overnight repricing, reflects a partially completed flow and has short-horizon continuation. The quality and tradability conditions identify plausible funding vehicles, while sector-relative residualization removes common sector news and sector-basket moves that can otherwise resemble forced-flow pressure."""

from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_fund_agent.factors.base import BaseFactor
from quant_fund_agent.factors.registry import register_factor


def _winsorize_cross_section(
    values: pd.DataFrame, eligible: pd.DataFrame
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Winsorize valid observations independently on each date."""
    masked = values.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).where(eligible)
    lower = masked.quantile(0.01, axis=1)
    upper = masked.quantile(0.99, axis=1)
    return masked.clip(lower=lower, upper=upper, axis=0)


def _static_sector_labels(sector: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Extract one static sector label per ticker without using price data."""
    labels: dict[object, object] = {}
    for column in sector.columns:
        observed = sector[column].dropna()
        labels[column] = observed.iloc[0] if not observed.empty else np.nan
    return pd.Series(labels, index=sector.columns, dtype=object)


def _sector_rank(
    values: pd.DataFrame,
    labels: pd.Series,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Date-by-date percentile rank within static sector groups."""
    source = values if eligible is None else values.where(eligible)
    output = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=values.index, columns=values.columns)

    for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        columns = labels.index[labels == label]
        if len(columns) > 0:
            output.loc[:, columns] = source.loc[:, columns].rank(axis=1, pct=True)
    return output


def _sector_pressure_and_count(
    pressure: pd.DataFrame,
    labels: pd.Series,
    eligible: pd.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Causally form same-date sector residuals and eligible sector counts."""
    residual = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=pressure.index, columns=pressure.columns)
    count = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pressure.index, columns=pressure.columns)
    masked_pressure = pressure.where(eligible)

    for label in pd.unique(labels.dropna()):
        columns = labels.index[labels == label]
        if len(columns) == 0:
            continue
        group_values = masked_pressure.loc[:, columns]
        group_mean = group_values.mean(axis=1)
        group_count = group_values.notna().sum(axis=1).astype(float)
        residual.loc[:, columns] = group_values.sub(group_mean, axis=0)
        count.loc[:, columns] = np.repeat(
            group_count.to_numpy()[:, None], len(columns), axis=1
        )

    return residual, count


@register_factor
class StressLiquidQualityExecutionCarry(BaseFactor):
    """Stress-gated sector-residual execution-pressure carry signal."""

    factor_id = "stress_liquid_quality_execution_carry"
    name = "Stress-Gated Quality Liquidity Pressure"
    category = "microstructure"
    description = (
        "Ranks sector-residual signed intraday execution pressure only during "
        "joint market return-and-turnover stress, for quiet-gap, financially "
        "resilient, highly tradable names."
    )
    window_length = 80
    inputs = [
        "open",
        "close",
        "volume",
        "marketCap",
        "roe",
        "freeCashFlowYield",
        "debtToAssets",
        "sector",
    ]
    prediction_horizon = 6
    suggested_horizons = [6]

    def calc(self, data: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        close = data["close"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        open_ = data["open"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        volume = data["volume"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        market_cap = data["marketCap"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        positive_close = close.gt(0.0)
        positive_open = open_.gt(0.0)
        positive_volume = volume.gt(0.0)
        positive_cap = market_cap.gt(0.0)
        basic_valid = positive_close & positive_volume & positive_cap

        previous_close = close.shift(1)
        intraday = (close / open_ - 1.0).where(positive_close & positive_open)
        close_to_close = (close / previous_close - 1.0).where(
            positive_close & previous_close.gt(0.0)
        )
        gap = (open_ / previous_close - 1.0).where(
            positive_open & previous_close.gt(0.0)
        )

        dollar_volume = (close * volume).where(basic_valid)
        log_dollar_volume = np.log(dollar_volume.where(dollar_volume.gt(0.0)))
        turnover = (dollar_volume / market_cap).where(basic_valid)

        intraday_win = _winsorize_cross_section(
            intraday, basic_valid & intraday.notna()
        )
        log_dv_win = _winsorize_cross_section(
            log_dollar_volume, log_dollar_volume.notna()
        )
        turnover_win = _winsorize_cross_section(turnover, turnover.notna())

        prior_log_dv_mean = log_dv_win.shift(1).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
        abnormal_volume = log_dv_win - prior_log_dv_mean
        abnormal_volume_win = _winsorize_cross_section(
            abnormal_volume, abnormal_volume.notna()
        )
        pressure = intraday_win * abnormal_volume_win

        # Both market-state components use only the valid tradable universe.
        market_abs_return = close_to_close.abs().where(basic_valid)
        market_turnover = turnover_win.where(basic_valid)
        stress_return_level = market_abs_return.quantile(0.75, axis=1)
        stress_turnover_level = market_turnover.quantile(0.50, axis=1)
        return_threshold = stress_return_level.shift(1).rolling(
            60, min_periods=60
        ).quantile(0.80)
        turnover_threshold = stress_turnover_level.shift(1).rolling(
            60, min_periods=60
        ).quantile(0.80)
        stress_series = (
            stress_return_level.gt(return_threshold)
            & stress_turnover_level.gt(turnover_threshold)
        )
        stress = pd.DataFrame(
            np.repeat(stress_series.to_numpy()[:, None], close.shape[1], axis=1),
            index=close.index,
            columns=close.columns,
        )

        labels = _static_sector_labels(data["sector"])
        roe = data["roe"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        fcf_yield = data["freeCashFlowYield"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
        debt_assets = data["debtToAssets"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

        roe_rank = _sector_rank(roe, labels)
        fcf_rank = _sector_rank(fcf_yield, labels)
        debt_rank = _sector_rank(-debt_assets, labels)
        fundamental_valid = roe.notna() & fcf_yield.notna() & debt_assets.notna()
        quality = ((roe_rank + fcf_rank + debt_rank) / 3.0).where(fundamental_valid)

        median_turnover = turnover_win.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median()
        tradability = _sector_rank(median_turnover, labels)
        tradability_valid = median_turnover.notna()

        quality_gate = quality.ge(0.67)
        tradability_gate = tradability.ge(0.67)
        pressure_valid = pressure.notna() & intraday.notna() & abnormal_volume.notna()
        base_eligible = (
            basic_valid
            & pressure_valid
            & fundamental_valid
            & tradability_valid
            & quality_gate
            & tradability_gate
        )

        residual_pressure, sector_count = _sector_pressure_and_count(
            pressure, labels, base_eligible
        )
        sufficient_sector = sector_count.ge(5.0)
        qualifying = base_eligible & sufficient_sector
        sector_percentile = _sector_rank(residual_pressure, labels, qualifying)
        signed_score = 2.0 * sector_percentile - 1.0

        quiet_gap_limit = (0.25 * intraday.abs()).clip(upper=0.005)
        quiet_gap = gap.abs().le(quiet_gap_limit) & gap.notna()
        final_gate = qualifying & stress & quiet_gap

        return signed_score.where(final_gate, 0.0).fillna(0.0).astype(float)

programs.trading_idea: During broad market stress, investors needing immediate cash may preferentially transact in financially resilient, highly tradable names because those positions can absorb larger notional execution with less immediate implementation risk than illiquid or financially fragile holdings. The hypothesis is not that all liquid-quality stocks fall in stress, but that an unusually large same-day directional execution imbalance in this specific group, when not accompanied by a material overnight repricing, reflects a partially completed flow and has short-horizon continuation. The quality and tradability conditions identify plausible funding vehicles, while sector-relative residualization removes common sector news and sector-basket moves that can otherwise resemble forced-flow pressure.
programs.description: At each date t after the close, use only bars and point-in-time fundamentals available through t. Define intraday return r_i,t = close_i,t / open_i,t - 1, overnight gap g_i,t = open_i,t / close_i,t-1 - 1, daily dollar volume DV_i,t = close_i,t * volume_i,t, and daily turnover TV_i,t = DV_i,t / marketCap_i,t. Require positive close, volume, and marketCap. Winsorize r_i,t, log(DV_i,t), and TV_i,t cross-sectionally at the 1st and 99th percentiles each day. Define abnormal-volume a_i,t = log(DV_i,t) - mean(log(DV_i,t-20:t-1)); require 20 prior valid daily observations. Define raw signed execution pressure p_i,t = winsorized(r_i,t) * winsorized(a_i,t). Define broad market stress using the eligible-universe cross-sectional 75th percentile of absolute close-to-close return A_t = Q75(|close_i,t / close_i,t-1 - 1|) and the cross-sectional median turnover B_t = median(TV_i,t). Stress is active only when both A_t exceeds its trailing 60-day 80th-percentile threshold, computed from A_t-60:t-1, and B_t exceeds its trailing 60-day 80th-percentile threshold, computed from B_t-60:t-1. Define a quiet-gap condition as |g_i,t| <= min(0.005, 0.25 * |r_i,t|); this excludes names whose move was primarily incorporated at the open rather than during the trading session. Construct sector-relative fundamental quality Q_i,t as the mean of three within-sector percentile ranks: roe_i,t, freeCashFlowYield_i,t, and -debtToAssets_i,t. Construct sector-relative tradability L_i,t as the within-sector percentile rank of the trailing 20-day median turnover, median(TV_i,t-19:t). Require all three quality inputs and the tradability measure to be non-missing; no stale-value imputation beyond the feed's existing point-in-time forward fill is performed. The quality/liquidity eligibility gate is Q_i,t >= 0.67 and L_i,t >= 0.67. To isolate pressure not explained by a common sector move, compute sector-residual pressure x_i,t = p_i,t - mean(p_j,t for j in i's sector), requiring at least five eligible tickers in that sector. Within each sector, rank x_i,t among qualifying names and set score_i,t = 2 * percentile_rank_sector(x_i,t) - 1; set score to zero unless market stress, quiet-gap, quality, tradability, and data-validity gates all hold. The signal is therefore long positive residual execution pressure and short negative residual execution pressure, conditional on the joint stress x quiet-gap x quality/liquidity interaction. It differs from generic signed-volume continuation by requiring a market-level two-component stress state, an explicitly small overnight-information component, a sector-relative funding-quality and turnover screen, and sector residualization before ranking. Positions based on score at t may enter no earlier than the next executable bar at t+1, never at t's close.
